name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_add_left
statement:
lemma comp_add_left (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α α' : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b (α + α') β = comp (R := R) a b α β + comp (R := R) a b α' β

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_add_right
statement:
lemma comp_add_right (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β β' : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b α (β + β') = comp (R := R) a b α β + comp (R := R) a b α β'

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_smul_left
statement:
lemma comp_smul_left (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b (r • α) β = r • comp (R := R) a b α β

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_smul_right
statement:
lemma comp_smul_right (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b α (r • β) = r • comp (R := R) a b α β

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_zero_left
statement:
lemma comp_zero_left (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b (0 : P (a + 1 + b)) β = 0

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_zero_right (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : P (a + 1 + b)) :
    comp (R := R) a b α (0 : P n) = 0

name: Operad.reindex_ass
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reindex_ass {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : Ass R m) :
    reindex R (Ass R) h x = x

name: Operad.reindex_eq_iff
statement:
lemma reindex_eq_iff {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x y : P m) :
    reindex R P h x = reindex R P h y ↔ x = y

name: Operad.reindex_injective
statement: lemma reindex_injective {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) : Function.Injective (reindex R P h)

name: Operad.reindex_reindex
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reindex_reindex {l m n : ℕ} (h₁ : l = m) (h₂ : m = n) (x : P l) :
    reindex R P h₂ (reindex R P h₁ x) = reindex R P (h₁.trans h₂) x

name: Operad.reindex_rfl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reindex_rfl {n : ℕ} (x : P n) : reindex R P (rfl : n = n) x = x

name: Operad.reindex_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reindex_self {n : ℕ} (h : n = n) (x : P n) : reindex R P h x = x

name: Operad.reindex_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reindex_symm_apply {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : P n) :
    (reindex R P h).symm x = reindex R P h.symm x

name: Operad.NSOperadHom.app_compFin
statement:
lemma app_compFin (φ : NSOperadHom R P Q) {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (α : P m) (β : P n) :
    φ.app (m - 1 + n) (compFin (R := R) i α β)
      = compFin (R := R) i (φ.app m α) (φ.app n β)

name: Operad.NSOperadHom.app_reindex
statement:
lemma app_reindex (φ : NSOperadHom R P Q) {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : P m) :
    φ.app n (reindex R P h x) = reindex R Q h (φ.app m x)

name: Operad.NSOperadHom.comp_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_app (g : NSOperadHom R Q S) (f : NSOperadHom R P Q) (n : ℕ) :
    (g.comp f).app n = (g.app n).comp (f.app n)

name: Operad.NSOperadHom.comp_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_id (f : NSOperadHom R P Q) : f.comp NSOperadHom.id = f

name: Operad.NSOperadHom.ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma ext {f g : NSOperadHom R P Q} (h : ∀ n, f.app n = g.app n) : f = g

name: Operad.NSOperadHom.id_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma id_app (n : ℕ) : (NSOperadHom.id (R := R) (P := P)).app n = LinearMap.id

name: Operad.NSOperadHom.id_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma id_comp (f : NSOperadHom R P Q) : NSOperadHom.id.comp f = f

name: Operad.compFin_add_left
statement:
lemma compFin_add_left {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (α α' : P m) (β : P n) :
    compFin (R := R) i (α + α') β = compFin (R := R) i α β + compFin (R := R) i α' β

name: Operad.compFin_add_right
statement:
lemma compFin_add_right {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (α : P m) (β β' : P n) :
    compFin (R := R) i α (β + β') = compFin (R := R) i α β + compFin (R := R) i α β'

name: Operad.compFin_eq_comp
statement:
lemma compFin_eq_comp (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    compFin (R := R) ⟨a, by omega⟩ α β
      = reindex R P (by omega) (comp (R := R) a b α β)

name: Operad.compFin_reindex_left
statement:
lemma compFin_reindex_left {m m' n : ℕ} (h : m = m') {p : ℕ} (hp : p < m) (α : P m) (β : P n) :
    compFin (R := R) (⟨p, by omega⟩ : Fin m') (reindex R P h α) β
      = reindex R P (by omega) (compFin (R := R) ⟨p, hp⟩ α β)

name: Operad.compFin_reindex_right
statement:
lemma compFin_reindex_right {m n n' : ℕ} (h : n = n') {p : ℕ} (hp : p < m) (α : P m) (β : P n) :
    compFin (R := R) ⟨p, hp⟩ α (reindex R P h β)
      = reindex R P (by omega) (compFin (R := R) ⟨p, hp⟩ α β)

name: Operad.compFin_smul_left
statement:
lemma compFin_smul_left {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (r : R) (α : P m) (β : P n) :
    compFin (R := R) i (r • α) β = r • compFin (R := R) i α β

name: Operad.compFin_smul_right
statement:
lemma compFin_smul_right {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (r : R) (α : P m) (β : P n) :
    compFin (R := R) i α (r • β) = r • compFin (R := R) i α β

name: Operad.compFin_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma compFin_zero_left {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (β : P n) :
    compFin (R := R) i (0 : P m) β = 0

name: Operad.compFin_zero_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma compFin_zero_right {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (α : P m) :
    compFin (R := R) i α (0 : P n) = 0

name: Operad.comp_arity_congr
statement:
lemma comp_arity_congr (a b : ℕ) {n n' : ℕ} (hn : n = n') (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b α (reindex R P hn β)
      = reindex R P (by omega) (comp (R := R) a b α β)

name: Operad.comp_index_congr
statement:
lemma comp_index_congr (a : ℕ) {b b' : ℕ} (hb : b = b') {n : ℕ}
    (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b' (reindex R P (by omega) α) β
      = reindex R P (by omega) (comp (R := R) a b α β)

name: Operad.comp_leading_congr
statement:
lemma comp_leading_congr {a a' : ℕ} (ha : a = a') (b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a' b (reindex R P (by omega) α) β
      = reindex R P (by omega) (comp (R := R) a b α β)

name: Operad.compFin_assoc_par
statement:
lemma compFin_assoc_par {m n p : ℕ} (i i' : Fin m) (hlt : (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ))
    (α : P m) (β : P n) (γ : P p) :
    compFin (R := R)
        (⟨(i' : ℕ) + n - 1, by have := i'.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + n))
        (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ
      = reindex R P (by have := i'.isLt; omega)
          (compFin (R := R) (⟨(i : ℕ), by have := i'.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + p))
            (compFin (R := R) i' α γ) β)

name: Operad.compFin_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma compFin_assoc_seq {m n p : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) (α : P m) (β : P n) (γ : P p) :
    reindex R P (by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega)
        (compFin (R := R)
          (⟨(i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ), by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + n))
          (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ)
      = compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) j β γ)

name: Operad.End.compL_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compL_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (β : End R V n)
    (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    compL a b α β v = α (insTuple a b (β (midTuple a b v)) v)

name: Operad.End.compMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compMap_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (β : End R V n)
    (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    compMap a b α β v = α (insTuple a b (β (midTuple a b v)) v)

name: Operad.End.comp_assoc_par'
statement:
lemma comp_assoc_par' (a b c : ℕ) {n p : ℕ} (α : End R V (a + 1 + b + 1 + c)) (β : End R V n)
    (γ : End R V p) :
    reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
        (compMap (a + n + b) c
          (reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
            (compMap a (b + 1 + c) (reindex R (End R V) (by omega) α) β)) γ)
      = compMap a (b + p + c) (reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (compMap (a + 1 + b) c α γ)) β

name: Operad.End.comp_assoc_seq'
statement:
lemma comp_assoc_seq' (a b c d : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (β : End R V (c + 1 + d))
    (γ : End R V p) :
    reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
        (compMap (a + c) (d + b) (reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (compMap a b α β)) γ)
      = compMap a b α (compMap c d β γ)

name: Operad.End.comp_one_left'
statement:
lemma comp_one_left' {n : ℕ} (α : End R V n) :
    reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (compMap 0 0 (idEnd (R := R) (V := V)) α) = α

name: Operad.End.comp_one_right'
statement:
lemma comp_one_right' (a b : ℕ) (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) :
    compMap a b α (idEnd (R := R) (V := V)) = α

name: Operad.End.idEnd_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma idEnd_apply (v : Fin 1 → V) : (idEnd (R := R) (V := V)) v = v 0

name: Operad.End.idxCases
statement:
lemma idxCases (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (a + n + b)) :
    (∃ j, i = midIdx a b j) ∨ ∃ k, i = outIdx a b k

name: Operad.End.insTuple_eq_update
statement:
lemma insTuple_eq_update (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + 1 + b))]
    (x y : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    insTuple a b y v = Function.update (insTuple a b x v) (slotPos a b) y

name: Operad.End.insTuple_of_eq
statement:
lemma insTuple_of_eq (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V)
    (i : Fin (a + 1 + b)) (h : (i : ℕ) = a) :
    insTuple a b x v i = x

name: Operad.End.insTuple_of_gt
statement:
lemma insTuple_of_gt (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V)
    (i : Fin (a + 1 + b)) (h : a < (i : ℕ)) :
    insTuple a b x v i = v ⟨(i : ℕ) + n - 1, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩

name: Operad.End.insTuple_of_lt
statement:
lemma insTuple_of_lt (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V)
    (i : Fin (a + 1 + b)) (h : (i : ℕ) < a) :
    insTuple a b x v i = v ⟨i, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩

name: Operad.End.insTuple_outPos
statement:
@[simp] lemma insTuple_outPos (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V)
    (k : Fin (a + b)) :
    insTuple a b x v (outPos a b k) = v (outIdx a b k)

name: Operad.End.insTuple_slotPos
statement:
@[simp] lemma insTuple_slotPos (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    insTuple a b x v (slotPos a b) = x

name: Operad.End.insTuple_update_midIdx
statement:
lemma insTuple_update_midIdx (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + n + b))]
    (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) (j : Fin n) (z : V) :
    insTuple a b x (Function.update v (midIdx a b j) z) = insTuple a b x v

name: Operad.End.insTuple_update_outIdx
statement:
lemma insTuple_update_outIdx (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + n + b))]
    [DecidableEq (Fin (a + 1 + b))] (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V)
    (k : Fin (a + b)) (z : V) :
    insTuple a b x (Function.update v (outIdx a b k) z)
      = Function.update (insTuple a b x v) (outPos a b k) z

name: Operad.End.midIdx_injective
statement: lemma midIdx_injective (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} : Injective (midIdx (n := n) a b)

name: Operad.End.midIdx_ne_outIdx
statement:
lemma midIdx_ne_outIdx (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) (k : Fin (a + b)) :
    midIdx a b j ≠ outIdx a b k

name: Operad.End.midIdx_one
statement: lemma midIdx_one (a b : ℕ) : midIdx (n := 1) a b 0 = slotPos a b

name: Operad.End.midIdx_val
statement: @[simp] lemma midIdx_val (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) : (midIdx a b j : ℕ) = a + j

name: Operad.End.midTuple_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma midTuple_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) (j : Fin n) :
    midTuple a b v j = v (midIdx a b j)

name: Operad.End.midTuple_update_midIdx
statement:
lemma midTuple_update_midIdx (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + n + b))]
    [DecidableEq (Fin n)] (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) (j : Fin n) (z : V) :
    midTuple a b (Function.update v (midIdx a b j) z)
      = Function.update (midTuple a b v) j z

name: Operad.End.midTuple_update_outIdx
statement:
lemma midTuple_update_outIdx (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + n + b))]
    (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) (k : Fin (a + b)) (z : V) :
    midTuple a b (Function.update v (outIdx a b k) z) = midTuple a b v

name: Operad.End.operad_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma operad_comp_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (β : End R V n)
    (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b α β v = α (insTuple a b (β (midTuple a b v)) v)

name: Operad.End.outIdx_injective
statement: lemma outIdx_injective (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} : Injective (outIdx (n := n) a b)

name: Operad.End.outIdx_one_eq_outPos
statement:
lemma outIdx_one_eq_outPos (a b : ℕ) (k : Fin (a + b)) :
    outIdx (n := 1) a b k = outPos a b k

name: Operad.End.outIdx_val_of_lt
statement:
lemma outIdx_val_of_lt (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (k : Fin (a + b)) (h : (k : ℕ) < a) :
    (outIdx (n := n) a b k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ)

name: Operad.End.outIdx_val_of_not_lt
statement:
lemma outIdx_val_of_not_lt (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (k : Fin (a + b)) (h : ¬ (k : ℕ) < a) :
    (outIdx (n := n) a b k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) + n

name: Operad.End.outPos_injective
statement: lemma outPos_injective (a b : ℕ) : Injective (outPos a b)

name: Operad.End.outPos_ne_slotPos
statement: lemma outPos_ne_slotPos (a b : ℕ) (k : Fin (a + b)) : outPos a b k ≠ slotPos a b

name: Operad.End.outPos_val_of_lt
statement:
lemma outPos_val_of_lt (a b : ℕ) (k : Fin (a + b)) (h : (k : ℕ) < a) :
    (outPos a b k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ)

name: Operad.End.outPos_val_of_not_lt
statement:
lemma outPos_val_of_not_lt (a b : ℕ) (k : Fin (a + b)) (h : ¬ (k : ℕ) < a) :
    (outPos a b k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) + 1

name: Operad.End.posCases
statement:
lemma posCases (a b : ℕ) (i : Fin (a + 1 + b)) :
    i = slotPos a b ∨ ∃ k, i = outPos a b k

name: Operad.End.reindex_apply
statement:
lemma reindex_apply {m m' : ℕ} (h : m = m') (x : End R V m) (v : Fin m' → V) :
    reindex R (End R V) h x v = x (fun i => v (Fin.cast h i))

name: Operad.End.slotPos_val
statement: @[simp] lemma slotPos_val (a b : ℕ) : (slotPos a b : ℕ) = a

name: Operad.End.slot_add
statement:
lemma slot_add (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + 1 + b))]
    (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (x y : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    α (insTuple a b (x + y) v) = α (insTuple a b x v) + α (insTuple a b y v)

name: Operad.End.slot_smul
statement:
lemma slot_smul (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + 1 + b))]
    (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (c : R) (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    α (insTuple a b (c • x) v) = c • α (insTuple a b x v)

name: Operad.bracket_add_left
statement:
lemma bracket_add_left {j k : ℕ} (α α' : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    bracket (R := R) (α + α') β = bracket (R := R) α β + bracket (R := R) α' β

name: Operad.bracket_add_right
statement:
lemma bracket_add_right {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β β' : P (k + 1)) :
    bracket (R := R) α (β + β') = bracket (R := R) α β + bracket (R := R) α β'

name: Operad.bracket_antisymm
statement:
lemma bracket_antisymm {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    bracket (R := R) α β = - reindex R P (by omega) (bracket (R := R) β α)

name: Operad.bracket_def
statement:
lemma bracket_def {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    bracket (R := R) α β
      = star (R := R) α β - reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) β α)

name: Operad.bracket_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma bracket_self {j : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) :
    bracket (R := R) α α = 0

name: Operad.compFin_one
statement:
lemma compFin_one {m : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (α : P m) :
    compFin (R := R) i α (one (R := R) (P := P))
      = reindex R P (by have := i.isLt; omega) α

name: Operad.compFin_zero_one
statement:
lemma compFin_zero_one {k : ℕ} (β : P (k + 1)) :
    reindex R P (by omega)
        (compFin (R := R) (0 : Fin (0 + 1)) (one (R := R) (P := P)) β) = β

name: Operad.one_star
statement:
@[simp] lemma one_star {k : ℕ} (β : P (k + 1)) :
    reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) (one (R := R) (P := P)) β) = β

name: Operad.star_add_left
statement:
lemma star_add_left {j k : ℕ} (α α' : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (α + α') β = star (R := R) α β + star (R := R) α' β

name: Operad.star_add_right
statement:
lemma star_add_right {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β β' : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α (β + β') = star (R := R) α β + star (R := R) α β'

name: Operad.star_def
statement:
lemma star_def {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α β = ∑ i : Fin (j + 1), compFin (R := R) i α β

name: Operad.star_smul_left
statement:
lemma star_smul_left {j k : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (r • α) β = r • star (R := R) α β

name: Operad.star_smul_right
statement:
lemma star_smul_right {j k : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α (r • β) = r • star (R := R) α β

name: Operad.star_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma star_zero {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α (0 : P (k + 1)) = 0

name: Operad.zero_star
statement:
@[simp] lemma zero_star {j k : ℕ} (β : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (0 : P (j + 1)) β = 0

name: Operad.compFin_sum_left
statement:
lemma compFin_sum_left {m n : ℕ} {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) (i : Fin m) (f : ι → P m)
    (β : P n) :
    compFin (R := R) i (∑ x ∈ s, f x) β = ∑ x ∈ s, compFin (R := R) i (f x) β

name: Operad.compFin_sum_right
statement:
lemma compFin_sum_right {m n : ℕ} {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) (i : Fin m) (α : P m)
    (g : ι → P n) :
    compFin (R := R) i α (∑ x ∈ s, g x) = ∑ x ∈ s, compFin (R := R) i α (g x)

name: Operad.disjointPart_symm
statement:
theorem disjointPart_symm {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    disjointPart (R := R) α β γ
      = reindex R P (by omega) (disjointPart (R := R) α γ β)

name: Operad.mem_after
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_after {j k : ℕ} (i : Fin (j + 1)) (i' : Fin (j + k + 1)) :
    i' ∈ after (k := k) i ↔ (i : ℕ) + k < (i' : ℕ)

name: Operad.mem_before
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_before {j k : ℕ} (i : Fin (j + 1)) (i' : Fin (j + k + 1)) :
    i' ∈ before (k := k) i ↔ (i' : ℕ) < (i : ℕ)

name: Operad.mem_nested
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_nested {j k : ℕ} (i : Fin (j + 1)) (i' : Fin (j + k + 1)) :
    i' ∈ nested (k := k) i ↔ ∃ i'' : Fin (k + 1), (i' : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + (i'' : ℕ)

name: Operad.not_mem_nested_iff
statement:
lemma not_mem_nested_iff {j k : ℕ} (i : Fin (j + 1)) (i' : Fin (j + k + 1)) :
    i' ∉ nested (k := k) i ↔ (i' : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) ∨ (i : ℕ) + k < (i' : ℕ)

name: Operad.star_assoc_symm
statement:
theorem star_assoc_symm {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (star (R := R) α β) γ
        - reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) α (star (R := R) β γ))
      = reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) (star (R := R) α γ) β)
        - reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) α (star (R := R) γ β))

name: Operad.star_star_left
statement:
lemma star_star_left {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (star (R := R) α β) γ
      = ∑ i' : Fin (j + k + 1), ∑ i : Fin (j + 1),
          compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ

name: Operad.star_star_left_split
statement:
lemma star_star_left_split {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (star (R := R) α β) γ
      = reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) α (star (R := R) β γ))
        + disjointPart (R := R) α β γ

name: Operad.star_star_right
statement:
lemma star_star_right {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α (star (R := R) β γ)
      = ∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1),
          compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) i'' β γ)

name: Operad.sum_after_eq
statement:
lemma sum_after_eq {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    ((∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i' ∈ after (k := k) i,
        compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ) : P (j + k + l + 1))
      = ∑ s : Fin (j + 1), ∑ t ∈ before (k := l) s,
          reindex R P (by omega) (compFin (R := R) t (compFin (R := R) s α γ) β)

name: Operad.sum_before_eq
statement:
lemma sum_before_eq {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    ((∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i' ∈ before (k := k) i,
        compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ) : P (j + k + l + 1))
      = ∑ s : Fin (j + 1), ∑ t ∈ after (k := l) s,
          reindex R P (by omega) (compFin (R := R) t (compFin (R := R) s α γ) β)

name: Operad.sum_compl_nested
statement:
lemma sum_compl_nested {j k : ℕ} {M : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] (i : Fin (j + 1))
    (f : Fin (j + k + 1) → M) :
    ∑ i' ∈ (nested (k := k) i)ᶜ, f i'
      = (∑ i' ∈ before (k := k) i, f i') + ∑ i' ∈ after (k := k) i, f i'

name: Operad.sum_nested
statement:
lemma sum_nested {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1))
    (i : Fin (j + 1)) :
    reindex R P (by omega)
        (∑ i' ∈ nested (k := k) i, compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ)
      = ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1), compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) i'' β γ)

name: Operad.End.cfTuple_of_eq
statement:
lemma cfTuple_of_eq {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (β : End R V n) (v : Fin (m - 1 + n) → V)
    (s : Fin m) (h : (s : ℕ) = i) :
    cfTuple i β v s = β (fun t => v ⟨i + t, by have := t.isLt; have := i.isLt; omega⟩)

name: Operad.End.cfTuple_of_gt
statement:
lemma cfTuple_of_gt {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (β : End R V n) (v : Fin (m - 1 + n) → V)
    (s : Fin m) (h : (i : ℕ) < s) :
    cfTuple i β v s = v ⟨s + n - 1, by have := s.isLt; have := i.isLt; omega⟩

name: Operad.End.cfTuple_of_lt
statement:
lemma cfTuple_of_lt {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (β : End R V n) (v : Fin (m - 1 + n) → V)
    (s : Fin m) (h : (s : ℕ) < i) :
    cfTuple i β v s = v ⟨s, by have := s.isLt; have := i.isLt; omega⟩

name: Operad.End.compFin_apply
statement:
lemma compFin_apply {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (α : End R V m) (β : End R V n)
    (v : Fin (m - 1 + n) → V) : compFin (R := R) i α β v = α (cfTuple i β v)

name: Operad.End.compFin_twist_left
statement:
lemma compFin_twist_left (q i' : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (hi : i' ≤ (i : ℕ)) (α : End R V m)
    (β : End R V n) :
    compFin (R := R) i (twist ε q i' α) β = twist ε q i' (compFin (R := R) i α β)

name: Operad.End.kcompFin_assoc_seq
statement:
theorem kcompFin_assoc_seq (q r : ℕ) {m n p : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) (α : End R V m)
    (β : End R V n) (γ : End R V p) :
    reindex R (End R V) (by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega)
        (kcompFin ε r
          (⟨(i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ), by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + n))
          (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ)
      = kcompFin ε (q + r) i α (kcompFin ε r j β γ)

name: Operad.End.kcompFin_sum_left
statement:
lemma kcompFin_sum_left (q : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (i : Fin m)
    (f : ι → End R V m) (β : End R V n) :
    kcompFin ε q i (∑ x ∈ s, f x) β = ∑ x ∈ s, kcompFin ε q i (f x) β

name: Operad.End.kcompFin_sum_right
statement:
lemma kcompFin_sum_right (q : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (i : Fin m)
    (α : End R V m) (g : ι → End R V n) :
    kcompFin ε q i α (∑ x ∈ s, g x) = ∑ x ∈ s, kcompFin ε q i α (g x)

name: Operad.End.kdisjointPart_eq
statement:
lemma kdisjointPart_eq (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    (γ : End R V (l + 1)) :
    kdisjointPart ε q r α β γ = kbefore ε q r α β γ + kafter ε q r α β γ

name: Operad.End.kstar_kstar_left
statement:
lemma kstar_kstar_left (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    (γ : End R V (l + 1)) :
    kstar ε r (kstar ε q α β) γ
      = ∑ i' : Fin (j + k + 1), ∑ i : Fin (j + 1), kcompFin ε r i' (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ

name: Operad.End.kstar_kstar_left_split
statement:
lemma kstar_kstar_left_split (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    (γ : End R V (l + 1)) :
    kstar ε r (kstar ε q α β) γ
      = reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (kstar ε (q + r) α (kstar ε r β γ))
        + kdisjointPart ε q r α β γ

name: Operad.End.kstar_kstar_right
statement:
lemma kstar_kstar_right (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    (γ : End R V (l + 1)) :
    kstar ε (q + r) α (kstar ε r β γ)
      = ∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1),
          kcompFin ε (q + r) i α (kcompFin ε r i'' β γ)

name: Operad.End.reindex_twist
statement:
lemma reindex_twist {m m' : ℕ} (h : m = m') (q i : ℕ) (α : End R V m) :
    reindex R (End R V) h (twist ε q i α) = twist ε q i (reindex R (End R V) h α)

name: Operad.End.sum_nested_k
statement:
lemma sum_nested_k (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    (γ : End R V (l + 1)) (i : Fin (j + 1)) :
    reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
        (∑ i' ∈ nested (k := k) i, kcompFin ε r i' (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ)
      = ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1), kcompFin ε (q + r) i α (kcompFin ε r i'' β γ)

name: Operad.End.twist_comm
statement:
lemma twist_comm (q r i i' : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V n) :
    twist ε r i' (twist ε q i α) = twist ε q i (twist ε r i' α)

name: Operad.End.twist_compFin_nested
statement:
lemma twist_compFin_nested (r : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) (α : End R V m)
    (β : End R V n) :
    twist ε r (i + j) (compFin (R := R) i α β)
      = compFin (R := R) i (twist ε r i α) (twist ε r j β)

name: Operad.End.twist_twist
statement:
lemma twist_twist (q r i : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V n) :
    twist ε r i (twist ε q i α) = twist ε (q + r) i α

name: Operad.AInf.acast_acast
statement:
lemma acast_acast {a b c : ℕ} (h : a = b) (x : End R V a) :
    (acast (acast x : End R V b) : End R V c) = acast x

name: Operad.AInf.acast_add
statement:
lemma acast_add {a b : ℕ} (x y : End R V a) :
    (acast (x + y) : End R V b) = acast x + acast y

name: Operad.AInf.acast_neg
statement: lemma acast_neg {a b : ℕ} (x : End R V a) : (acast (-x) : End R V b) = -acast x

name: Operad.AInf.acast_of_eq
statement:
lemma acast_of_eq {a b : ℕ} (h : a = b) (x : End R V a) :
    (acast x : End R V b) = reindex R (End R V) h x

name: Operad.AInf.acast_reindex
statement:
lemma acast_reindex {a b c : ℕ} (h : a = b) (x : End R V a) :
    (acast (reindex R (End R V) h x) : End R V c) = acast x

name: Operad.AInf.acast_self
statement: @[simp] lemma acast_self {a : ℕ} (x : End R V a) : (acast x : End R V a) = x

name: Operad.AInf.acast_smul
statement:
lemma acast_smul {a b : ℕ} (c : R) (x : End R V a) :
    (acast (c • x) : End R V b) = c • acast x

name: Operad.AInf.acast_sub
statement:
lemma acast_sub {a b : ℕ} (x y : End R V a) :
    (acast (x - y) : End R V b) = acast x - acast y

name: Operad.AInf.acast_sum
statement:
lemma acast_sum {a b : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → End R V a) :
    (acast (∑ i ∈ s, x i) : End R V b) = ∑ i ∈ s, acast (x i)

name: Operad.AInf.acast_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma acast_zero {a b : ℕ} : (acast (0 : End R V a) : End R V b) = 0

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_acast_left
statement:
lemma kstar_acast_left (q : ℕ) {j j' k : ℕ} (h : j' = j) (α : End R V (j' + 1))
    (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q (acast α : End R V (j + 1)) β = acast (kstar ε q α β)

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_acast_right
statement:
lemma kstar_acast_right (q : ℕ) {j k k' : ℕ} (h : k' = k) (α : End R V (j + 1))
    (β : End R V (k' + 1)) :
    kstar ε q α (acast β : End R V (k + 1)) = acast (kstar ε q α β)

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_add_left
statement:
lemma kstar_add_left (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (α α' : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q (α + α') β = kstar ε q α β + kstar ε q α' β

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_add_right
statement:
lemma kstar_add_right (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β β' : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q α (β + β') = kstar ε q α β + kstar ε q α β'

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_apply_11
statement:
lemma kstar_apply_11 (d d' : End R V 1) (v : Fin 1 → V) :
    kstar ε 1 d d' v = d ![d' ![v 0]]

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_apply_12
statement:
lemma kstar_apply_12 (d : End R V 1) (μ : End R V 2) (v : Fin 2 → V) :
    kstar ε 1 d μ v = d ![μ ![v 0, v 1]]

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_apply_21
statement:
lemma kstar_apply_21 (μ : End R V 2) (d : End R V 1) (v : Fin 2 → V) :
    kstar ε 1 μ d v = μ ![d ![v 0], v 1] + μ ![ε (v 0), d ![v 1]]

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_apply_22
statement:
lemma kstar_apply_22 (μ ν : End R V 2) (v : Fin 3 → V) :
    kstar ε 1 μ ν v = μ ![ν ![v 0, v 1], v 2] + μ ![ε (v 0), ν ![v 1, v 2]]

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_smul_left
statement:
lemma kstar_smul_left (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (c : R) (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q (c • α) β = c • kstar ε q α β

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_smul_right
statement:
lemma kstar_smul_right (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (c : R) (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q α (c • β) = c • kstar ε q α β

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_sub_left
statement:
lemma kstar_sub_left (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (α α' : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q (α - α') β = kstar ε q α β - kstar ε q α' β

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_sub_right
statement:
lemma kstar_sub_right (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β β' : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q α (β - β') = kstar ε q α β - kstar ε q α β'

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_sum_left
statement:
lemma kstar_sum_left (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → End R V (j + 1))
    (β : End R V (k + 1)) : kstar ε q (∑ x ∈ s, f x) β = ∑ x ∈ s, kstar ε q (f x) β

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_sum_right
statement:
lemma kstar_sum_right (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (α : End R V (j + 1))
    (g : ι → End R V (k + 1)) : kstar ε q α (∑ x ∈ s, g x) = ∑ x ∈ s, kstar ε q α (g x)

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma kstar_zero_left (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q (0 : End R V (j + 1)) β = 0

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_zero_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma kstar_zero_right (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) :
    kstar ε q α (0 : End R V (k + 1)) = 0

name: Operad.AInf.sum_triangle
statement:
lemma sum_triangle {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    ∑ a ∈ range (m + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (a + 1), F j (a - j) (m - a)
      = ∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), ∑ k ∈ range (m - j + 1), F j k (m - j - k)

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_apply
statement:
lemma tstar_apply (q : ℕ) (f g : Fam R V) (m : ℕ) :
    tstar ε q f g m = ∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), acast (kstar ε q (f j) (g (m - j)))

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_assoc_eq_defect
statement:
lemma tstar_assoc_eq_defect (q r : ℕ) (f g h : Fam R V) (m : ℕ) :
    tstar ε r (tstar ε q f g) h m - tstar ε (q + r) f (tstar ε r g h) m
      = defect ε q r f g h m

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_smul_left
statement:
lemma tstar_smul_left (q : ℕ) (c : R) (f g : Fam R V) :
    tstar ε q (c • f) g = c • tstar ε q f g

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_smul_right
statement:
lemma tstar_smul_right (q : ℕ) (c : R) (f g : Fam R V) :
    tstar ε q f (c • g) = c • tstar ε q f g

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_sub_left
statement:
lemma tstar_sub_left (q : ℕ) (f f' g : Fam R V) :
    tstar ε q (f - f') g = tstar ε q f g - tstar ε q f' g

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_sub_right
statement:
lemma tstar_sub_right (q : ℕ) (f g g' : Fam R V) :
    tstar ε q f (g - g') = tstar ε q f g - tstar ε q f g'

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_zero_left
statement: @[simp] lemma tstar_zero_left (q : ℕ) (g : Fam R V) : tstar ε q 0 g = 0

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma tstar_zero_right (q : ℕ) (f : Fam R V) : tstar ε q f 0 = 0

name: Operad.AInf.IsInfMorph.chain
statement:
theorem chain {b : Fam R V} {b' : Fam R W} {f : MSer R V W} (hf : IsInfMorph εV εW b b' f)
    (x : V) : f 1 ![b 0 ![x]] = b' 0 ![f 1 ![x]]

name: Operad.AInf.IsInfMorph.mul
statement:
theorem mul {b : Fam R V} {b' : Fam R W} {f : MSer R V W} (hf : IsInfMorph εV εW b b' f)
    (x y : V) :
    f 1 ![b 1 ![x, y]] + f 2 ![b 0 ![x], y] + f 2 ![εV x, b 0 ![y]] =
      b' 1 ![f 1 ![x], f 1 ![y]] + b' 0 ![f 2 ![x, y]]

name: Operad.AInf.bser_succ_apply
statement:
lemma bser_succ_apply (b : Fam R V) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → V) :
    bser b (n + 1) v = (MSer.id R V (n + 1) v, b n v)

name: Operad.AInf.bser_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma bser_zero (b : Fam R V) : bser b 0 = 0

name: Operad.MSer.applyComp_ones
statement:
lemma applyComp_ones (p : MSer R V W) (n : ℕ) :
    applyComp p (Composition.ones n) =
      fun v i => p 1 fun _ => v (Fin.castLE (Composition.length_le _) i)

name: Operad.MSer.applyComp_update
statement:
lemma applyComp_update (p : MSer R V W) {n : ℕ} (c : Composition n) (j : Fin n) (v : Fin n → V)
    (z : V) :
    applyComp p c (Function.update v j z) =
      Function.update (applyComp p c v) (c.index j)
        (p (c.blocksFun (c.index j))
          (Function.update (v ∘ c.embedding (c.index j)) (c.invEmbedding j) z))

name: Operad.MSer.compAlong_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compAlong_apply (q : MSer R W X) (p : MSer R V W) {n : ℕ} (c : Composition n)
    (v : Fin n → V) : compAlong q p c v = q c.length (applyComp p c v)

name: Operad.MSer.comp_apply
statement:
lemma comp_apply (q : MSer R W X) (p : MSer R V W) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → V) :
    comp q p n v = ∑ c : Composition n, q c.length (applyComp p c v)

name: Operad.MSer.comp_apply_one
statement:
lemma comp_apply_one (q : MSer R W X) (p : MSer R V W) (v : Fin 1 → V) :
    comp q p 1 v = q 1 ![p 1 v]

name: Operad.MSer.comp_apply_two
statement:
lemma comp_apply_two (q : MSer R W X) (p : MSer R V W) (v : Fin 2 → V) :
    comp q p 2 v = q 2 ![p 1 ![v 0], p 1 ![v 1]] + q 1 ![p 2 v]

name: Operad.MSer.comp_even
statement:
lemma comp_even {εX : X →ₗ[R] X} {f : MSer R V W} {g : MSer R W X} (hf : IsEven εV εW f)
    (hg : IsEven εW εX g) : IsEven εV εX (comp g f)

name: Operad.MSer.comp_id
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_id (p : MSer R V W) : comp p (id R V) = p

name: Operad.MSer.comp_lin_right
statement:
theorem comp_lin_right (p : MSer R W X) (φ : V →ₗ[R] W) :
    comp p (lin φ) = fun n => (p n).compLinearMap fun _ => φ

name: Operad.MSer.composition_one

name: Operad.MSer.composition_two

name: Operad.MSer.congr

lemma embedding_lt_embedding {n : ℕ} (c : Composition n) {i r : Fin c.length} (h : i < r)

name: Operad.MSer.hatFn_of_gt
statement: lemma hatFn_of_gt {n : ℕ} {s t : Fin n} (h : s < t) : hatFn εV s t = LinearMap.fst R V V

name: Operad.MSer.hatFn_of_lt
statement:
lemma hatFn_of_lt {n : ℕ} {s t : Fin n} (h : t < s) :

name: Operad.MSer.hatFn_self
statement: lemma hatFn_self {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n) : hatFn εV s s = LinearMap.snd R V V

name: Operad.MSer.hat_apply
statement:
lemma hat_apply (f : MSer R V W) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → V × V) :

statement:
lemma hat_apply_one_snd (εV : V →ₗ[R] V) (f : MSer R V W) (w : Fin 1 → V × V) :

name: Operad.Algebra.act_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma act_add (A : Algebra R P V) {n : ℕ} (α α' : P n) (v : Fin n → V) :
    A.act (α + α') v = A.act α v + A.act α' v

name: Operad.Algebra.act_comp
statement:
lemma act_comp (A : Algebra R P V) (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n)
    (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    A.act (comp (R := R) a b α β) v
      = A.act α (End.insTuple a b (A.act β (End.midTuple a b v)) v)

name: Operad.Algebra.act_def
statement:
lemma act_def (A : Algebra R P V) {n : ℕ} (α : P n) (v : Fin n → V) :
    A.act α v = A.app n α v

name: Operad.Algebra.act_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma act_one (A : Algebra R P V) (v : Fin 1 → V) :
    A.act (one (R := R) (P := P)) v = v 0

name: Operad.Algebra.act_smul
statement:
@[simp] lemma act_smul (A : Algebra R P V) {n : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P n) (v : Fin n → V) :
    A.act (r • α) v = r • A.act α v

name: Operad.Algebra.act_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma act_zero (A : Algebra R P V) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → V) :
    A.act (0 : P n) v = 0

name: Operad.Algebra.comap_act
statement:
@[simp] lemma comap_act (f : NSOperadHom R P Q) (A : Algebra R Q V) {n : ℕ} (α : P n)
    (v : Fin n → V) :
    (A.comap f).act α v = A.act (f.app n α) v

name: Operad.Algebra.self_act
statement:
@[simp] lemma self_act {n : ℕ} (α : End R V n) (v : Fin n → V) :
    (Algebra.self R V).act α v = α v

name: Operad.AssAlgebra.ass_comp_eq
statement:
lemma ass_comp_eq :
    comp (R := R) (P := Ass R) 0 1 (1 : Ass R 2) (1 : Ass R 2)
      = comp (R := R) (P := Ass R) 1 0 (1 : Ass R 2) (1 : Ass R 2)

name: Operad.AssAlgebra.insTuple_left
statement:
lemma insTuple_left (w : V) (v : Fin 3 → V) :

name: Operad.AssAlgebra.insTuple_right

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.cast_cast
statement:
@[simp] lemma cast_cast {l m n : ℕ} (h₁ : l = m) (h₂ : m = n) (t : OfArity E l) :
    cast h₂ (cast h₁ t) = cast (h₁.trans h₂) t

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.cast_self
statement: @[simp] lemma cast_self {n : ℕ} (h : n = n) (t : OfArity E n) : cast h t = t

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.cast_val
statement: @[simp] lemma cast_val {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (t : OfArity E m) : (cast h t).1 = t.1

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {n : ℕ} {s t : OfArity E n} (h : s.1 = t.1) : s = t

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.graft_inj
statement:
theorem graft_inj (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} {t t' : OfArity E (a + 1 + b)} {s s' : OfArity E n}
    (h : graft a b t s = graft a b t' s') : t = t' ∧ s = s'

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.graft_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma graft_val (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t : OfArity E (a + 1 + b)) (s : OfArity E n) :
    (graft a b t s).1 = t.1.graft a s.1

name: Operad.BTree.arity_graft
statement:
theorem arity_graft : ∀ (t : BTree E) (i : ℕ) (s : BTree E), i < t.arity →
    (t.graft i s).arity + 1 = t.arity + s.arity
  | leaf, _, s, _ => by simp only [graft_leaf, arity_leaf]; omega
  | node e l r, i, s, h => by
    simp only [arity_node] at h
    by_cases hi : i < l.arity
    · rw [graft_node_of_lt r s hi]
      have

name: Operad.BTree.arity_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma arity_leaf : (leaf : BTree E).arity = 1

name: Operad.BTree.arity_node
statement: @[simp] lemma arity_node (e : E) (l r : BTree E) : (node e l r).arity = l.arity + r.arity

name: Operad.BTree.arity_pos
statement:
lemma arity_pos : ∀ t : BTree E, 0 < t.arity
  | leaf => Nat.one_pos
  | node _ l _ => Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (arity_pos l) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

name: Operad.BTree.eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one
statement:
lemma eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one : ∀ {t : BTree E}, t.arity = 1 → t = leaf
  | leaf, _ => rfl
  | node _ l r, h => by
    have

name: Operad.BTree.graft_graft_par
statement:
theorem graft_graft_par : ∀ (t : BTree E) (i : ℕ) (s : BTree E) (i' : ℕ) (u : BTree E),
    i < i' → i' < t.arity → (t.graft i s).graft (i' - 1 + s.arity) u = (t.graft i' u).graft i s
  | leaf, _, _, _, _, h, h' => by simp only [arity_leaf] at h'; omega
  | node e l r, i, s, i', u, h, h' => by
    simp only [arity_node] at h'
    have hs

name: Operad.BTree.graft_graft_seq
statement:
theorem graft_graft_seq : ∀ (t : BTree E) (i : ℕ) (s : BTree E) (j : ℕ) (u : BTree E),
    i < t.arity → j < s.arity → (t.graft i s).graft (i + j) u = t.graft i (s.graft j u)
  | leaf, i, s, j, u, h, _ => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0

name: Operad.BTree.graft_inj
statement:
theorem graft_inj : ∀ (t t' : BTree E) (i : ℕ) (s s' : BTree E), i < t.arity → i < t'.arity →
    s.arity = s'.arity → t.graft i s = t'.graft i s' → t = t' ∧ s = s'
  | leaf, leaf, _, s, s', _, _, _, h => ⟨rfl, h⟩
  | leaf, node e l r, i, s, s', hi, hi', hs, h => by
    exfalso
    obtain rfl : i = 0

name: Operad.BTree.graft_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma graft_leaf (i : ℕ) (s : BTree E) : (leaf : BTree E).graft i s = s

name: Operad.BTree.graft_leaf_right
statement:
theorem graft_leaf_right : ∀ (t : BTree E) (i : ℕ), t.graft i leaf = t
  | leaf, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, i => by
    by_cases hi : i < l.arity
    · rw [graft_node_of_lt r _ hi, graft_leaf_right l i]
    · rw [graft_node_of_ge l _ (by omega), graft_leaf_right r]

name: Operad.BTree.graft_node
Operad.BTree.graft_node_of_ge
statement:
lemma graft_node_of_ge {e : E} (l : BTree E) {r : BTree E} {i : ℕ} (s : BTree E)
    (h : l.arity ≤ i) : (node e l r).graft i s = node e l (r.graft (i - l.arity) s)

name: Operad.BTree.graft_node_of_lt
statement:
lemma graft_node_of_lt {e : E} {l : BTree E} (r : BTree E) {i : ℕ} (s : BTree E)
    (h : i < l.arity) : (node e l r).graft i s = node e (l.graft i s) r

name: Operad.BTree.mem_ofArityFinset
statement:
theorem mem_ofArityFinset : ∀ (t : BTree E) (n : ℕ), t ∈ ofArityFinset n ↔ t.arity = n
  | leaf, 0 => by simp [ofArityFinset]
  | leaf, 1 => by simp [ofArityFinset]
  | leaf, n + 2 => by
    simp only [ofArityFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_image,
      Finset.mem_product, true_and, arity_leaf]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, _, _, h⟩
      cases h
    · omega
  | node e l r, 0 => by
    simp only [ofArityFinset, Finset.notMem_empty, arity_node, false_iff]
    have := arity_pos l
    omega
  | node e l r, 1 => by
    simp only [ofArityFinset, Finset.mem_singleton, arity_node]
    have := arity_pos l
    have := arity_pos r
    constructor
    · intro h; cases h
    · intro h; omega
  | node e l r, n + 2 => by
    simp only [ofArityFinset, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_image,
      Finset.mem_product, true_and, arity_node]
    have hl := arity_pos l
    have hr := arity_pos r
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, ⟨e', l', r'⟩, ⟨hl', hr'⟩, h⟩
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Operad.BTree.weight_add_one
statement:
lemma weight_add_one : ∀ t : BTree E, t.weight + 1 = t.arity
  | leaf => rfl
  | node _ l r => by
    have hl

name: Operad.BTree.weight_graft
statement:
theorem weight_graft : ∀ (t : BTree E) (i : ℕ) (s : BTree E), i < t.arity →
    (t.graft i s).weight = t.weight + s.weight
  | leaf, _, s, _ => by simp
  | node e l r, i, s, h => by
    simp only [arity_node] at h
    by_cases hi : i < l.arity
    · rw [graft_node_of_lt r s hi]
      have

name: Operad.BTree.weight_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma weight_leaf : (leaf : BTree E).weight = 0

name: Operad.BTree.weight_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma weight_node (e : E) (l r : BTree E) :
    (node e l r).weight = l.weight + r.weight + 1

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.bracket_antisymm
statement:
theorem IsBV.bracket_antisymm (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) :
    bracket μ Δ p x y = -σ R ((!p) && (!q)) • bracket μ Δ q y x

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.bracket_jacobi
statement:
theorem IsBV.bracket_jacobi (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) (z : V) :
    bracket μ Δ p x (bracket μ Δ q y z)
      = bracket μ Δ (!(xor p q)) (bracket μ Δ p x y) z
        + σ R ((!p) && (!q)) • bracket μ Δ q y (bracket μ Δ p x z)

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.bracket_mul_right
statement:
theorem IsBV.bracket_mul_right (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) (z : V) :
    bracket μ Δ p x (μ y z)
      = μ (bracket μ Δ p x y) z + σ R ((!p) && q) • μ y (bracket μ Δ p x z)

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.dev_comm
statement:
lemma IsBV.dev_comm (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) : dev μ Δ p x y = σ R (p && q) • dev μ Δ q y x

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.par_bracket
statement:
lemma IsBV.par_bracket (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) : IsPar ε (!(xor p q)) (bracket μ Δ p x y)

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.par_dev
statement:
lemma IsBV.par_dev (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) : IsPar ε (!(xor p q)) (dev μ Δ p x y)

name: Operad.GerBV.IsPar.add
statement:
lemma IsPar.add {p : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x) (hy : IsPar ε p y) :
    IsPar ε p (x + y)

name: Operad.GerBV.IsPar.smul
statement: lemma IsPar.smul {p : Bool} {x : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x) (c : R) : IsPar ε p (c • x)

name: Operad.GerBV.IsPar.sub
statement:
lemma IsPar.sub {p : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x) (hy : IsPar ε p y) :
    IsPar ε p (x - y)

name: Operad.GerBV.dev_jacobi
statement:
theorem dev_jacobi {H : Bool → V → Prop} (hΔ : ∀ x, Δ (Δ x) = 0)
    (hord : ∀ p q x y z, H p x → H q y →
      dev μ Δ p x (μ y z) = μ (dev μ Δ p x y) z + σ R ((!p) && q) • μ y (dev μ Δ p x z))
    (hpΔ : ∀ p x, H p x → H (!p) (Δ x)) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (z : V)
    (hx : H p x) (hy : H q y) :
    dev μ Δ p x (dev μ Δ q y z)
      = -σ R p • dev μ Δ (!(xor p q)) (dev μ Δ p x y) z
        - σ R (xor p ((!p) && q)) • dev μ Δ q y (dev μ Δ p x z)

name: Operad.GerBV.dev_smul_left
statement:
lemma dev_smul_left (p : Bool) (c : R) (x z : V) :
    dev μ Δ p (c • x) z = c • dev μ Δ p x z

name: Operad.GerBV.dev_smul_right
statement:
lemma dev_smul_right (p : Bool) (c : R) (x y : V) :
    dev μ Δ p x (c • y) = c • dev μ Δ p x y

name: Operad.GerBV.dev_sub_left
statement:
lemma dev_sub_left (p : Bool) (x y z : V) :
    dev μ Δ p (x - y) z = dev μ Δ p x z - dev μ Δ p y z

name: Operad.GerBV.dev_sub_right
statement:
lemma dev_sub_right (p : Bool) (x y z : V) :
    dev μ Δ p x (y - z) = dev μ Δ p x y - dev μ Δ p x z

name: Operad.GerBV.Δ_bracket
statement:
theorem Δ_bracket (hΔ : ∀ x, Δ (Δ x) = 0) (p : Bool) (x y : V) :
    Δ (bracket μ Δ p x y)
      = bracket μ Δ (!p) (Δ x) y + σ R (!p) • bracket μ Δ p x (Δ y)

name: Operad.GerBV.Δ_dev
statement:
lemma Δ_dev (hΔ : ∀ x, Δ (Δ x) = 0) (p : Bool) (x y : V) :
    Δ (dev μ Δ p x y) = -dev μ Δ (!p) (Δ x) y - σ R p • dev μ Δ p x (Δ y)

name: Operad.GerBV.σ_true
statement: @[simp] lemma σ_true : σ R true = -1

name: Operad.LInf.jac_two_of_ge

lemma jac_two_of_ge (d : End R V 1) (b : End R V 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (p : Fin n → Bool)

statement:
lemma jac_two_one (d : End R V 1) (b : End R V 2) (p : Fin 1 → Bool) (v : Fin 1 → V) :

name: Operad.LInf.jac_two_three
statement:
lemma jac_two_three (d : End R V 1) (b : End R V 2) (p : Fin 3 → Bool) (v : Fin 3 → V) :
    jac (two d b) p v =
      b ![b ![v 0, v 1], v 2] + σ R (p 2 && p 1) • b ![b ![v 0, v 2], v 1] +
        (σ R (p 1 && p 0) * σ R (p 2 && p 0)) • b ![b ![v 1, v 2], v 0]

name: Operad.LInf.jac_two_two
statement:
lemma jac_two_two (d : End R V 1) (b : End R V 2) (p : Fin 2 → Bool) (v : Fin 2 → V) :
    jac (two d b) p v =
      b ![d ![v 0], v 1] + σ R (p 1 && p 0) • b ![d ![v 1], v 0] + d ![b ![v 0, v 1]]

statement: lemma strictMono_fin_one {α : Type*} [Preorder α] (f : Fin 1 → α) : StrictMono f
