name: Operad.LInf.term_eq
statement:
lemma term_eq (ℓ : LFam R V) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → V) (S : Finset (Fin n)) {k m : ℕ}
    (hk : S.card = k) (hm : Sᶜ.card = m) :
    ℓ (Sᶜ.card + 1) (Fin.cons (ℓ S.card (restr v S)) (restr v Sᶜ)) =
      ℓ (m + 1) (Fin.cons (ℓ k fun a => v (S.orderEmbOfFin hk a))
        fun a => v (Sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin hm a))

name: Operad.LInf.two_of_ge
statement: lemma two_of_ge (d : End R V 1) (b : End R V 2) {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : two d b k = 0

name: Operad.LInf.two_one
statement: @[simp] lemma two_one (d : End R V 1) (b : End R V 2) : two d b 1 = d

name: Operad.LInf.two_one_add
statement: @[simp] lemma two_one_add (d : End R V 1) (b : End R V 2) : two d b (1 + 1) = b

name: Operad.LInf.two_smul_left
statement: lemma two_smul_left (β : End R V 2) (c : R) (x y : V) : β ![c • x, y] = c • β ![x, y]

name: Operad.LInf.two_smul_right
statement: lemma two_smul_right (β : End R V 2) (c : R) (x y : V) : β ![x, c • y] = c • β ![x, y]

name: Operad.LInf.two_two
statement: @[simp] lemma two_two (d : End R V 1) (b : End R V 2) : two d b 2 = b

name: Operad.LInf.two_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma two_zero (d : End R V 1) (b : End R V 2) : two d b 0 = 0

name: Operad.LInf.two_zero_add
statement: @[simp] lemma two_zero_add (d : End R V 1) (b : End R V 2) : two d b (0 + 1) = d

name: Operad.LInf.vec_one_eq
statement: lemma vec_one_eq (v : Fin 1 → V) : v = ![v 0]

name: Operad.LInf.vec_swap
statement: lemma vec_swap {x y : V} : ![x, y] ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1 = ![y, x]

name: Operad.LInf.vec_two_eq
statement: lemma vec_two_eq (v : Fin 2 → V) : v = ![v 0, v 1]

name: Operad.LInf.σ_mul
statement: lemma σ_mul (a b : Bool) : σ R a * σ R b = σ R (xor a b)

name: Operad.LInf.σ_mul_self
statement: lemma σ_mul_self (a : Bool) : σ R a * σ R a = 1

name: Operad.LInf.σ_not
statement: lemma σ_not (a : Bool) : σ R (!a) = -σ R a

name: Operad.CInf.isCInf_dga_iff
statement:
theorem isCInf_dga_iff {d : End R V 1} {μ : End R V 2} :
    IsCInf ε (dga R V d μ) ↔ IsAInf ε (dga R V d μ) ∧
      ∀ (x y : V) (px py : Bool), IsPar ε px x → IsPar ε py y →
        μ ![x, y] + σ R (px && py) • μ ![y, x] = 0

name: Operad.CInf.merge_of_mem
Operad.CInf.merge_of_not_mem
Operad.CInf.merge_one
statement:
lemma merge_one {X : Type*} (x y : Fin 1 → X) :
    merge (a := 1) (c := 1) {1} rfl x y = ![y 0, x 0]

name: Operad.CInf.merge_zero
statement:
lemma merge_zero {X : Type*} (x y : Fin 1 → X) :
    merge (a := 1) (c := 1) {0} rfl x y = ![x 0, y 0]

name: Operad.CInf.shuffle_two
statement:
lemma shuffle_two (b : Fam R V) (x y : V) (px py : Bool) :
    ∑ S : {S : Finset (Fin (0 + 1 + (0 + 1))) // S.card = 0 + 1},
      (usgn (merge S.1 S.2 ![px] ![py]) S.1 : R) •
        b (0 + 0 + 1) (merge S.1 S.2 ![x] ![y] ∘ Fin.cast (by omega))
      = b 1 ![x, y] + σ R (px && py) • b 1 ![y, x]

name: Operad.CInf.sum_two
statement:
lemma sum_two {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (F : {S : Finset (Fin (0 + 1 + (0 + 1))) // S.card = 0 + 1} → M) :
    ∑ S, F S = F ⟨{0}, rfl⟩ + F ⟨{1}, rfl⟩

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.compFun_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma compFun_inl [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] (i : A) (x : A → R) (y : B → R)
    (a : Without A i) :
    compFun i x y (Sum.inl a) = x a.1 * ∑ b, y b

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.compFun_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma compFun_inr [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] (i : A) (x : A → R) (y : B → R) (b : B) :
    compFun i x y (Sum.inr b) = x i * y b

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.compL_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compL_apply [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] (i : A) (x : A → R) (y : B → R) :
    compL i x y = compFun i x y

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.mapL_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma mapL_apply (e : A ≃ B) (x : A → R) (b : B) : mapL e x b = x (e.symm b)

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.sum_compFun
statement:
theorem sum_compFun [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] (i : A) (x : A → R) (y : B → R) :
    ∑ c, compFun i x y c = (∑ a, x a) * ∑ b, y b

name: Operad.Sym.com_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma com_comp (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (x : Com R A) (y : Com R B) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) (P := Com R) i x y = x * y

name: Operad.Sym.com_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma com_map (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B) (x : Com R A) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) (P := Com R) e x = x

name: Operad.Sym.com_one
statement: @[simp] lemma com_one (R : Type u) [CommRing R] : (SymOperad.one R : Com R Unit) = (1 : R)

name: Operad.Sym.compEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma compEquiv_inl (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (a : Without A i) :
    compEquiv σ τ i (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inl ⟨σ a.1, fun h => a.2 (σ.injective h)⟩

name: Operad.Sym.compEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma compEquiv_inr (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (b : B) :
    compEquiv σ τ i (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inr (τ b)

name: Operad.Sym.compEquiv_symm_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma compEquiv_symm_inl (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (a : Without A' (σ i)) :
    (compEquiv σ τ i).symm (Sum.inl a)
      = Sum.inl ⟨σ.symm a.1, fun h => a.2 (σ.symm_apply_eq.mp h)⟩

name: Operad.Sym.compEquiv_symm_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma compEquiv_symm_inr (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (b : B') :
    (compEquiv σ τ i).symm (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inr (τ.symm b)

name: Operad.Sym.leftUnitEquiv_inr
statement: @[simp] lemma leftUnitEquiv_inr (b : B) : leftUnitEquiv B (Sum.inr b) = b

name: Operad.Sym.leftUnitEquiv_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma leftUnitEquiv_symm_apply (b : B) : (leftUnitEquiv B).symm b = Sum.inr b

name: Operad.Sym.parEquiv_inl_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma parEquiv_inl_inl [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq D] {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k)
    (a : Without A i) (ha : (Sum.inl a : Without A i ⊕ B) ≠ Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) :
    parEquiv hik B D (Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inl a, ha⟩)
      = Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inl ⟨a.1, fun h => ha (by simp [Subtype.ext_iff, h])⟩, by
          simp [Subtype.ext_iff, a.2]⟩

name: Operad.Sym.parEquiv_inl_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma parEquiv_inl_inr [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq D] {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (b : B)
    (hb : (Sum.inr b : Without A i ⊕ B) ≠ Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) :
    parEquiv hik B D (Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr b, hb⟩) = Sum.inr b

name: Operad.Sym.parEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma parEquiv_inr [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq D] {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (d : D) :
    parEquiv hik B D (Sum.inr d) = Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr d, by simp⟩

name: Operad.Sym.parEquiv_symm_inl_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma parEquiv_symm_inl_inl [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq D] {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k)
    (a : Without A k) (ha : (Sum.inl a : Without A k ⊕ D) ≠ Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) :
    (parEquiv hik B D).symm (Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inl a, ha⟩)
      = Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inl ⟨a.1, fun h => ha (by simp [Subtype.ext_iff, h])⟩, by
          simp [Subtype.ext_iff, a.2]⟩

name: Operad.Sym.parEquiv_symm_inl_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma parEquiv_symm_inl_inr [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq D] {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k)
    (d : D) (hd : (Sum.inr d : Without A k ⊕ D) ≠ Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) :
    (parEquiv hik B D).symm (Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr d, hd⟩) = Sum.inr d

name: Operad.Sym.parEquiv_symm_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma parEquiv_symm_inr [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq D] {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (b : B) :
    (parEquiv hik B D).symm (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr b, by simp⟩

name: Operad.Sym.rightUnitEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma rightUnitEquiv_inl (i : A) (a : Without A i) :
    rightUnitEquiv i (Sum.inl a) = a.1

name: Operad.Sym.rightUnitEquiv_inr
statement: @[simp] lemma rightUnitEquiv_inr (i : A) (u : Unit) : rightUnitEquiv i (Sum.inr u) = i

name: Operad.Sym.rightUnitEquiv_symm_of_ne
statement:
lemma rightUnitEquiv_symm_of_ne {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] {i x : A} (h : x ≠ i) :
    (rightUnitEquiv i).symm x = Sum.inl ⟨x, h⟩

name: Operad.Sym.rightUnitEquiv_symm_self
statement:
lemma rightUnitEquiv_symm_self {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (i : A) :
    (rightUnitEquiv i).symm i = Sum.inr ()

name: Operad.Sym.seqEquiv_inl_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma seqEquiv_inl_inl [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (j : B) (a : Without A i) (h) :
    seqEquiv i j D (Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inl a, h⟩) = Sum.inl a

name: Operad.Sym.seqEquiv_inl_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma seqEquiv_inl_inr [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (j : B) (b : B) (hb) :
    seqEquiv i j D (Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr b, hb⟩)
      = Sum.inr (Sum.inl ⟨b, fun h => hb (congrArg Sum.inr h)⟩)

name: Operad.Sym.seqEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma seqEquiv_inr [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (j : B) (d : D) :
    seqEquiv i j D (Sum.inr d) = Sum.inr (Sum.inr d)

name: Operad.Sym.seqEquiv_symm_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma seqEquiv_symm_inl [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (j : B) (a : Without A i) :
    (seqEquiv i j D).symm (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inl a, by simp⟩

name: Operad.Sym.seqEquiv_symm_inr_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma seqEquiv_symm_inr_inl [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (j : B) (b : Without B j) :
    (seqEquiv i j D).symm (Sum.inr (Sum.inl b)) = Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr b.1, by simpa using b.2⟩

name: Operad.Sym.seqEquiv_symm_inr_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma seqEquiv_symm_inr_inr [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (j : B) (d : D) :
    (seqEquiv i j D).symm (Sum.inr (Sum.inr d)) = Sum.inr d

name: Operad.Sym.slotEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma slotEquiv_inl {A B : Type} [DecidableEq A] {i i' : A} (h : i = i')
    (a : Without A i) : slotEquiv (B := B) h (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inl ⟨a.1, h ▸ a.2⟩

name: Operad.Sym.slotEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma slotEquiv_inr {A B : Type} [DecidableEq A] {i i' : A} (h : i = i') (b : B) :
    slotEquiv (A := A) h (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inr b

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_one'
statement:
lemma comp_one' (i : A) (x : P A) :
    comp (R := R) i x (one R) = map (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv i).symm x

name: Operad.SymOperad.mapEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapEquiv_apply (e : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    mapEquiv (R := R) e x = map (R := R) e x

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_comp_inner
statement:
lemma map_comp_inner (τ : Equiv.Perm B) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    map (R := R) (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) τ i) (comp (R := R) i x y)
      = comp (R := R) i x (map (R := R) τ y)

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_comp_outer
statement:
lemma map_comp_outer (σ : Equiv.Perm A) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    map (R := R) (compEquiv σ (Equiv.refl B) i) (comp (R := R) i x y)
      = comp (R := R) (σ i) (map (R := R) σ x) y

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_injective
statement: lemma map_injective (e : A ≃ B) : Function.Injective (map (R := R) (P := P) e)

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_map
statement:
lemma map_map (e : A ≃ B) (f : B ≃ C) (x : P A) :
    map (R := R) f (map (R := R) e x) = map (R := R) (e.trans f) x

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_map_symm
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_map_symm (e : A ≃ B) (y : P B) :
    map (R := R) e (map (R := R) e.symm y) = y

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_refl'
statement: @[simp] lemma map_refl' (x : P A) : map (R := R) (Equiv.refl A) x = x

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_symm_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_symm_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    map (R := R) e.symm (map (R := R) e x) = x

name: Operad.SymOperad.one_comp'
statement:
lemma one_comp' (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) () (one R) y = map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv B).symm y

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.app_invOfBijective
statement:
lemma app_invOfBijective (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Function.Bijective (φ.app A))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : Q A) :
    φ.app A ((φ.invOfBijective h).app A y) = y

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.comp_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_app (ψ : SymOperadHom R Q S) (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (ψ.comp φ).app A x = ψ.app A (φ.app A x)

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.ext
Operad.SymOperadHom.invOfBijective_app
statement:
lemma invOfBijective_app (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Function.Bijective (φ.app A))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (φ.invOfBijective h).app A (φ.app A x) = x

name: Operad.Sym.EndOp.compML_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma EndOp.compML_apply (i : A) (f : EndOp R V A) (g : EndOp R V B)
    (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) :
    EndOp.compML R V i f g v = f (feed i v (g fun b => v (Sum.inr b)))

name: Operad.Sym.EndOp.mapL_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma EndOp.mapL_apply (e : A ≃ A') (f : EndOp R V A) (v : A' → V) :
    EndOp.mapL R V e f v = f fun a => v (e a)

name: Operad.Sym.EndOp.one_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma EndOp.one_apply (v : Unit → V) : EndOp.one R V v = v ()

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebra.act_comp
statement:
lemma SymAlgebra.act_comp (α : SymAlgebra R P V) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B)
    (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) :
    α.act (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y) v
      = α.act x (feed i v (α.act y fun b => v (Sum.inr b)))

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebra.act_map
statement:
lemma SymAlgebra.act_map (α : SymAlgebra R P V) (e : A ≃ A') (x : P A) (v : A' → V) :
    α.act (SymOperad.map (R := R) e x) v = α.act x fun a => v (e a)

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebra.act_one
statement:
lemma SymAlgebra.act_one (α : SymAlgebra R P V) (v : Unit → V) :
    α.act (SymOperad.one R) v = v ()

name: Operad.Sym.feed_eq_update
statement:
lemma feed_eq_update [Zero V] (i : A) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) :
    feed i v w = Function.update (feed i v 0) i w

name: Operad.Sym.feed_of_ne
statement:
lemma feed_of_ne {i a : A} (h : a ≠ i) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) :
    feed i v w a = v (Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩)

name: Operad.Sym.feed_self
statement: @[simp] lemma feed_self (i : A) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) : feed i v w i = w

name: Operad.Sym.feed_update_inl
statement:
lemma feed_update_inl (i : A) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) (a : Without A i) (z : V) :
    feed i (Function.update v (Sum.inl a) z) w = Function.update (feed i v w) a.1 z

name: Operad.Sym.feed_update_inr
statement:
lemma feed_update_inr (i : A) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) (b : B) (z : V) :
    feed i (Function.update v (Sum.inr b) z) w = feed i v w

name: Operad.Sym.feed_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma feed_val (i : A) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) (a : Without A i) :
    feed i v w a.1 = v (Sum.inl a)

name: Operad.ColEnd.map_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma ColEnd.map_apply {c : A → C} {c' : B → C} {d : C} (e : A ≃ B)
    (hc : ∀ a, c' (e a) = c a) (f : ColEnd R V A c d) (v : ∀ b, V (c' b)) :
    ColEnd.map R V e hc f v = f fun a => castV R V (hc a) (v (e a))

name: Operad.ColEnd.one_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma ColEnd.one_apply (c : C) (v : Unit → V c) : ColEnd.one R V c v = v ()

name: Operad.castV_castV
statement:
lemma castV_castV {c c' c'' : C} (h : c = c') (h' : c' = c'') (x : V c) :
    castV R V h' (castV R V h x) = castV R V (h.trans h') x

name: Operad.castV_self
statement: @[simp] lemma castV_self {c : C} (h : c = c) (x : V c) : castV R V h x = x

name: Operad.castV_update_comp
statement:
lemma castV_update_comp {c : A → C} {c' : B → C} (e : A ≃ B) (hc : ∀ a, c' (e a) = c a)
    (v : ∀ b, V (c' b)) (a₀ : A) (z : V (c' (e a₀))) :
    (fun a => castV R V (hc a) (Function.update v (e a₀) z (e a)))
      = Function.update (fun a => castV R V (hc a) (v (e a))) a₀ (castV R V (hc a₀) z)

name: Operad.cfeed_eq_update
statement:
lemma cfeed_eq_update (i : A) (h : d' = cA i)
    (v : ∀ z : Without A i ⊕ B, V (compColor cA i cB z)) (w : V d') :
    cfeed R i h v w = Function.update (cfeed R i h v 0) i (castV R V h w)

name: Operad.cfeed_of_ne
statement:
lemma cfeed_of_ne {i a : A} (ha : a ≠ i) (h : d' = cA i)
    (v : ∀ z : Without A i ⊕ B, V (compColor cA i cB z)) (w : V d') :
    cfeed R i h v w a = v (Sum.inl ⟨a, ha⟩)

name: Operad.cfeed_self
statement:
lemma cfeed_self (i : A) (h : d' = cA i) (v : ∀ z : Without A i ⊕ B, V (compColor cA i cB z))
    (w : V d') : cfeed R i h v w i = castV R V h w

name: Operad.cfeed_update_inr
statement:
lemma cfeed_update_inr (i : A) (h : d' = cA i)
    (v : ∀ z : Without A i ⊕ B, V (compColor cA i cB z)) (w : V d') (b : B) (z : V (cB b)) :
    cfeed R i h (Function.update v (Sum.inr b) z) w = cfeed R i h v w

name: Operad.Lin.compL_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma compL_single (i : A) (s : S A) (t : S B) (r r' : R) :
    compL R i (Finsupp.single s r) (Finsupp.single t r')
      = Finsupp.single (SetOperad.comp i s t) (r * r')

name: Operad.Lin.induction₁
statement:
lemma induction₁ {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f g : (S A →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M)
    (h : ∀ s, f (Finsupp.single s 1) = g (Finsupp.single s 1)) (x : S A →₀ R) : f x = g x

name: Operad.Lin.mapL_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapL_single (e : A ≃ B) (s : S A) (r : R) :
    mapL R e (Finsupp.single s r) = Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map e s) r

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_injective
statement: lemma map_injective (e : A ≃ B) : Function.Injective (map (S := S) e)

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_map_symm
statement: @[simp] lemma map_map_symm (e : A ≃ B) (y : S B) : map e (map e.symm y) = y

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_symm_map
statement: @[simp] lemma map_symm_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : S A) : map e.symm (map e x) = x

name: Operad.SetOperadHom.ext
Operad.SetOperadHom.lin_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma SetOperadHom.lin_single (φ : SetOperadHom S T) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (s : S A) (r : R) :
    (φ.lin R).app A (Finsupp.single s r) = Finsupp.single (φ.app A s) r

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.ext_single
Operad.Und.comp_eq
statement:
lemma Und.comp_eq (i : A) (x : Q A) (y : Q B) :
    SetOperad.comp i (Und.of R Q x) (Und.of R Q y)
      = Und.of R Q (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)

name: Operad.Und.map_eq
statement:
lemma Und.map_eq (e : A ≃ B) (x : Q A) :
    SetOperad.map e (Und.of R Q x) = Und.of R Q (SymOperad.map (R := R) e x)

name: Operad.Und.one_eq
statement: lemma Und.one_eq : (SetOperad.one : Und R Q Unit) = Und.of R Q (SymOperad.one R)

name: Operad.ComC.counit_eq
statement: @[simp] lemma counit_eq : SymCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := ComC R) = LinearMap.id

name: Operad.ComC.decomp_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma decomp_eq {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (i : A) : SymCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := ComC R) (B := B) i
      = (TensorProduct.lid R R).symm.toLinearMap

name: Operad.ComC.dualHom_bijective
statement:
theorem dualHom_bijective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Bijective ((dualHom R).app A)

name: Operad.ComC.map_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_eq {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) : SymCooperad.map (R := R) (C := ComC R) e = LinearMap.id

name: Operad.SymCooperad.dualComp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dualComp_apply (i : A) (f : Dual R C A) (g : Dual R C B)
    (c : C (Without A i ⊕ B)) : dualComp i f g c = pair f g (decomp (R := R) i c)

name: Operad.SymCooperad.dualMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dualMap_apply {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (f : Dual R C A) (c : C B) : dualMap e f c = f (map (R := R) e.symm c)

name: Operad.SymCooperad.dual_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dual_comp_apply (i : A) (f : Dual R C A) (g : Dual R C B)
    (c : C (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) (P := Dual R C) i f g c = pair f g (decomp (R := R) i c)

name: Operad.SymCooperad.dual_map_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dual_map_apply {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B) (f : Dual R C A) (c : C B) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) (P := Dual R C) e f c = f (map (R := R) e.symm c)

name: Operad.SymCooperad.dual_one
statement: lemma dual_one : SymOperad.one R (P := Dual R C) = counit

name: Operad.SymCooperad.map_map_symm
statement:
lemma map_map_symm {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (x : C B) : map (R := R) e (map (R := R) e.symm x) = x

name: Operad.SymCooperad.map_symm_map
statement:
lemma map_symm_map {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (x : C A) : map (R := R) e.symm (map (R := R) e x) = x

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_assoc
statement:
lemma pair_assoc {X Y Z : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y]
    [AddCommGroup Z] [Module R Z] (f : Module.Dual R X) (g : Module.Dual R Y)
    (h : Module.Dual R Z) :
    pair f (pair g h) ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.assoc R X Y Z).toLinearMap = pair (pair f g) h

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_comp_decomp
statement:
lemma pair_comp_decomp (i : A) (f : Dual R C A) (g : Dual R C B) :
    dualComp i f g = pair f g ∘ₗ decomp (R := R) i

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_comp_left
statement:
lemma pair_comp_left {X X' Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup X']
    [Module R X'] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y] (F : Module.Dual R X') (φ : X →ₗ[R] X')
    (G : Module.Dual R Y) : pair (F ∘ₗ φ) G = pair F G ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor Y φ

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_comp_right
statement:
lemma pair_comp_right {X Y Y' : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y]
    [Module R Y] [AddCommGroup Y'] [Module R Y'] (F : Module.Dual R X) (G : Module.Dual R Y')
    (ψ : Y →ₗ[R] Y') : pair F (G ∘ₗ ψ) = pair F G ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor X ψ

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_counit_left
statement:
lemma pair_counit_left {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y]
    (ε : Module.Dual R X) (g : Module.Dual R Y) :
    pair ε g = g ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.lid R Y).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor Y ε

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_counit_right
statement:
lemma pair_counit_right {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y]
    (f : Module.Dual R X) (ε : Module.Dual R Y) :
    pair f ε = f ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.rid R X).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor X ε

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_map
statement:
lemma pair_map {X Y X' Y' : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y]
    [AddCommGroup X'] [Module R X'] [AddCommGroup Y'] [Module R Y'] (f : Module.Dual R X')
    (g : Module.Dual R Y') (φ : X →ₗ[R] X') (ψ : Y →ₗ[R] Y') :
    pair f g ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map φ ψ = pair (f ∘ₗ φ) (g ∘ₗ ψ)

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_swapLast
statement:
lemma pair_swapLast {X Y Z : Type v} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y]
    [AddCommGroup Z] [Module R Z] (f : Module.Dual R X) (g : Module.Dual R Y)
    (h : Module.Dual R Z) :
    pair (pair f h) g ∘ₗ (swapLast R X Y Z).toLinearMap = pair (pair f g) h

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma pair_tmul {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y]
    [Module R Y] (f : Module.Dual R X) (g : Module.Dual R Y) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    pair f g (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) = f x * g y

name: Operad.Lin.coHomEquiv_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coHomEquiv_apply_apply (Φ : SymCooperadHom R C (Lin R S)) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (p : S A) (c : C A) : dualVal (coHomEquiv Φ).1 p c = Φ.app A c p

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_apply
statement:
lemma decompL_apply (i : A) (x : S (Without A i ⊕ B) →₀ R) (pq : S A × S B) :
    tens R (S A) (S B) (decompL R i x) pq = x (SetOperad.comp i pq.1 pq.2)

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_assoc_par
statement:
lemma decompL_assoc_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (S B →₀ R) (decompL (B := D) R k) ∘ₗ decompL R (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩)
      = (swapLast R (S A →₀ R) (S B →₀ R) (S D →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor (S D →₀ R) (decompL R i) ∘ₗ decompL R (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) ∘ₗ
            mapL R (parEquiv hik B D).symm

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma decompL_assoc_seq (i : A) (j : B) :
    LinearMap.lTensor (S A →₀ R) (decompL (B := D) R j) ∘ₗ decompL R i
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R (S A →₀ R) (S B →₀ R) (S D →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor (S D →₀ R) (decompL R i) ∘ₗ decompL R (Sum.inr j) ∘ₗ
            mapL R (seqEquiv i j D).symm

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_counit_left
statement:
lemma decompL_counit_left :
    (TensorProduct.lid R (S B →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.rTensor (S B →₀ R) (Finsupp.lapply SetOperad.one) ∘ₗ decompL R () ∘ₗ
          mapL R (leftUnitEquiv B).symm
      = LinearMap.id

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_counit_right
statement:
lemma decompL_counit_right (i : A) :
    (TensorProduct.rid R (S A →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.lTensor (S A →₀ R) (Finsupp.lapply SetOperad.one) ∘ₗ decompL (B := Unit) R i ∘ₗ
          mapL R (rightUnitEquiv i).symm
      = LinearMap.id

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_map
statement:
lemma decompL_map (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) :
    decompL R (σ i) ∘ₗ mapL R (compEquiv σ τ i)
      = TensorProduct.map (mapL R σ) (mapL R τ) ∘ₗ decompL (S := S) R i

name: Operad.Lin.dualVal_comp
statement:
lemma dualVal_comp (Ψ : SetOperadHom S (Und R (SymCooperad.Dual R C))) {A B : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (p : S A) (q : S B)
    (c : C (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    dualVal Ψ (SetOperad.comp i p q) c
      = SymCooperad.pair (dualVal Ψ p) (dualVal Ψ q) (SymCooperad.decomp (R := R) i c)

name: Operad.Lin.dualVal_map
statement:
lemma dualVal_map (Ψ : SetOperadHom S (Und R (SymCooperad.Dual R C))) {A B : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B) (p : S A) (c : C B) :
    dualVal Ψ (SetOperad.map e p) c = dualVal Ψ p (SymCooperad.map (R := R) e.symm c)

name: Operad.Lin.dualVal_one
statement:
lemma dualVal_one (Ψ : SetOperadHom S (Und R (SymCooperad.Dual R C))) (c : C Unit) :
    dualVal Ψ SetOperad.one c = SymCooperad.counit (R := R) c

name: Operad.Lin.dualVal_transpose
statement:
@[simp] lemma dualVal_transpose (Φ : SymCooperadHom R C (Lin R S)) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (p : S A) (c : C A) : dualVal (transpose Φ) p c = Φ.app A c p

name: Operad.Lin.mapL_apply
statement:
lemma mapL_apply (e : A ≃ B) (x : S A →₀ R) (y : S B) :
    mapL R e x y = x (SetOperad.map e.symm y)

name: Operad.Lin.ofTranspose_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofTranspose_apply (Ψ : SetOperadHom S (Und R (SymCooperad.Dual R C)))
    (hΨ : LocallyFinite Ψ) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A) (p : S A) :
    (ofTranspose Ψ hΨ).app A c p = dualVal Ψ p c

name: Operad.Lin.transpose_locallyFinite
statement:
lemma transpose_locallyFinite (Φ : SymCooperadHom R C (Lin R S)) :
    LocallyFinite (transpose Φ)

name: Operad.SymCooperadHom.ext
Operad.finComap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma finComap_apply {X Y : Type*} (c : X → Y) (hc : ∀ y, (c ⁻¹' {y}).Finite)
    (x : Y →₀ R) (a : X) : finComap c hc x a = x (c a)

name: Operad.finite_preimage_of_injective
statement:
lemma finite_preimage_of_injective {X Y : Type*} {c : X → Y} (hc : Function.Injective c) (y : Y) :
    (c ⁻¹' {y}).Finite

name: Operad.lid_rTensor_lapply
statement:
lemma lid_rTensor_lapply {Y U : Type*} (u : U) (t : (U →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) (b : Y) :
    TensorProduct.lid R (Y →₀ R) (LinearMap.rTensor (Y →₀ R) (Finsupp.lapply u) t) b
      = tens R U Y t (u, b)

name: Operad.rid_lTensor_lapply
statement:
lemma rid_lTensor_lapply {X U : Type*} (u : U) (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (U →₀ R)) (a : X) :
    TensorProduct.rid R (X →₀ R) (LinearMap.lTensor (X →₀ R) (Finsupp.lapply u) t) a
      = tens R X U t (a, u)

name: Operad.tens3'_rTensor
statement:
lemma tens3'_rTensor {X X₁ X₂ Z : Type*} (g : (X →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X₁ →₀ R) ⊗[R] (X₂ →₀ R))
    (c : X₁ × X₂ → X) (hg : ∀ x p, tens R X₁ X₂ (g x) p = x (c p))
    (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Z →₀ R)) (p : X₁ × X₂) (d : Z) :
    tens3' R X₁ X₂ Z (LinearMap.rTensor (Z →₀ R) g t) (p, d) = tens R X Z t (c p, d)

name: Operad.tens3'_swapLast
statement:
lemma tens3'_swapLast {X Y Z : Type w} (t : ((X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) ⊗[R] (Z →₀ R)) (a : X)
    (b : Y) (d : Z) :
    tens3' R X Z Y (swapLast R _ _ _ t) ((a, d), b) = tens3' R X Y Z t ((a, b), d)

name: Operad.tens3'_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma tens3'_tmul_apply {X Y Z : Type*} (x : X →₀ R) (y : Y →₀ R) (z : Z →₀ R) (a : X)
    (b : Y) (d : Z) : tens3' R X Y Z ((x ⊗ₜ y) ⊗ₜ z) ((a, b), d) = x a * y b * z d

name: Operad.tens3_assoc
statement:
lemma tens3_assoc {X Y Z : Type*} (t : ((X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) ⊗[R] (Z →₀ R)) (a : X) (b : Y)
    (d : Z) :
    tens3 R X Y Z (TensorProduct.assoc R _ _ _ t) (a, (b, d)) = tens3' R X Y Z t ((a, b), d)

name: Operad.tens3_lTensor
statement:
lemma tens3_lTensor {X Y Y₁ Y₂ : Type*} (g : (Y →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (Y₁ →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y₂ →₀ R))
    (c : Y₁ × Y₂ → Y) (hg : ∀ y p, tens R Y₁ Y₂ (g y) p = y (c p))
    (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) (a : X) (p : Y₁ × Y₂) :
    tens3 R X Y₁ Y₂ (LinearMap.lTensor (X →₀ R) g t) (a, p) = tens R X Y t (a, c p)

name: Operad.tens3_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma tens3_tmul_apply {X Y Z : Type*} (x : X →₀ R) (y : Y →₀ R) (z : Z →₀ R) (a : X)
    (b : Y) (d : Z) : tens3 R X Y Z (x ⊗ₜ (y ⊗ₜ z)) (a, (b, d)) = x a * (y b * z d)

name: Operad.tens_apply_eq_pair
statement:
lemma tens_apply_eq_pair {X Y : Type*} (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) (a : X) (b : Y) :
    tens R X Y t (a, b) = SymCooperad.pair (Finsupp.lapply a) (Finsupp.lapply b) t

name: Operad.tens_map
statement:
lemma tens_map {X X' Y Y' : Type*} (f : (X →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X' →₀ R)) (g : (Y →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (Y' →₀ R))
    (cf : X' → X) (cg : Y' → Y) (hf : ∀ x a, f x a = x (cf a)) (hg : ∀ y b, g y b = y (cg b))
    (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) (a : X') (b : Y') :
    tens R X' Y' (TensorProduct.map f g t) (a, b) = tens R X Y t (cf a, cg b)

name: Operad.tens_tmul_apply
statement:
lemma tens_tmul_apply {X Y : Type*} (x : X →₀ R) (y : Y →₀ R) (a : X) (b : Y) :
    tens R X Y (x ⊗ₜ y) (a, b) = x a * y b

name: Operad.Lin.conilpotent
statement: theorem conilpotent : Conilpotent R (Lin R S)

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_mem
statement:
lemma decompL_mem (i : A) (x : S (Without A i ⊕ B) →₀ R)
    (P : Submodule R ((S A →₀ R) ⊗[R] (S B →₀ R)))
    (h : ∀ p q, x (SetOperad.comp i p q) ≠ 0 →
      Finsupp.single p (1 : R) ⊗ₜ Finsupp.single q (1 : R) ∈ P) :
    decompL R i x ∈ P

name: Operad.Lin.one_eq
statement: lemma one_eq : Coaug.one (R := R) (C := Lin R S) = Finsupp.single SetOperad.one 1

name: Operad.Lin.single_mem_filt
statement: theorem single_mem_filt (t : S A) : Finsupp.single t (1 : R) ∈ filt R (Lin R S) (w t) A

name: Operad.Lin.single_unit_mem
statement:
lemma single_unit_mem (one : S Unit →₀ R) (hone : one = Finsupp.single SetOperad.one 1)
    (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one : S A) (1 : R)
      ∈ unitSpan R (Lin R S) one A

name: Operad.SetOperad.ConnectedWeight.w_comp
statement: lemma w_comp (i : A) (p : S A) (q : S B) : w (SetOperad.comp i p q) = w p + w q

name: Operad.SetOperad.ConnectedWeight.w_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma w_eq_zero_iff (t : S A) : w t = 0 ↔ ∃ e : Unit ≃ A, t = SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one

name: Operad.SetOperad.ConnectedWeight.w_map
statement: lemma w_map (e : A ≃ B) (t : S A) : w (SetOperad.map e t) = w t

name: Operad.SetOperad.ConnectedWeight.w_one
statement: lemma w_one : w (SetOperad.one : S Unit) = 0

name: Operad.SymCooperad.coaugSpan_le_filt
statement:
lemma coaugSpan_le_filt (n : ℕ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    coaugSpan R C A ≤ filt R C n A

name: Operad.SymCooperad.decomp_mem_coaugSpan
Operad.SymCooperad.filtTarget_mono
Operad.SymCooperad.filt_le_filt
statement:
lemma filt_le_filt {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    filt R C m A ≤ filt R C n A

name: Operad.SymCooperad.filt_mono
statement:
lemma filt_mono (n : ℕ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    filt R C n A ≤ filt R C (n + 1) A

name: Operad.SymCooperad.filt_zero
statement: lemma filt_zero : filt R C 0 A = coaugSpan R C A

name: Operad.SymCooperad.map_mem_filt
statement:
lemma map_mem_filt (n : ℕ) (e : A ≃ A') {c : C A} (hc : c ∈ filt R C n A) :
    map (R := R) e c ∈ filt R C n A'

name: Operad.SymCooperad.map_mem_unitSpan
statement:
lemma map_mem_unitSpan (one : C Unit) (e : A ≃ A') {c : C A} (hc : c ∈ unitSpan R C one A) :
    map (R := R) e c ∈ unitSpan R C one A'

name: Operad.SymCooperad.mem_filt_succ
statement:
lemma mem_filt_succ {n : ℕ} {c : C A} :
    c ∈ filt R C (n + 1) A ↔ ∀ (B D : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] [Fintype D]
      [DecidableEq D] (i : B) (e : Without B i ⊕ D ≃ A),
      decomp (R := R) i (map (R := R) e.symm c) ∈ filtTarget R C (filt R C n) B D

name: Operad.Conv.bracket_add_left
statement:
theorem bracket_add_left (f₁ f₂ g : Conv R C P) :
    bracket (f₁ + f₂) g = bracket f₁ g + bracket f₂ g

name: Operad.Conv.bracket_add_right
statement:
theorem bracket_add_right (f g₁ g₂ : Conv R C P) :
    bracket f (g₁ + g₂) = bracket f g₁ + bracket f g₂

name: Operad.Conv.bracket_antisymm
statement: theorem bracket_antisymm (f g : Conv R C P) : bracket f g = - bracket g f

name: Operad.Conv.bracket_self
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_self (f : Conv R C P) : bracket f f = 0

name: Operad.Conv.compT_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma compT_tmul (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    compT (R := R) a b (α ⊗ₜ[R] β) = NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b α β

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_add_left
statement:
lemma convTerm_add_left (f₁ f₂ g : Conv R C P) (m a n b : ℕ) :
    convTerm (f₁ + f₂) g m a n b = convTerm f₁ g m a n b + convTerm f₂ g m a n b

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_add_right
statement:
lemma convTerm_add_right (f g₁ g₂ : Conv R C P) (m a n b : ℕ) :
    convTerm f (g₁ + g₂) m a n b = convTerm f g₁ m a n b + convTerm f g₂ m a n b

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_ass
statement:
theorem convTerm_ass (f g : Conv R (Ass R) (Ass R)) {m a n b : ℕ} (h : a + n + b = m) (x : R) :
    convTerm f g m a n b x = f (a + 1 + b) x * g n 1

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_of_eq
statement:
lemma convTerm_of_eq (f g : Conv R C P) {m a n b : ℕ} (h : a + n + b = m) :
    convTerm f g m a n b
      = (reindex R P h).toLinearMap ∘ₗ compT a b ∘ₗ
          TensorProduct.map (f (a + 1 + b)) (g n) ∘ₗ NSCooperad.decomp a b n ∘ₗ
          (reindex R C h.symm).toLinearMap

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_of_ne
statement:
lemma convTerm_of_ne (f g : Conv R C P) {m a n b : ℕ} (h : a + n + b ≠ m) :
    convTerm f g m a n b = 0

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_smul_left
statement:
lemma convTerm_smul_left (r : R) (f g : Conv R C P) (m a n b : ℕ) :
    convTerm (r • f) g m a n b = r • convTerm f g m a n b

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_smul_right
statement:
lemma convTerm_smul_right (r : R) (f g : Conv R C P) (m a n b : ℕ) :
    convTerm f (r • g) m a n b = r • convTerm f g m a n b

name: Operad.Conv.star_add_left
statement: theorem star_add_left (f₁ f₂ g : Conv R C P) : (f₁ + f₂) ⋆c g = f₁ ⋆c g + f₂ ⋆c g

name: Operad.Conv.star_add_right
statement: theorem star_add_right (f g₁ g₂ : Conv R C P) : f ⋆c (g₁ + g₂) = f ⋆c g₁ + f ⋆c g₂

name: Operad.Conv.star_apply
statement:
lemma star_apply (f g : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    (f ⋆c g) m = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), convTerm f g m a n b

name: Operad.Conv.star_smul_left
statement: theorem star_smul_left (r : R) (f g : Conv R C P) : (r • f) ⋆c g = r • (f ⋆c g)

name: Operad.Conv.star_smul_right
statement: theorem star_smul_right (r : R) (f g : Conv R C P) : f ⋆c (r • g) = r • (f ⋆c g)

name: Operad.Conv.star_zero_left
statement: @[simp] theorem star_zero_left (g : Conv R C P) : (0 : Conv R C P) ⋆c g = 0

name: Operad.Conv.star_zero_right
statement: @[simp] theorem star_zero_right (f : Conv R C P) : f ⋆c (0 : Conv R C P) = 0

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_add_left
statement:
lemma commutator_add_left (x x' y : L) :
    commutator (x + x') y = commutator x y + commutator x' y

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_add_right
statement:
lemma commutator_add_right (x y y' : L) :
    commutator x (y + y') = commutator x y + commutator x y'

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_antisymm
statement: lemma commutator_antisymm (x y : L) : commutator x y = -commutator y x

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_def
statement: lemma commutator_def (x y : L) : commutator x y = x * y - y * x

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_neg_right
statement: lemma commutator_neg_right (x y : L) : commutator x (-y) = -commutator x y

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_self
statement: @[simp] lemma commutator_self (x : L) : commutator x x = 0

name: RightPreLieRing.jacobi
statement:
theorem jacobi (x y z : L) :
    commutator (commutator x y) z + commutator (commutator y z) x
        + commutator (commutator z x) y = 0

name: Operad.Conv.apply_reindex
statement:
lemma apply_reindex (f : Conv R C P) {k k' : ℕ} (e : k = k') (x : C k) :
    f k' (reindex R C e x) = reindex R P e (f k x)

name: Operad.Conv.associator_eq
statement:
lemma associator_eq (f g h : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    ((f ⋆c g) ⋆c h) m - (f ⋆c (g ⋆c h)) m = beforePart f g h m + afterPart f g h m

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_eq_cterm
statement:
lemma convTerm_eq_cterm (f g : Conv R C P) (m a n b : ℕ) :
    convTerm f g m a n b = cterm m a b n (f (a + 1 + b)) (g n)

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_add_left
statement:
lemma cterm_add_left (m a b n : ℕ) (φ₁ φ₂ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b))
    (ψ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) :
    cterm m a b n (φ₁ + φ₂) ψ = cterm m a b n φ₁ ψ + cterm m a b n φ₂ ψ

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_add_right
statement:
lemma cterm_add_right (m a b n : ℕ) (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b))
    (ψ₁ ψ₂ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) :
    cterm m a b n φ (ψ₁ + ψ₂) = cterm m a b n φ ψ₁ + cterm m a b n φ ψ₂

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_of_eq
statement:
lemma cterm_of_eq {m a b n : ℕ} (h : a + n + b = m) (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b))
    (ψ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) :
    cterm m a b n φ ψ
      = (reindex R P h).toLinearMap ∘ₗ compT a b ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map φ ψ ∘ₗ
          NSCooperad.decomp a b n ∘ₗ (reindex R C h.symm).toLinearMap

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_of_ne
statement:
lemma cterm_of_ne {m a b n : ℕ} (h : a + n + b ≠ m) (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b))
    (ψ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) : cterm m a b n φ ψ = 0

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_sum_left
statement:
lemma cterm_sum_left {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (m a b n : ℕ)
    (φ : ι → (C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b))) (ψ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) :
    cterm m a b n (∑ i ∈ s, φ i) ψ = ∑ i ∈ s, cterm m a b n (φ i) ψ

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_sum_right
statement:
lemma cterm_sum_right {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (m a b n : ℕ)
    (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b)) (ψ : ι → (C n →ₗ[R] P n)) :
    cterm m a b n φ (∑ i ∈ s, ψ i) = ∑ i ∈ s, cterm m a b n φ (ψ i)

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_zero_left
statement:
lemma cterm_zero_left (m a b n : ℕ) (ψ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) :
    cterm m a b n (0 : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b)) ψ = 0

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_zero_right
statement:
lemma cterm_zero_right (m a b n : ℕ) (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b)) :
    cterm m a b n φ (0 : C n →ₗ[R] P n) = 0

name: Operad.Conv.mem_decomps
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_decomps {m : ℕ} {x : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ} :
    x ∈ decomps m ↔ x.1 + x.2.1 + x.2.2 = m

name: Operad.Conv.nested_term
statement:
theorem nested_term {a b c d p : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (hm : a + (c + p + d) + b = m)
    (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b)) (χ : C (c + 1 + d) →ₗ[R] P (c + 1 + d))
    (ψ : C p →ₗ[R] P p) :
    cterm m (a + c) (d + b) p (cterm (a + c + 1 + (d + b)) a b (c + 1 + d) φ χ) ψ
      = cterm m a b (c + p + d) φ (cterm (c + p + d) c d p χ ψ)

name: Operad.Conv.nested_term'
statement:
theorem nested_term' (f g h : Conv R C P) (m a b c d p A N B A' N' B' A₂ N₂ B₂ C₂ P₂ D₂ : ℕ)
    (hA : A = a + c) (hN : N = p) (hB : B = d + b) (hA' : A' = a) (hN' : N' = c + 1 + d)
    (hB' : B' = b) (hA₂ : A₂ = a) (hN₂ : N₂ = c + p + d) (hB₂ : B₂ = b) (hC₂ : C₂ = c)
    (hP₂ : P₂ = p) (hD₂ : D₂ = d) (hm : a + (c + p + d) + b = m) :
    lterm f g h m (A, N, B) (A', N', B') = rterm f g h m (A₂, N₂, B₂) (C₂, P₂, D₂)

name: Operad.Conv.parallel_term
statement:
theorem parallel_term (f : Conv R C P) {a b c n p : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (hm : a + n + b + p + c = m)
    (X : C n →ₗ[R] P n) (Y : C p →ₗ[R] P p) :
    cterm m (a + n + b) c p
        (cterm (a + n + b + 1 + c) a (b + 1 + c) n (f (a + 1 + (b + 1 + c))) X) Y
      = cterm m a (b + p + c) n
          (cterm (a + 1 + (b + p + c)) (a + 1 + b) c p (f (a + 1 + b + 1 + c)) Y) X

name: Operad.Conv.parallel_term'
statement:
theorem parallel_term' (f g h : Conv R C P)
    (m a b c n p A N B A' N' B' A₂ N₂ B₂ A₂' N₂' B₂' : ℕ)
    (hA : A = a + n + b) (hN : N = p) (hB : B = c) (hA' : A' = a) (hN' : N' = n)
    (hB' : B' = b + 1 + c) (hA₂ : A₂ = a) (hN₂ : N₂ = n) (hB₂ : B₂ = b + p + c)
    (hA₂' : A₂' = a + 1 + b) (hN₂' : N₂' = p) (hB₂' : B₂' = c) (hm : a + n + b + p + c = m) :
    lterm f g h m (A, N, B) (A', N', B') = lterm f h g m (A₂, N₂, B₂) (A₂', N₂', B₂')

name: Operad.Conv.reindex_toLinearMap_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma reindex_toLinearMap_self {Q : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, AddCommGroup (Q n)]
    [∀ n, Module R (Q n)] {n : ℕ} (h : n = n) :
    (reindex R Q h).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id

name: Operad.Conv.star_assoc_symm
statement:
theorem star_assoc_symm (f g h : Conv R C P) :
    (f ⋆c g) ⋆c h - f ⋆c (g ⋆c h) = (f ⋆c h) ⋆c g - f ⋆c (h ⋆c g)

name: Operad.Conv.star_eq_sum
statement:
lemma star_eq_sum (f g : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    (f ⋆c g) m = ∑ x ∈ decomps m, cterm m x.1 x.2.2 x.2.1 (f (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2)) (g x.2.1)

name: Operad.Conv.star_star_left_eq
statement:
lemma star_star_left_eq (f g h : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    ((f ⋆c g) ⋆c h) m
      = ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ decomps (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2), lterm f g h m x y

name: Operad.Conv.star_star_right_eq
statement:
lemma star_star_right_eq (f g h : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    (f ⋆c (g ⋆c h)) m = ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ decomps x.2.1, rterm f g h m x y

name: Operad.Conv.sum_after_eq_sum_before
statement:
lemma sum_after_eq_sum_before (f g h : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ (decomps (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2)).filter (fun y => y.1 + y.2.1 ≤ x.1),
        lterm f g h m x y
      = ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ (decomps (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2)).filter (fun y => x.1 < y.1),
          lterm f h g m x y

name: Operad.Conv.sum_nested
statement:
lemma sum_nested (f g h : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ (decomps (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2)).filter
        (fun y => y.1 ≤ x.1 ∧ x.1 < y.1 + y.2.1), lterm f g h m x y
      = ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ decomps x.2.1, rterm f g h m x y

name: Operad.Conv.sum_split3
statement:
lemma sum_split3 {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (x : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ))
    (F : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → M) :
    ∑ y ∈ s, F y
      = ∑ y ∈ s.filter (fun y => y.1 ≤ x.1 ∧ x.1 < y.1 + y.2.1), F y
        + ∑ y ∈ s.filter (fun y => x.1 < y.1), F y
        + ∑ y ∈ s.filter (fun y => y.1 + y.2.1 ≤ x.1), F y

name: Operad.Contraction.pA_eq_left
statement: lemma pA_eq_left (v : V) : pA δ κ v = δ v + δ (c.h (pA δ κ v))

name: Operad.Contraction.pA_eq_right
statement: lemma pA_eq_right (v : V) : pA δ κ v = δ v + pA δ κ (c.h (δ v))

name: Operad.Contraction.perturb_dW_dW
statement:
theorem perturb_dW_dW (hdW : ∀ w, dW (dW w) = 0) (w : W) :
    (dW + c.π ∘ₗ pA δ κ ∘ₗ c.ι) ((dW + c.π ∘ₗ pA δ κ ∘ₗ c.ι) w) = 0

name: Operad.Contraction.perturb_key
statement:
theorem perturb_key (v : V) :
    dV (pA δ κ v) + pA δ κ (dV v) + pA δ κ (c.ι (c.π (pA δ κ v))) = 0

name: Operad.Homology.map_comp
statement:
lemma map_comp {dV : V →ₗ[R] V} {dW : W →ₗ[R] W} {dU : U →ₗ[R] U} (f : V →ₗ[R] W)
    (hf : ∀ v, f (dV v) = dW (f v)) (g : W →ₗ[R] U) (hg : ∀ w, g (dW w) = dU (g w)) :
    map (g ∘ₗ f) (fun v => by simp [hf, hg]) = map g hg ∘ₗ map f hf

name: Operad.Homology.map_eq_of_homotopy
statement:
theorem map_eq_of_homotopy {dV : V →ₗ[R] V} {dW : W →ₗ[R] W} (f g : V →ₗ[R] W)
    (hf : ∀ v, f (dV v) = dW (f v)) (hg : ∀ v, g (dV v) = dW (g v)) (s : V →ₗ[R] W)
    (hs : ∀ v, f v - g v = dW (s v) + s (dV v)) : map f hf = map g hg

name: Operad.Homology.map_id
statement: lemma map_id (dV : V →ₗ[R] V) : map (dV := dV) LinearMap.id (fun _ => rfl) = LinearMap.id

name: Operad.Homology.map_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_mk {dV : V →ₗ[R] V} {dW : W →ₗ[R] W} (f : V →ₗ[R] W)
    (hf : ∀ v, f (dV v) = dW (f v)) (z : LinearMap.ker dV) :
    map f hf (mk dV z) = mk dW (cycleMap f hf z)

name: Operad.Homology.mk_boundary
statement:
lemma mk_boundary {d : V →ₗ[R] V} (hd : ∀ v, d (d v) = 0) (v : V) :
    mk d ⟨d v, hd v⟩ = 0

name: Operad.Homology.mk_eq_mk_iff
statement:
lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {d : V →ₗ[R] V} (z z' : LinearMap.ker d) :
    mk d z = mk d z' ↔ ∃ v, d v = z.1 - z'.1

name: Operad.Homology.mk_surjective
statement: lemma mk_surjective (d : V →ₗ[R] V) : Function.Surjective (mk d)

name: Operad.DGOperad.cls_congr
statement:
lemma cls_congr {x x' : P A} (h : x = x') (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) (hx' : 𝐝 x' = 0) :
    cls x hx = cls x' hx'

name: Operad.DGOperad.comp_boundary_left
statement:
lemma comp_boundary_left (i : A) (w : P A) {y : P B} (hy : 𝐝 y = 0) :
    𝐜 i (𝐝 w) y = 𝐝 (𝐜 i w y)

name: Operad.DGOperad.comp_boundary_right
statement:
lemma comp_boundary_right (i : A) {x : P A} (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) (w : P B) :
    𝐜 i x (𝐝 w) = 𝐝 (𝐜 i (𝐩 false x - 𝐩 true x) w)

name: Operad.DGOperad.comp_cycle
statement:
lemma comp_cycle (i : A) {x : P A} {y : P B} (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) (hy : 𝐝 y = 0) :
    𝐝 (𝐜 i x y) = 0

name: Operad.DGOperad.d_eps
statement: lemma d_eps (x : P A) : 𝐝 (𝐩 false x - 𝐩 true x) = -(𝐩 false (𝐝 x) - 𝐩 true (𝐝 x))

name: Operad.DGOperad.eps_eps
statement:
lemma eps_eps (x : P A) :
    𝐩 false (𝐩 false x - 𝐩 true x) - 𝐩 true (𝐩 false x - 𝐩 true x) = x

name: Operad.DGOperad.exists_cls
statement: lemma exists_cls (X : HomologyOp R P A) : ∃ (x : P A) (hx : 𝐝 x = 0), cls x hx = X

name: Operad.DayMonoid.tensor_ext
Operad.DayMonoid.η_associator
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_associator (F G H : C ⊛⥤ V) (x y z : C) :
    ηa F G x y ▷ H.functor.obj z ≫ ηa (F ⊗ G) H (x ⊗ y) z ≫
        (α_ F G H).hom.natTrans.app ((x ⊗ y) ⊗ z) =
      (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ (F.functor.obj x ◁ ηa G H y z) ≫
        ηa F (G ⊗ H) x (y ⊗ z) ≫ (F ⊗ G ⊗ H).functor.map (α_ x y z).inv

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_naturality_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_naturality_left (F G : C ⊛⥤ V) (x : C) {y y' : C} (g : y ⟶ y') :
    F.functor.obj x ◁ G.functor.map g ≫ ηa F G x y' =
      ηa F G x y ≫ (F ⊗ G).functor.map (x ◁ g)

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_naturality_right (F G : C ⊛⥤ V) {x x' : C} (f : x ⟶ x') (y : C) :
    F.functor.map f ▷ G.functor.obj y ≫ ηa F G x' y =
      ηa F G x y ≫ (F ⊗ G).functor.map (f ▷ y)

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_tensorHom
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_tensorHom {F F' G G' : C ⊛⥤ V} (f : F ⟶ F') (g : G ⟶ G') (x y : C) :
    ηa F G x y ≫ (f ⊗ₘ g).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) =
      (f.natTrans.app x ⊗ₘ g.natTrans.app y) ≫ ηa F' G' x y

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_whiskerLeft
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_whiskerLeft (F : C ⊛⥤ V) {G G' : C ⊛⥤ V} (g : G ⟶ G') (x y : C) :
    ηa F G x y ≫ (F ◁ g).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) =
      (F.functor.obj x ◁ g.natTrans.app y) ≫ ηa F G' x y

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_whiskerRight {F F' : C ⊛⥤ V} (f : F ⟶ F') (G : C ⊛⥤ V) (x y : C) :
    ηa F G x y ≫ (f ▷ G).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) =
      (f.natTrans.app x ▷ G.functor.obj y) ≫ ηa F' G x y

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ηa_tensorDesc
statement:
lemma ηa_tensorDesc {F G H : C ⊛⥤ V} (α : F.functor ⊠ G.functor ⟶ tensor C ⋙ H.functor)
    (x y : C) : ηa F G x y ≫ (tensorDesc α).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) = α.app (x, y)

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ν_leftUnitor
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ν_leftUnitor (F : C ⊛⥤ V) (y : C) :
    ν C V ▷ F.functor.obj y ≫ ηa (𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V)) F (𝟙_ C) y ≫
        (λ_ F).hom.natTrans.app (𝟙_ C ⊗ y) =
      (λ_ (F.functor.obj y)).hom ≫ F.functor.map (λ_ y).inv

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ν_rightUnitor
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ν_rightUnitor (F : C ⊛⥤ V) (y : C) :
    F.functor.obj y ◁ ν C V ≫ ηa F (𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V)) y (𝟙_ C) ≫
        (ρ_ F).hom.natTrans.app (y ⊗ 𝟙_ C) =
      (ρ_ (F.functor.obj y)).hom ≫ F.functor.map (ρ_ y).inv

name: Operad.DayMonoid.isCommDay_iff
statement:
theorem isCommDay_iff (F : C ⊛⥤ V) [MonObj F] :
    IsCommDay F ↔ ∀ x y : C,
      μF F x y ≫ F.functor.map (β_ x y).hom = (β_ _ _).hom ≫ μF F y x

name: Operad.DayMonoid.isMonHom_iff
statement:
theorem isMonHom_iff {M N : C ⊛⥤ V} [MonObj M] [MonObj N] (f : M ⟶ N) :
    IsMonHom f ↔ @NatTrans.IsMonoidal _ _ _ _ _ _ M.functor N.functor f.natTrans
      (laxMonoidalOfMonObj M) (laxMonoidalOfMonObj N)

name: Operad.DayMonoid.laxMonoidal_ext
Operad.DayMonoid.monObj_ext
Operad.DayMonoid.mul_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma mul_naturality {a b : C} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (F ⊗ F).functor.map f ≫ (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.app b =
      (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.app a ≫ F.functor.map f

name: Operad.DayMonoid.mul_oneL
statement: lemma mul_oneL : F ◁ oneL F ≫ mulL F = (ρ_ F).hom

name: Operad.DayMonoid.oneL_mul
statement: lemma oneL_mul : oneL F ▷ F ≫ mulL F = (λ_ F).hom

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ηa_dayBraiding
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ηa_dayBraiding (F : C ⊛⥤ V) (x y : C) :
    ηa F F x y ≫ (dayBraiding F).hom.app (x ⊗ y) =
      (β_ _ _).hom ≫ ηa F F y x ≫ (F ⊗ F).functor.map (β_ y x).hom

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ηa_dayBraiding_mul
statement:
lemma ηa_dayBraiding_mul (F : C ⊛⥤ V) [MonObj F] (x y : C) :
    ηa F F x y ≫ (dayBraiding F).hom.app (x ⊗ y) ≫
        (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) =
      (β_ _ _).hom ≫ μF F y x ≫ F.functor.map (β_ y x).hom

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ηa_mulL
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ηa_mulL (x y : C) :
    ηa F F x y ≫ (mulL F).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) = Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F.functor x y

name: Operad.DayMonoid.μF_assoc
statement:
lemma μF_assoc (x y z : C) :
    μF F x y ▷ F.functor.obj z ≫ μF F (x ⊗ y) z ≫ F.functor.map (α_ x y z).hom =
      (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ F.functor.obj x ◁ μF F y z ≫ μF F x (y ⊗ z)

name: Operad.DayMonoid.μF_left_unitality
statement:
lemma μF_left_unitality (y : C) :

name: Operad.STree.exists_get?_leaf
statement:
theorem exists_get?_leaf : ∀ {t : STree E} {a : ℕ}, a ∈ t.labels → ∃ q, t.get? q = some (leaf a)
  | leaf b, a, h => ⟨[], by rw [Multiset.mem_singleton.1 h]; rfl⟩
  | @node _ k e c, a, h => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩

name: Operad.STree.exists_subst_trunc
statement:
theorem exists_subst_trunc : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup →
    ∀ V : Set (List ℕ), ∃ zs : ℕ → STree E, (t.trunc V).subst zs = t ∧
      ∀ a ∈ (t.trunc V).labels, (zs a).IsShuffle ∧ (zs a).first = a ∧
        (zs a).labels ≤ t.labels
  | leaf b, _, _, V => ⟨leaf, rfl, fun a ha => by
      rw [trunc_leaf, labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at ha
      subst ha
      exact ⟨trivial, rfl, le_rfl⟩⟩
  | @node _ k e c, h, hn, V => by
    by_cases hV : [] ∈ V
    · choose zs hzs hzs' using fun i => exists_subst_trunc (h.child i) (nodup_of_node hn i)
        (shift V [(i : ℕ)])
      classical
      let Z : ℕ → STree E := fun a =>
        if hi : ∃ i, a ∈ ((c i).trunc (shift V [(i : ℕ)])).labels then zs hi.choose a else leaf a
      have hZ : ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ ((c i).trunc (shift V [(i : ℕ)])).labels, Z a = zs i a := by
        intro i a ha
        have hex : ∃ i, a ∈ ((c i).trunc (shift V [(i : ℕ)])).labels := ⟨i, ha⟩
        simp only [Z, dite_eq_left hex]
        congr 1
        by_contra hne
        exact not_mem_of_node hn hne
          (Multiset.mem_of_le (labels_trunc_le (h.child _) _) hex.choose_spec)
          (Multiset.mem_of_le (labels_trunc_le (h.child _) _) ha)
      refine ⟨Z, ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
      · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c hV, subst_node]
        congr 1
        funext i
        rw [subst_congr _ (hZ i)]
        exact hzs i
      · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c hV, labels_node] at ha
        obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩

name: Operad.STree.first_replace
statement:
theorem first_replace : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u → ∀ {v : STree E},
    v.first = u.first → (t.replace p v).first = t.first
  | t, u, [], h, v, hv => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    simpa using hv
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h, v, hv => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.first_subst
statement:
theorem first_subst : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ xs : ℕ → STree E,
    (t.subst xs).first = (xs t.first).first
  | leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | @node _ k e c, h, xs => by
    rw [subst_node, first_node _ _ h.pos, first_node _ _ h.pos]
    exact first_subst (h.child _) xs

name: Operad.STree.first_trunc
statement:
theorem first_trunc : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ V : Set (List ℕ), (t.trunc V).first = t.first
  | leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | @node _ k e c, h, V => by
    by_cases hV : [] ∈ V
    · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c hV, first_node _ _ h.pos, first_node _ _ h.pos]
      exact first_trunc (h.child _) _
    · rw [trunc_node_of_not_mem e c hV]
      rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_append
statement:
theorem get?_append : ∀ (t : STree E) (p q : List ℕ),
    t.get? (p ++ q) = (t.get? p).bind fun u => u.get? q
  | t, [], q => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | @node _ k e c, i :: p, q => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, get?_node_cons]
    split_ifs
    · exact get?_append _ p q
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_leaf_cons
statement: @[simp] lemma get?_leaf_cons (a i : ℕ) (p : List ℕ) : (leaf a : STree E).get? (i :: p) = none

name: Operad.STree.get?_leaf_unique
statement:
theorem get?_leaf_unique : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.labels.Nodup → ∀ {a : ℕ} {q q' : List ℕ},
    t.get? q = some (leaf a) → t.get? q' = some (leaf a) → q = q'
  | leaf b, _, a, [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | leaf b, _, a, _ :: _, _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | leaf b, _, a, [], _ :: _, _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, _, a, [], _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, _, a, _ :: _, [], _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, hn, a, i :: q, j :: q', h, h' => by
    rw [get?_node_cons] at h h'
    split_ifs at h with hi
    split_ifs at h' with hj
    by_cases hij : (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k) = ⟨j, hj⟩
    · cases Fin.mk.inj_iff.1 hij
      rw [get?_leaf_unique (nodup_of_node hn _) h h']
    · exact absurd (mem_labels_of_get? h')
        (not_mem_of_node hn hij (mem_labels_of_get? h))

name: Operad.STree.get?_replace_append

theorem get?_replace_append {t : STree E} {p : List ℕ} (h : (t.get? p).isSome) (u : STree E)

name: Operad.STree.get?_replace_of_incomp
statement:
theorem get?_replace_of_incomp : ∀ (r : List ℕ) {i j : ℕ}, i ≠ j → ∀ (t : STree E)
    (p' q' : List ℕ) (u : STree E),
    (t.replace (r ++ i :: p') u).get? (r ++ j :: q') = t.get? (r ++ j :: q')
  | [], i, j, hij, leaf _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | [], i, j, hij, @node _ k e c, p', q', u => by
    rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, replace_node_cons, get?_node_cons, get?_node_cons]
    split_ifs with hj h <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h (Ne.symm hij)
  | _ :: _, _, _, _, leaf _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | a :: r, i, j, hij, @node _ k e c, p', q', u => by
    rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, replace_node_cons, get?_node_cons, get?_node_cons]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | exact get?_replace_of_incomp r hij _ p' q' u

name: Operad.STree.get?_subst
statement:
theorem get?_subst : ∀ {t u : STree E} {q : List ℕ}, t.get? q = some u → ∀ xs : ℕ → STree E,
    (t.subst xs).get? q = some (u.subst xs)
  | t, u, [], h, xs => by rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h; subst h; simp
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: q, h, xs => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.get?_subst_cases
statement:
theorem get?_subst_cases : ∀ {t w : STree E} {xs : ℕ → STree E} {q : List ℕ},
    (t.subst xs).get? q = some w →
    (∃ u, t.get? q = some u ∧ w = u.subst xs) ∨
      ∃ q₀ i q' a, q = q₀ ++ i :: q' ∧ t.get? q₀ = some (leaf a) ∧ (xs a).get? (i :: q') = some w
  | t, w, xs, [], h => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    exact Or.inl ⟨t, get?_nil t, h.symm⟩
  | leaf a, w, xs, i :: q, h => Or.inr ⟨[], i, q, a, rfl, rfl, h⟩
  | @node _ k e c, w, xs, i :: q, h => by
    rw [subst_node, get?_node_cons] at h
    split_ifs at h with hi
    rcases get?_subst_cases h with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨q₀, j, q', a, rfl, h₀, h'⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨u, by rw [get?_node_cons, dite_eq_left hi]; exact hu, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨i :: q₀, j, q', a, rfl, by rw [get?_node_cons, dite_eq_left hi]; exact h₀, h'⟩

name: Operad.STree.get?_trunc
statement:
theorem get?_trunc : ∀ {t u : STree E} {q : List ℕ}, t.get? q = some u → ∀ {V : Set (List ℕ)},
    (∀ q', q' <+: q → q' ≠ q → q' ∈ V) → (t.trunc V).get? q = some (u.trunc (shift V q))
  | t, u, [], h, V, _ => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    rw [get?_nil, shift_nil]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: q, h, V, hV => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.get?_trunc_node
statement:
theorem get?_trunc_node : ∀ {t : STree E} {V : Set (List ℕ)} {q : List ℕ} {k : ℕ} {e : E k}
    {c : Fin k → STree E}, (t.trunc V).get? q = some (node e c) → q ∈ V
  | leaf _, V, [], _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | leaf _, V, _ :: _, _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k' e' c', V, q, k, e, c, h => by
    by_cases hV : [] ∈ V
    · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e' c' hV] at h
      cases q with
      | nil => exact hV
      | cons i q =>
        obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_get?
statement:
lemma isShuffle_get? : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.IsShuffle → t.get? p = some u →
    u.IsShuffle
  | t, u, [], ht, h => by rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h; exact h ▸ ht
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, ht, h => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma isShuffle_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : STree E).IsShuffle

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_node
statement:
lemma isShuffle_node {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} :
    (node e c).IsShuffle ↔ 0 < k ∧ (∀ i, (c i).IsShuffle) ∧ StrictMono fun i => (c i).first

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_replace
statement:
theorem isShuffle_replace : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.IsShuffle → t.get? p = some u →
    ∀ {v : STree E}, v.IsShuffle → v.first = u.first → (t.replace p v).IsShuffle
  | t, u, [], _, _, v, hv, _ => by simpa using hv
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, ht, h, v, hv, hvu => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_subst
statement:
theorem isShuffle_subst : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ {xs : ℕ → STree E},
    (∀ a ∈ t.labels, (xs a).IsShuffle) →
    StrictMonoOn (fun a => (xs a).first) {a | a ∈ t.labels} → (t.subst xs).IsShuffle
  | leaf a, _, _, hx, _ => hx a (Multiset.mem_singleton_self a)
  | @node _ k e c, h, xs, hx, hm => by
    refine ⟨h.pos, fun i => isShuffle_subst (h.child i)
      (fun a ha => hx a (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, ha⟩))
      (fun a ha b hb hab => hm (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, ha⟩) (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, hb⟩) hab),
      fun i j hij => ?_⟩
    simp only [first_subst (h.child _)]
    exact hm (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, first_mem (h.child i)⟩)
      (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨j, first_mem (h.child j)⟩) (h.mono hij)

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_trunc
statement:
theorem isShuffle_trunc : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ V : Set (List ℕ), (t.trunc V).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, _, _ => trivial
  | @node _ k e c, h, V => by
    by_cases hV : [] ∈ V
    · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c hV]
      refine ⟨h.pos, fun i => isShuffle_trunc (h.child i) _, ?_⟩
      simp only [first_trunc (h.child _)]
      exact h.mono
    · rw [trunc_node_of_not_mem e c hV]
      trivial

name: Operad.STree.labels_get?_le
statement:
lemma labels_get?_le : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u →
    u.labels ≤ t.labels
  | t, u, [], h => by rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h; exact h ▸ le_rfl
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.labels_le_node
statement:
lemma labels_le_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (i : Fin k) :
    (c i).labels ≤ (node e c).labels

name: Operad.STree.labels_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma labels_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : STree E).labels = {a}

name: Operad.STree.labels_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma labels_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) :
    (node e c).labels = ∑ i, (c i).labels

name: Operad.STree.labels_replace
statement:
theorem labels_replace : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u → ∀ v : STree E,
    (t.replace p v).labels + u.labels = t.labels + v.labels
  | t, u, [], h, v => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    simp [add_comm]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h, v => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.labels_replace_of_eq
statement:
lemma labels_replace_of_eq {t u v : STree E} {p : List ℕ} (h : t.get? p = some u)
    (huv : v.labels = u.labels) : (t.replace p v).labels = t.labels

name: Operad.STree.labels_subst
statement:
theorem labels_subst : ∀ (t : STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree E),
    (t.subst xs).labels = t.labels.bind fun a => (xs a).labels
  | leaf a, xs => by simp
  | node e c, xs => by
    simp only [subst_node, labels_node, sum_bind]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => labels_subst (c i) xs

name: Operad.STree.labels_trunc_le
statement:
theorem labels_trunc_le : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ V : Set (List ℕ),
    (t.trunc V).labels ≤ t.labels
  | leaf _, _, _ => le_rfl
  | @node _ k e c, h, V => by
    by_cases hV : [] ∈ V
    · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c hV, labels_node, labels_node]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => labels_trunc_le (h.child i) _
    · rw [trunc_node_of_not_mem e c hV, labels_leaf, Multiset.singleton_le]
      exact first_mem h

name: Operad.STree.mem_labels_node
statement:
lemma mem_labels_node {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} {a : ℕ} :
    a ∈ (node e c).labels ↔ ∃ i, a ∈ (c i).labels

statement:
lemma mem_labels_of_get? {t : STree E} {q : List ℕ} {a : ℕ} (h : t.get? q = some (leaf a)) :
    a ∈ t.labels

statement: @[simp] lemma mem_shift {V : Set (List ℕ)} {p q : List ℕ} : q ∈ shift V p ↔ p ++ q ∈ V

statement:

    (i : Fin k) : (c i).labels.Nodup

name: Operad.STree.not_mem_of_node
statement:

statement:

    (h : t.get? q = some (leaf a)) : t.pos a = q

name: Operad.STree.prefix_or_incomp
statement:
theorem prefix_or_incomp : ∀ p q : List ℕ, p <+: q ∨ q <+: p ∨ Incomp p q
  | [], _ => Or.inl (List.nil_prefix)
  | _ :: _, [] => Or.inr (Or.inl List.nil_prefix)
  | i :: p, j :: q => by
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      rcases prefix_or_incomp p q with h | h | ⟨r, a, b, p', q', hab, rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inl (List.cons_prefix_cons.2 ⟨rfl, h⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (List.cons_prefix_cons.2 ⟨rfl, h⟩))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨i :: r, a, b, p', q', hab, rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨[], i, j, p, q, hij, rfl, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.STree.replace_append
statement:
theorem replace_append : ∀ {t w : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some w →
    ∀ (q : List ℕ) (v : STree E), t.replace (p ++ q) v = t.replace p (w.replace q v)
  | t, w, [], h, q, v => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    simp
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, w, i :: p, h, q, v => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.replace_comm
statement:
lemma replace_comm {p q : List ℕ} (h : Incomp p q) (t u v : STree E) :
    (t.replace p u).replace q v = (t.replace q v).replace p u

name: Operad.STree.replace_comm_of_incomp
statement:
theorem replace_comm_of_incomp : ∀ (r : List ℕ) {i j : ℕ}, i ≠ j → ∀ (t : STree E)
    (p' q' : List ℕ) (u v : STree E),
    (t.replace (r ++ i :: p') u).replace (r ++ j :: q') v =
      (t.replace (r ++ j :: q') v).replace (r ++ i :: p') u
  | [], i, j, hij, leaf _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | [], i, j, hij, node e c, p', q', u, v => by
    simp only [List.nil_append, replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext l
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)
  | _ :: _, _, _, _, leaf _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | a :: r, i, j, hij, node e c, p', q', u, v => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext l
    split_ifs with ha
    · exact replace_comm_of_incomp r hij _ p' q' u v
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.replace_leaf_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma replace_leaf_cons (a i : ℕ) (p : List ℕ) (u : STree E) :
    (leaf a : STree E).replace (i :: p) u = leaf a

name: Operad.STree.replace_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma replace_nil (t u : STree E) : t.replace [] u = u

name: Operad.STree.replace_node_cons
statement:
lemma replace_node_cons {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (i : ℕ) (p : List ℕ)
    (u : STree E) :
    (node e c).replace (i :: p) u =
      node e fun j => if (j : ℕ) = i then (c j).replace p u else c j

name: Operad.STree.replace_replace
statement:
theorem replace_replace : ∀ (t : STree E) (p : List ℕ) (u v : STree E),
    (t.replace p u).replace p v = t.replace p v
  | t, [], u, v => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e c, i :: p, u, v => by
    simp only [replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext j
    split_ifs with hj
    · exact replace_replace _ p u v
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.replace_self
statement:
theorem replace_self : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u → t.replace p u = t
  | t, u, [], h => by rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h; rw [replace_nil, h]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.replace_subst
statement:
theorem replace_subst : ∀ {t : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, (t.get? p).isSome →
    ∀ (u : STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree E),
    (t.replace p u).subst xs = (t.subst xs).replace p (u.subst xs)
  | t, [], _, u, xs => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, i :: p, h, u, xs => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.shift_nil
statement: lemma shift_nil (V : Set (List ℕ)) : shift V [] = V

name: Operad.STree.shift_shift
statement: lemma shift_shift (V : Set (List ℕ)) (p q : List ℕ) : shift (shift V p) q = shift V (p ++ q)

name: Operad.STree.subst_congr
statement:
theorem subst_congr : ∀ (t : STree E) {xs ys : ℕ → STree E}, (∀ a ∈ t.labels, xs a = ys a) →
    t.subst xs = t.subst ys
  | leaf a, _, _, h => h a (Multiset.mem_singleton_self a)
  | node e c, _, _, h => by
    simp only [subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact subst_congr (c i) fun a ha => h a (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, ha⟩)

name: Operad.STree.subst_leaf
statement:
theorem subst_leaf : ∀ t : STree E, t.subst leaf = t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by
    rw [subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact subst_leaf (c i)

name: Operad.STree.subst_leaf'
statement: @[simp] lemma subst_leaf' (a : ℕ) (xs : ℕ → STree E) : (leaf a).subst xs = xs a

name: Operad.STree.subst_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma subst_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree E) :

name: Operad.STree.subst_subst
statement:
theorem subst_subst : ∀ (t : STree E) (xs ys : ℕ → STree E),
    (t.subst xs).subst ys = t.subst fun a => (xs a).subst ys
  | leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e c, xs, ys => by
    simp only [subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact subst_subst (c i) xs ys

name: Operad.STree.subst_update
statement:
theorem subst_update : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.labels.Nodup → ∀ {q : List ℕ} {a : ℕ},
    t.get? q = some (leaf a) → ∀ (xs : ℕ → STree E) (w : STree E),
    t.subst (Function.update xs a w) = (t.subst xs).replace q w
  | t, _, [], a, h, xs, w => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    simp
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, _, h, _, _ => by simp at h

lemma Amb.data {B : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : ρ} (A : G.Amb B r₁ r₂) :

      A.top.1.get? p₂ = some ((G.lead r₂).1.subst xs₂) ∧
      Inputs (G.src r₁) B xs₁ ∧ Inputs (G.src r₂) B xs₂ ∧
      (∀ g, (A.f₁ g).1 = A.top.1.replace p₁ (g.1.subst xs₁)) ∧

name: Operad.STree.DegLex.trans
statement: theorem DegLex.trans {u v w : List L} : DegLex u v → DegLex v w → DegLex u w

name: Operad.STree.acc_lexEq
statement:
theorem acc_lexEq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : List L), u.length = n → Acc LexEq u
  | 0, u, hu => by
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff] at hu
    subst hu
    exact ⟨_, fun v hv => by cases hv.2⟩
  | n + 1, u, hu => by
    cases u with
    | nil => simp at hu
    | cons b w => exact acc_lexEq_cons (acc_lexEq n) b w (by simpa using hu)

name: Operad.STree.acc_lexEq_cons
statement:
theorem acc_lexEq_cons {n : ℕ} (ih : ∀ u : List L, u.length = n → Acc LexEq u) :
    ∀ (b : L) (w : List L), w.length = n → Acc LexEq (b :: w)

name: Operad.STree.degLex_wf
statement: theorem degLex_wf : WellFounded (DegLex (L := L))

name: Operad.STree.get?_node_of_prefix
statement:
lemma get?_node_of_prefix {t : STree E} {p r : List ℕ} (hp : (t.get? p).isSome) (h : r <+: p)
    (hne : r ≠ p) : ∃ k, ∃ (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E), t.get? r = some (node e c)

name: Operad.STree.lex_append_right
statement:
theorem lex_append_right : ∀ {u w : List L}, List.Lex (· < ·) u w → u.length = w.length →
    ∀ Q : List L, List.Lex (· < ·) (u ++ Q) (w ++ Q)
  | _, _, .nil, h, _ => by simp at h
  | _, _, .cons hl, h, Q => .cons (lex_append_right hl (by simpa using h) Q)
  | _, _, .rel hr, _, _ => .rel hr

name: Operad.STree.lex_trans
statement:
theorem lex_trans : ∀ {u v w : List L}, List.Lex (· < ·) u v → List.Lex (· < ·) v w →
    List.Lex (· < ·) u w
  | _, _, _, .nil, .cons _ => .nil
  | _, _, _, .nil, .rel _ => .nil
  | _, _, _, .cons h₁, .cons h₂ => .cons (lex_trans h₁ h₂)
  | _, _, _, .cons _, .rel h₂ => .rel h₂
  | _, _, _, .rel h₁, .cons _ => .rel h₁
  | _, _, _, .rel h₁, .rel h₂ => .rel (h₁.trans h₂)

name: Operad.STree.pathWord_append
statement:
theorem pathWord_append : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u → ∀ q : List ℕ,
    pathWord ltr t (p ++ q) = pathWord ltr t p ++ pathWord ltr u q
  | t, u, [], h, q => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    simp
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h, q => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.pathWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma pathWord_nil (t : STree E) : pathWord ltr t [] = []

name: Operad.STree.pathWord_node_cons
statement:
lemma pathWord_node_cons {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (i : ℕ) (q : List ℕ) :
    pathWord ltr (node e c) (i :: q) =
      if h : i < k then ltr k e i :: pathWord ltr (c ⟨i, h⟩) q else []

name: Operad.STree.pathWord_replace
statement:
theorem pathWord_replace : ∀ {t : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, (t.get? p).isSome → ∀ u : STree E,
    pathWord ltr (t.replace p u) p = pathWord ltr t p
  | t, [], _, u => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, i :: p, h, u => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.pathWord_replace_incomp
statement:
lemma pathWord_replace_incomp {p r : List ℕ} (h : Incomp p r) (t u : STree E) :
    pathWord ltr (t.replace p u) r = pathWord ltr t r

name: Operad.STree.pathWord_replace_of_incomp
statement:
theorem pathWord_replace_of_incomp : ∀ (r : List ℕ) {i j : ℕ}, i ≠ j → ∀ (t : STree E)
    (p' q' : List ℕ) (u : STree E),
    pathWord ltr (t.replace (r ++ i :: p') u) (r ++ j :: q') = pathWord ltr t (r ++ j :: q')
  | [], i, j, hij, leaf _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | [], i, j, hij, @node _ k e c, p', q', u => by
    rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, replace_node_cons, pathWord_node_cons,
      pathWord_node_cons]
    split_ifs with hj h <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h (Ne.symm hij)
  | _ :: _, _, _, _, leaf _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | a :: r, i, j, hij, @node _ k e c, p', q', u => by
    rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, replace_node_cons, pathWord_node_cons,
      pathWord_node_cons]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | rw [pathWord_replace_of_incomp r hij _ p' q' u]

name: Operad.STree.pathWord_subst
statement:
theorem pathWord_subst : ∀ {t : STree E} {q : List ℕ}, (t.get? q).isSome →
    ∀ xs : ℕ → STree E, pathWord ltr (t.subst xs) q = pathWord ltr t q
  | t, [], _, xs => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, i :: q, h, xs => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩

name: Operad.STree.word_ctx_in
statement:
theorem word_ctx_in {T t g : STree E} {p : List ℕ} {xs : ℕ → STree E} (hp : (T.get? p).isSome)
    (ht : t = T.replace p (g.subst xs)) (hn : t.labels.Nodup) {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ g.labels)
    (hb : b ∈ (xs a).labels) :
    word ltr t b = pathWord ltr T p ++ (word ltr g a ++ word ltr (xs a) b)

name: Operad.STree.word_ctx_out
statement:
theorem word_ctx_out {T U₁ U₂ : STree E} {p : List ℕ} (hp : (T.get? p).isSome)
    (hn₂ : (T.replace p U₂).labels.Nodup) {b : ℕ} (hb₁ : b ∈ (T.replace p U₁).labels)
    (hU₁ : b ∉ U₁.labels) : word ltr (T.replace p U₁) b = word ltr (T.replace p U₂) b

statement:
lemma mem_map (Φ : SymOperadFiltration R P) (f : SymOperadHom R P Q)

name: Operad.Forest.arityF_graftF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.arityF_graftF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E),
    i < f.arityF → (f.graftF i s).arityF = f.arityF - 1 + s.arity
  | _, .nil, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | _, .cons t f, i, s, h => by
      simp only [arityF_cons] at h
      by_cases hlt : i < t.arity
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_lt s hlt]
        simp only [arityF_cons]
        rw [arity_graft t i s hlt]
        omega
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge s (by omega)]
        simp only [arityF_cons]
        rw [Forest.arityF_graftF f (i - t.arity) s (by omega)]
        omega

name: Operad.Forest.graftF_graftF_par
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.graftF_graftF_par :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E) (i' : ℕ) (u : Tree E),
    i < i' → i' < f.arityF →
    (f.graftF i s).graftF (i' - 1 + s.arity) u = (f.graftF i' u).graftF i s
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, _, _, h' => by simp at h'
  | _, .cons t f, i, s, i', u, h, h' => by
      simp only [arityF_cons] at h'
      by_cases hi' : i' < t.arity
      · -- Both slots lie in the head tree.
        have hi : i < t.arity

name: Operad.Forest.graftF_graftF_seq
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.graftF_graftF_seq :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E) (j : ℕ) (u : Tree E),
    i < f.arityF → j < s.arity →
    (f.graftF i s).graftF (i + j) u = f.graftF i (s.graft j u)
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | _, .cons t f, i, s, j, u, h, hj => by
      simp only [arityF_cons] at h
      by_cases hlt : i < t.arity
      · have hsub : i + j < (t.graft i s).arity

name: Operad.Forest.graftF_leaf
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.graftF_leaf : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (i : ℕ),
    f.graftF i .leaf = f
  | _, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t f, i => by
      by_cases hlt : i < t.arity
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_lt _ hlt, graft_leaf_right t i]
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge _ (by omega), Forest.graftF_leaf f (i - t.arity)]

name: Operad.Tree.arityF_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma arityF_cons {k : ℕ} (t : Tree E) (f : Forest E k) :
    (Forest.cons t f).arityF = t.arity + f.arityF

name: Operad.Tree.arityF_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma arityF_nil : (Forest.nil (E := E)).arityF = 0

name: Operad.Tree.arity_graft
statement:
theorem arity_graft : ∀ (t : Tree E) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E), i < t.arity →
    (t.graft i s).arity = t.arity - 1 + s.arity
  | .leaf, _, s, _ => by simp
  | .node _ f, i, s, h => by
      simp only [graft_node, arity_node]
      exact Forest.arityF_graftF f i s h

name: Operad.Tree.arity_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma arity_leaf : (Tree.leaf (E := E)).arity = 1

name: Operad.Tree.arity_node
statement:

name: Operad.Tree.graftF_cons
Operad.Tree.graftF_cons_of_ge
statement:
lemma graftF_cons_of_ge {k : ℕ} {t : Tree E} {f : Forest E k} {i : ℕ} (s : Tree E)
    (h : t.arity ≤ i) : (Forest.cons t f).graftF i s = .cons t (f.graftF (i - t.arity) s)

name: Operad.Tree.graftF_cons_of_lt

lemma graftF_cons_of_lt {k : ℕ} {t : Tree E} {f : Forest E k} {i : ℕ} (s : Tree E)

name: Operad.Tree.graftF_nil
statement:
@[simp] lemma graftF_nil (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E) :
    (Forest.nil (E := E)).graftF i s = .nil

name: Operad.Tree.graft_graft_par
statement:
theorem graft_graft_par : ∀ (t : Tree E) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E) (i' : ℕ) (u : Tree E),
    i < i' → i' < t.arity →
    (t.graft i s).graft (i' - 1 + s.arity) u = (t.graft i' u).graft i s
  | .leaf, _, _, _, _, h, h' => by simp only [arity_leaf] at h'; omega
  | .node _ f, i, s, i', u, h, h' => by
      simp only [graft_node]
      rw [Forest.graftF_graftF_par f i s i' u h h']

name: Operad.Tree.graft_graft_seq
statement:
theorem graft_graft_seq : ∀ (t : Tree E) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E) (j : ℕ) (u : Tree E),
    i < t.arity → j < s.arity →
    (t.graft i s).graft (i + j) u = t.graft i (s.graft j u)
  | .leaf, i, s, j, u, h, _ => by
      obtain rfl : i = 0

statement: @[simp] lemma graft_leaf (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E) : (Tree.leaf (E := E)).graft i s = s

name: Operad.Tree.graft_leaf_right
statement:
theorem graft_leaf_right : ∀ (t : Tree E) (i : ℕ), t.graft i .leaf = t

  | .node _ f, i => by rw [graft_node, Forest.graftF_leaf f i]

name: Operad.Tree.weightF_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma weightF_nil : (Forest.nil (E := E)).weightF = 0

name: Operad.Tree.weight_graft
statement:
theorem weight_graft : ∀ (t : Tree E) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E), i < t.arity →
    (t.graft i s).weight = t.weight + s.weight
  | .leaf, _, s, _ => by simp
  | .node _ f, i, s, h => by

name: Operad.substF_comp
statement:
lemma substF_comp (f : ∀ k, E k → Q k) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (p q d c e g : ℕ) (hc : c = p + d + q) (he : e = p + 1 + q)
      (_hg : g = q + fo.arityF)
      (h3 : p + d + g = c + fo.arityF) (h4 : e + fo.arityF = p + 1 + g)
      (β : Q (e + k)) (δ : Q d),
      substF (R := R) f c
          (reindex R Q (show p + d + (q + k) = c + k by omega)
            (comp (R := R) p (q + k)
              (reindex R Q (show e + k = p + 1 + (q + k) by omega) β) δ)) fo
        = reindex R Q h3
            (comp (R := R) p g
              (reindex R Q h4 (substF (R := R) f e β fo)) δ)
  | _, .nil, p, q, d, c, e, g, hc, he, hg, h3, h4, β, δ => by
      simp only [Tree.arityF_nil] at hg
      subst hg
      simp only [substF]
      rfl
  | _, @Forest.cons _ k' t fo, p, q, d, c, e, g, hc, he, hg, h3, h4, β, δ => by
      subst hc
      subst he
      rw [Tree.arityF_cons] at hg
      simp only [substF, Tree.arityF_cons, reindex_reindex]
      have hax := comp_assoc_par (R := R) p q k'
        (reindex R Q (show p + 1 + q + (k' + 1) = p + 1 + q + 1 + k' by omega) β) δ
        (extend (R := R) f t)
      have hbridge := comp_index_congr (R := R) (P := Q) p
        (show q + 1 + k' = q + (k' + 1) by omega)
        (reindex R Q (show p + 1 + q + (k' + 1) = p + 1 + (q + 1 + k') by omega) β) δ
      simp only [reindex_reindex] at hbridge hax
      rw [hbridge]
      simp only [reindex_reindex]
      have hkey : (comp (R := R) (p + d + q) k'
            (reindex R Q (show p + d + (q + 1 + k') = p + d + q + 1 + k' by omega)
              (comp (R := R) p (q + 1 + k')
                (reindex R Q (show p + 1 + q + (k' + 1) = p + 1 + (q + 1 + k') by omega) β) δ))
            (extend (R := R) f t))
          = reindex R Q (show p + d + (q + t.arity + k') = p + d + q + t.arity + k' by omega)
              (comp (R := R) p (q + t.arity + k')
                (reindex R Q (show p + 1 + q + t.arity + k' = p + 1 + (q + t.arity + k') by omega)
                  (comp (R := R) (p + 1 + q) k'
                    (reindex R Q (show p + 1 + q + (k' + 1) = p + 1 + q + 1 + k' by omega) β)
                    (extend (R := R) f t))) δ) := by
        rw [← hax, reindex_reindex, reindex_self]
      rw [hkey]
      rw [substF_comp f fo p (q + t.arity) d (p + d + q + t.arity) (p + 1 + q + t.arity) g
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
        (comp (R := R) (p + 1 + q) k'
          (reindex R Q (show p + 1 + q + (k' + 1) = p + 1 + q + 1 + k' by omega) β)
          (extend (R := R) f t)) δ]
      set X

name: Operad.substForest_cons_of_ge
statement:
lemma substForest_cons_of_ge {k₁ : ℕ} (t : Tree E) (F : Forest E k₁) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (c : ℕ) (fo : Forest E k), t.arity ≤ c →
      substForest (Forest.cons t F) c fo = Forest.cons t (substForest F (c - t.arity) fo)
  | _, _, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, c, .cons s fo, h => by
      rw [substForest, Tree.graftF_cons_of_ge s h,
        substForest_cons_of_ge t (F.graftF (c - t.arity) s) (c + s.arity) fo (by omega),
        substForest, show c + s.arity - t.arity = c - t.arity + s.arity by omega]

  | _, .nil => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo => by
      rw [corollaF, substForest, Tree.graftF_cons_of_lt t (by simp),
        Tree.graft_leaf, substForest_cons_of_ge t (corollaF E _) (0 + t.arity) fo (by omega),
