statement:
lemma sum_T1 (m : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), ∑ k ∈ range j, F k (j - 1 - k) (m - j) =
      ∑ p ∈ range m, ∑ k ∈ range (p + 1), F k (m - 1 - p) (p - k)

name: Operad.HTT.sum_T2
statement:
lemma sum_T2 (m : ℕ) (G : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), ∑ k ∈ range j, G k (j - 1 - k) (m - j) =
      ∑ p ∈ range m, ∑ l ∈ range (m - 1 - p + 1), G p l (m - 1 - p - l)

name: Operad.HTT.sum_T3
statement:
lemma sum_T3 (m : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    ∑ p ∈ range m, ∑ k ∈ range p, F k (p - 1 - k) (m - 1 - p) =
      ∑ k ∈ range m, ∑ l ∈ range (m - 1 - k), F k l (m - 1 - k - 1 - l)

name: Operad.HTT.tf_succ
statement:
lemma tf_succ (n : ℕ) :
    tf μ e h (n + 1) = h.compMultilinearMap (BIN μ (tf μ e h) (tf μ e h) (n + 1))

name: Operad.HTT.tf_zero
statement: lemma tf_zero : tf μ e h 0 = op1 e

name: Operad.HTT.tstar_succ
statement:
lemma tstar_succ (q : ℕ) (F c : Fam R V) (m : ℕ) :
    tstar ε q F c (m + 1) = (acast (kstar ε q (F 0) (c (m + 1))) : End R V (m + 1 + 1)) +
      ∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), (acast (kstar ε q (F (j + 1)) (c (m - j))) : End R V (m + 1 + 1))

name: Operad.Hoffbeck.exact_of_leading
statement:
theorem exact_of_leading (wf : WellFounded lt) (trans : ∀ {a b c}, lt a b → lt b c → lt a c)
    {V V' : Set X} (D D₀ : (X →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X →₀ R))
    (hD : ∀ x ∈ V', D (single x 1) ∈ supported R R V)
    (hDD : ∀ w ∈ supported R R V', D (D w) = 0)
    (hlead : ∀ x ∈ V ∪ V',
      D (single x 1) - D₀ (single x 1) ∈ supported R R {y | lt (u y) (u x)})
    (hfib : ∀ x ∈ V, D₀ (single x 1) ∈ supported R R {y | u y = u x})
    (hexact : ∀ t, ∀ v ∈ supported R R (V ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}), D₀ v = 0 →
      ∃ w ∈ supported R R (V' ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}), D₀ w = v) :
    ∀ v ∈ supported R R V, D v = 0 → ∃ w ∈ supported R R V', D w = v

name: Operad.Hoffbeck.exact_of_leading_down
statement:
theorem exact_of_leading_down (wf : WellFounded lt)
    (trans : ∀ {a b c}, lt a b → lt b c → lt a c)
    {V V' : Set X} (D D₀ : (X →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X →₀ R))
    (hD : ∀ x ∈ V', D (single x 1) ∈ supported R R V)
    (hDD : ∀ w ∈ supported R R V', D (D w) = 0)
    (hlead : ∀ x ∈ V ∪ V',
      D (single x 1) - D₀ (single x 1) ∈ supported R R {y | lt (u y) (u x)})
    (hfib : ∀ x ∈ V ∪ V', D₀ (single x 1) ∈ supported R R {y | u y = u x})
    (hexact : ∀ t, ∀ v ∈ supported R R (V ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}), D₀ v = 0 →
      ∃ w ∈ supported R R (V' ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}), D₀ w = v)
    {Z : Set M} (hZ : ∀ m ∈ Z, ∀ m', lt m' m → m' ∈ Z) :
    ∀ v ∈ supported R R (V ∩ u ⁻¹' Z), D v = 0 →
      ∃ w ∈ supported R R (V' ∩ u ⁻¹' Z), D w = v

statement:
lemma leading_cycle (irr : ∀ a, ¬ lt a a) {V : Set X} (D D₀ : (X →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X →₀ R))
    (hlead : ∀ x ∈ V,
      D (single x 1) - D₀ (single x 1) ∈ supported R R {y | lt (u y) (u x)})
    (hfib : ∀ x ∈ V, D₀ (single x 1) ∈ supported R R {y | u y = u x}) {t : M}

name: Operad.TConv.compFun_eq
statement:
lemma compFun_eq (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)

name: Operad.TConv.eval_add
statement:
lemma eval_add {n : ℕ} (f g : TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) :
    eval (f + g) x = eval f x + eval g x

name: Operad.TConv.eval_apply
statement:
lemma eval_apply {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) :
    eval f x = ∑ t, x t • f t

name: Operad.TConv.eval_comp_inner
statement:
theorem eval_comp_inner (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (a + n + b)) :
    eval (compL a b f g) x
      = ∑ t₁, NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b (f t₁) (eval g (innerSlice a b t₁ x))

name: Operad.TConv.eval_comp_outer
statement:
theorem eval_comp_outer (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (a + n + b)) :
    eval (compL a b f g) x
      = ∑ t₂, NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b (eval f (outerSlice a b t₂ x)) (g t₂)

name: Operad.TConv.eval_comp_pairs
statement:
lemma eval_comp_pairs (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (a + n + b)) :
    eval (compL a b f g) x = ∑ p : OfArity E (a + 1 + b) × OfArity E n,
      x (OfArity.graft a b p.1 p.2) • NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b (f p.1) (g p.2)

name: Operad.TConv.eval_neg
statement: lemma eval_neg {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) : eval (-f) x = -eval f x

name: Operad.TConv.eval_single
statement:
lemma eval_single {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q n) (t : OfArity E n) (r : R) :

name: Operad.TConv.eval_smul
statement:
lemma eval_smul {n : ℕ} (c : R) (f : TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) :

name: Operad.TConv.eval_sub
statement:
lemma eval_sub {n : ℕ} (f g : TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) :
    eval (f - g) x = eval f x - eval g x

name: Operad.TConv.eval_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_zero {n : ℕ} (x : Chain R E n) : eval (0 : TConv R E Q n) x = 0

name: Operad.TConv.ext_eval

name: Operad.TConv.innerSlice_apply

name: Operad.TConv.koszulDual_three

name: Operad.TConv.mem_koszulDual_add_four
statement:
lemma mem_koszulDual_add_four (Rel : Submodule R (Chain R E 3)) (m : ℕ)
    (x : Chain R E (m + 4)) :
    x ∈ koszulDual Rel (m + 4) ↔ ∀ (a b k : ℕ) (h : a + k + b = m + 4), 2 ≤ k → 1 ≤ a + b →
      (∀ t₂ : OfArity E k, outerSlice a b t₂ (fun t => x (OfArity.cast h t))
        ∈ koszulDual Rel (a + 1 + b)) ∧
      (∀ t₁ : OfArity E (a + 1 + b), innerSlice a b t₁ (fun t => x (OfArity.cast h t))
        ∈ koszulDual Rel k)

name: Operad.TConv.mem_koszulDual_cast

name: Operad.isLeading_fiberKer_iff

theorem isLeading_fiberKer_iff [Nontrivial K] (f : X → Option Y) (x : X) :

name: Operad.ListInv.countP_lt_add_countP_gt
statement:
lemma countP_lt_add_countP_gt {x : ℕ} : ∀ {l : List ℕ}, x ∉ l →
    l.countP (· < x) + l.countP (x < ·) = l.length
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    rw [List.mem_cons, not_or] at h
    have ih

name: Operad.ListInv.cross_cons_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma cross_cons_left (a : ℕ) (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) :
    cross (a :: l₁) l₂ = l₂.countP (· < a) + cross l₁ l₂

name: Operad.ListInv.cross_cons_right
statement:
lemma cross_cons_right (l₁ : List ℕ) (x : ℕ) (l₂ : List ℕ) :
    cross l₁ (x :: l₂) = l₁.countP (x < ·) + cross l₁ l₂

name: Operad.ListInv.cross_nil_left
statement: @[simp] lemma cross_nil_left (l : List ℕ) : cross [] l = 0

name: Operad.ListInv.cross_perm_right

name: Operad.ListInv.inv_append
statement:
lemma inv_append : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List ℕ, inv (l₁ ++ l₂) = inv l₁ + inv l₂ + cross l₁ l₂
  | [], l₂ => by simp
  | a :: l₁, l₂ => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, inv_cons, List.countP_append, inv_append l₁ l₂, cross_cons_left]
    ring

name: Operad.ListInv.inv_cons
statement: @[simp] lemma inv_cons (a : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) : inv (a :: l) = l.countP (· < a) + inv l

name: Operad.ListInv.inv_move

lemma inv_move {x : ℕ} {l₁ : List ℕ} (hx : x ∉ l₁) (l₂ : List ℕ) :
    inv (l₁ ++ x :: l₂) + 2 * l₁.countP (· < x) = inv (x :: (l₁ ++ l₂)) + l₁.length

name: Operad.ListInv.inv_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma inv_nil : inv [] = 0

name: Operad.TConv.compFin_apply_graft
statement:
lemma compFin_apply_graft {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (f : TConv R E Q m) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (t₁ : OfArity E m) (t₂ : OfArity E n) (t : OfArity E (m - 1 + n))
    (h : t₁.1.graft i t₂.1 = t.1) :
    compFin (R := R) i f g t = compFin (R := R) (P := Q) i (f t₁) (g t₂)

name: Operad.TConv.compFin_sum_left
statement:
lemma compFin_sum_left {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Q m) (y : Q n) :
    compFin (R := R) i (∑ k ∈ s, F k) y = ∑ k ∈ s, compFin (R := R) i (F k) y

name: Operad.TConv.compFin_sum_right
statement:
lemma compFin_sum_right {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (x : Q m) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Q n) :
    compFin (R := R) i x (∑ k ∈ s, F k) = ∑ k ∈ s, compFin (R := R) i x (F k)

name: Operad.TConv.eval_compFin_in
statement:
theorem eval_compFin_in {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (f : TConv R E Q m) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (m - 1 + n)) :
    eval (compFin (R := R) i f g) x
      = ∑ t₁, compFin (R := R) (P := Q) i (f t₁) (eval g (sliceIn i t₁ x))

name: Operad.TConv.eval_compFin_out
statement:
theorem eval_compFin_out {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (f : TConv R E Q m) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (m - 1 + n)) :
    eval (compFin (R := R) i f g) x
      = ∑ t₂, compFin (R := R) (P := Q) i (eval f (sliceOut i t₂ x)) (g t₂)

name: Operad.TConv.eval_compFin_pairs
statement:
lemma eval_compFin_pairs {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (f : TConv R E Q m) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (m - 1 + n)) :
    eval (compFin (R := R) i f g) x = ∑ p : OfArity E m × OfArity E n,
      sliceOut i p.2 x p.1 • compFin (R := R) (P := Q) i (f p.1) (g p.2)

name: Operad.TConv.eval_sum
statement:
lemma eval_sum {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) :
    eval (∑ k ∈ s, F k) x = ∑ k ∈ s, eval (F k) x

name: Operad.TConv.graftPair_injective
statement:
lemma graftPair_injective {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) :
    Function.Injective (graftPair (E := E) (n := n) i)

name: Operad.TConv.mem_koszulDual_four_iff
statement:
theorem mem_koszulDual_four_iff (Rel : Submodule R (Chain R E 3)) (x : Chain R E 4) :
    x ∈ koszulDual Rel 4 ↔
      (∀ (a : Fin 3) (e : E), sliceOut (n := 2) a (cor e) x ∈ Rel) ∧
        (∀ (a : Fin 2) (e : E), sliceIn (n := 3) a (cor e) x ∈ Rel)

name: Operad.TConv.sliceIn_one_lc
statement: @[simp] lemma sliceIn_one_lc : sliceIn (n := 3) (1 : Fin 2) (cor e) x (lc p q) = x (rl e p q)

name: Operad.TConv.sliceIn_one_rc
statement: @[simp] lemma sliceIn_one_rc : sliceIn (n := 3) (1 : Fin 2) (cor e) x (rc p q) = x (rr e p q)

name: Operad.TConv.sliceIn_zero_lc
statement: @[simp] lemma sliceIn_zero_lc : sliceIn (n := 3) (0 : Fin 2) (cor e) x (lc p q) = x (ll e p q)

name: Operad.TConv.sliceIn_zero_rc
statement: @[simp] lemma sliceIn_zero_rc : sliceIn (n := 3) (0 : Fin 2) (cor e) x (rc p q) = x (lr e p q)

name: Operad.TConv.sliceOut_one_lc
statement: @[simp] lemma sliceOut_one_lc : sliceOut (m := 3) (1 : Fin 3) (cor e) x (lc p q) = x (lr p q e)

name: Operad.TConv.sliceOut_one_rc
statement: @[simp] lemma sliceOut_one_rc : sliceOut (m := 3) (1 : Fin 3) (cor e) x (rc p q) = x (rl p q e)

name: Operad.TConv.sliceOut_two_lc
statement: @[simp] lemma sliceOut_two_lc : sliceOut (m := 3) (2 : Fin 3) (cor e) x (lc p q) = x (bl p q e)

name: Operad.TConv.sliceOut_two_rc
statement: @[simp] lemma sliceOut_two_rc : sliceOut (m := 3) (2 : Fin 3) (cor e) x (rc p q) = x (rr p q e)

name: Operad.TConv.sliceOut_zero_lc
statement: @[simp] lemma sliceOut_zero_lc : sliceOut (m := 3) (0 : Fin 3) (cor e) x (lc p q) = x (ll p q e)

name: Operad.TConv.sliceOut_zero_rc
statement: @[simp] lemma sliceOut_zero_rc : sliceOut (m := 3) (0 : Fin 3) (cor e) x (rc p q) = x (bl p e q)

name: Operad.TConv.sum_ofArity_two
statement:
lemma sum_ofArity_two {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (F : OfArity E 2 → M) :
    ∑ t, F t = ∑ e, F (cor e)

name: Operad.May.Splits.mem_left
statement: lemma mem_left (h : Splits L L₁ L₂) (p : Without P i) : p.1 ∈ L₁ ↔ Sum.inl p ∈ L

name: Operad.May.Splits.mem_right
statement: lemma mem_right (h : Splits L L₁ L₂) (q : Q) : q ∈ L₂ ↔ Sum.inr q ∈ L

name: Operad.May.Splits.nodup_left
statement: lemma nodup_left (h : Splits L L₁ L₂) (hL : L.Nodup) : L₁.Nodup

name: Operad.May.Splits.nodup_right
statement: lemma nodup_right (h : Splits L L₁ L₂) (hL : L.Nodup) : L₂.Nodup

name: Operad.May.Splits.not_mem
statement: lemma not_mem (h : Splits L L₁ L₂) : i ∉ L₁

name: Operad.May.comp_map_left
statement:
lemma comp_map_left (e : P ≃ P') (i : P) (i' : P') (hi : e i = i') (X : S P) (Y : S Q) :
    SetOperad.comp i' (SetOperad.map e X) Y
      = SetOperad.map ((compEquiv e (Equiv.refl Q) i).trans (slotEquiv hi))
          (SetOperad.comp i X Y)

name: Operad.May.comp_map_right
statement:
lemma comp_map_right (i : P) (f : Q ≃ Q') (X : S P) (Y : S Q) :
    SetOperad.comp i X (SetOperad.map f Y)
      = SetOperad.map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Without P i)) f) (SetOperad.comp i X Y)

name: Operad.May.comp_one_eq
statement:
lemma comp_one_eq (i : P) (X : S P) :
    SetOperad.comp i X SetOperad.one = SetOperad.map (rightUnitEquiv i).symm X

name: Operad.May.comp_par_eq
statement:
lemma comp_par_eq {i k : P} (hik : i ≠ k) (X : S P) (Y : S Q) (Z : S Q') :
    SetOperad.comp (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (SetOperad.comp i X Y) Z
      = SetOperad.map (parEquiv hik Q Q').symm
          (SetOperad.comp (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (SetOperad.comp k X Z) Y)

name: Operad.May.comp_seq_eq
statement:
lemma comp_seq_eq (i : P) (j : Q) (X : S P) (Y : S Q) (Z : S Q') :
    SetOperad.comp (Sum.inr j) (SetOperad.comp i X Y) Z
      = SetOperad.map (seqEquiv i j Q').symm (SetOperad.comp i X (SetOperad.comp j Y Z))

name: Operad.May.fill_comp
statement:
theorem fill_comp (i : P) (X : S P) (Y : S Q) (w₁ : (p : P) → S (W₁ p))
    (w₂ : (q : Q) → S (W₂ q)) {L : List (Without P i ⊕ Q)} {L₁ : List P} {L₂ : List Q}
    (h : Splits L L₁ L₂) (hL : L.Nodup) :
    fill (SetOperad.comp i X Y) (sumVal i w₁ w₂) L hL
      = SetOperad.map (interEquiv h).symm
          (SetOperad.comp (Sum.inl ⟨i, h.not_mem⟩ : Stage W₁ L₁)
            (fill X w₁ L₁ (h.nodup_left hL)) (fill Y w₂ L₂ (h.nodup_right hL)))

name: Operad.May.fill_congr
statement:
theorem fill_congr (x : S A) {y y' : (a : A) → S (B a)} (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ l, y a = y' a) : fill x y l hl = fill x y' l hl

name: Operad.May.fill_cons
statement:
lemma fill_cons (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) (a : A) (l : List A) (h : (a :: l).Nodup) :
    fill x y (a :: l) h = SetOperad.map (stepEquiv a l (List.nodup_cons.1 h).1)
      (SetOperad.comp (Sum.inl ⟨a, (List.nodup_cons.1 h).1⟩ : Stage B l)
        (fill x y l (List.nodup_cons.1 h).2) (y a))

name: Operad.May.fill_nil
statement:
lemma fill_nil (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) (h : ([] : List A).Nodup) :
    fill x y [] h = SetOperad.map (initEquiv B) x

name: Operad.May.fill_one
statement:
theorem fill_one (x : S A) (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup) :
    ∃ e : A ≃ Stage (fun _ : A => Unit) l, (∀ a, unitVal (e a) = a) ∧
      fill x (fun _ => SetOperad.one) l hl = SetOperad.map e x

name: Operad.May.fill_perm
statement:
theorem fill_perm (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) {l l' : List A} (hp : l.Perm l')
    (hl : l.Nodup) (hl' : l'.Nodup) :
    SetOperad.map (stagePerm (B := B) fun _ => hp.mem_iff) (fill x y l hl) = fill x y l' hl'

name: Operad.May.map_congr
statement:
lemma map_congr {e e' : P ≃ P'} (h : ∀ p, e p = e' p) (X : S P) :
    SetOperad.map e X = SetOperad.map e' X

name: Operad.May.map_map
statement:
lemma map_map (e : P ≃ P') (f : P' ≃ Q) (X : S P) :
    SetOperad.map f (SetOperad.map e X) = SetOperad.map (e.trans f) X

name: Operad.May.mem_others
statement: lemma mem_others (a b : A) : b ∈ a :: others a

name: Operad.May.one_comp_eq
statement:
lemma one_comp_eq (Y : S Q) :
    SetOperad.comp () SetOperad.one Y = SetOperad.map (leftUnitEquiv Q).symm Y

name: Operad.May.others_nodup
statement: lemma others_nodup (a : A) : (a :: others a).Nodup

name: Operad.May.splits_append
statement:
lemma splits_append {i : P} (L₁ : List (Without P i)) (L₂ : List Q) :
    Splits (L₂.map Sum.inr ++ L₁.map Sum.inl) (L₁.map Subtype.val) L₂

name: Operad.May.total_eq_comp
statement:
theorem total_eq_comp (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) (a : A) :
    SetOperad.total x y = SetOperad.map
      ((stepEquiv a (others a) (List.nodup_cons.1 (others_nodup a)).1).trans
        (finalEquiv B _ (mem_others a)))
      (SetOperad.comp
        (Sum.inl ⟨a, (List.nodup_cons.1 (others_nodup a)).1⟩ : Stage B (others a))
        (fill x y (others a) (List.nodup_cons.1 (others_nodup a)).2) (y a))

name: Operad.SetOperad.total_eq_fill
statement:
theorem total_eq_fill (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup)
    (hc : ∀ a, a ∈ l) : total x y = map (finalEquiv B l hc) (fill x y l hl)

name: Operad.SetOperad.total_one_left
statement:
theorem total_one_left (y : (u : Unit) → S (E u)) :
    map (Equiv.uniqueSigma E) (total one y) = y ()

name: Operad.SetOperad.total_one_right
statement:
theorem total_one_right (x : S A) :
    map (Equiv.sigmaPUnit A) (total x fun _ => (one : S Unit)) = x

name: Operad.SymOperad.fill_add
statement:
lemma fill_add (x x' : Q A) (y : (a : A) → Q (B a)) (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup) :
    fill R (x + x') y l hl = fill R x y l hl + fill R x' y l hl

name: Operad.SymOperad.fill_cons
statement:
lemma fill_cons (x : Q A) (y : (a : A) → Q (B a)) (a : A) (l : List A) (h : (a :: l).Nodup) :
    fill R x y (a :: l) h = map (R := R) (stepEquiv a l (List.nodup_cons.1 h).1)
      (comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨a, (List.nodup_cons.1 h).1⟩ : Stage B l)
        (fill R x y l (List.nodup_cons.1 h).2) (y a))

name: Operad.SymOperad.fill_nil
statement:
lemma fill_nil (x : Q A) (y : (a : A) → Q (B a)) (h : ([] : List A).Nodup) :
    fill R x y [] h = map (R := R) (initEquiv B) x

name: Operad.SymOperad.fill_smul
statement:
lemma fill_smul (c : R) (x : Q A) (y : (a : A) → Q (B a)) (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup) :
    fill R (c • x) y l hl = c • fill R x y l hl

name: Operad.SymOperad.total_add
statement:
theorem total_add (x x' : Q A) (y : (a : A) → Q (B a)) :
    total R (x + x') y = total R x y + total R x' y

name: Operad.SymOperad.total_eq_fill
statement:
lemma total_eq_fill (x : Q A) (y : (a : A) → Q (B a)) (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup)
    (hc : ∀ a, a ∈ l) : total R x y = map (R := R) (finalEquiv B l hc) (fill R x y l hl)

name: Operad.SymOperad.total_one_left
statement:
theorem total_one_left {E : Unit → Type} [∀ u, Fintype (E u)] [∀ u, DecidableEq (E u)]
    (y : (u : Unit) → Q (E u)) :
    map (R := R) (Equiv.uniqueSigma E) (total R (one R) y) = y ()

name: Operad.SymOperad.total_one_right
statement:
theorem total_one_right (x : Q A) :
    map (R := R) (Equiv.sigmaPUnit A) (total R x fun _ => (one R : Q Unit)) = x

name: Operad.SymOperad.total_smul
statement:
theorem total_smul (c : R) (x : Q A) (y : (a : A) → Q (B a)) :
    total R (c • x) y = c • total R x y

name: Operad.SymOperad.total_update
statement:
lemma total_update (x : Q A) (y : (a : A) → Q (B a)) (a : A) (v : Q (B a)) :
    total R x (Function.update y a v)
      = map (R := R) ((stepEquiv a (others a) (List.nodup_cons.1 (others_nodup a)).1).trans
          (finalEquiv B _ (mem_others a)))
        (comp (R := R)
          (Sum.inl ⟨a, (List.nodup_cons.1 (others_nodup a)).1⟩ : Stage B (others a))
          (fill R x y (others a) (List.nodup_cons.1 (others_nodup a)).2) v)

name: Operad.SymOperad.total_update_add
statement:
theorem total_update_add (x : Q A) (y : (a : A) → Q (B a)) (a : A) (v v' : Q (B a)) :
    total R x (Function.update y a (v + v'))
      = total R x (Function.update y a v) + total R x (Function.update y a v')

name: Operad.SymOperad.total_update_smul
statement:
theorem total_update_smul (x : Q A) (y : (a : A) → Q (B a)) (a : A) (c : R) (v : Q (B a)) :
    total R x (Function.update y a (c • v)) = c • total R x (Function.update y a v)

name: Operad.May.fill_units
statement:
theorem fill_units (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup)
    (hy : ∀ a ∈ l, ∃ τ : Unit ≃ B a, y a = SetOperad.map τ SetOperad.one) :
    ∃ e : A ≃ Stage B l, (∀ a, stageVal (e a) = a) ∧ fill x y l hl = SetOperad.map e x

name: Operad.May.stageVal_step_inl
statement:
lemma stageVal_step_inl {a : A} {l : List A} (ha : a ∉ l)
    (s : Without (Stage B l) (Sum.inl ⟨a, ha⟩)) :
    stageVal (stepEquiv a l ha (Sum.inl s)) = stageVal s.1

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.comp_assoc_par
statement:
theorem comp_assoc_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S D) :
    map (parEquiv hik B D) (comp (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (comp i x y) z)
      = comp (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (comp k x z) y

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.comp_assoc_seq
statement:
theorem comp_assoc_seq (i : A) (j : B) (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S D) :
    map (seqEquiv i j D) (comp (Sum.inr j) (comp i x y) z) = comp i x (comp j y z)

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.comp_def
statement: lemma comp_def (i : A) (x : S A) (y : S B) : comp i x y = map (padEquiv i B) (total x (pad i y))

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.comp_one
statement: theorem comp_one (i : A) (x : S A) : map (rightUnitEquiv i) (comp i x one) = x

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.ext_of
statement:
theorem ext_of {I J : MaySetOperad S}
    (hmap : ∀ {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
      (x : S A), @MaySetOperad.map S I A B _ _ _ _ e x = @MaySetOperad.map S J A B _ _ _ _ e x)
    (hone : @MaySetOperad.one S I = @MaySetOperad.one S J)
    (htotal : ∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {B : A → Type} [∀ a, Fintype (B a)]
      [∀ a, DecidableEq (B a)] (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)),
      @MaySetOperad.total S I A _ _ B _ _ x y = @MaySetOperad.total S J A _ _ B _ _ x y) :
    I = J

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.fill_toSetOperad
statement:
theorem fill_toSetOperad (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup) :
    @May.fill S toSetOperad A _ _ B _ _ x y l hl = map (padLEquiv B l) (total x (padL l y))

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    map (compEquiv σ τ i) (comp i x y) = comp (σ i) (map σ x) (map τ y)

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.map_congr
statement: lemma map_congr {e e' : P ≃ P'} (h : ∀ p, e p = e' p) (X : S P) : map e X = map e' X

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.map_map
statement: lemma map_map (e : P ≃ P') (f : P' ≃ Q) (X : S P) : map f (map e X) = map (e.trans f) X

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.map_symm_map
statement: lemma map_symm_map (e : P ≃ P') (X : S P) : map e.symm (map e X) = X

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.one_comp
statement: theorem one_comp (y : S B) : map (leftUnitEquiv B) (comp () one y) = y

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.padL_of_mem
statement:
lemma padL_of_mem {l : List A} {a : A} (h : a ∈ l) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) :
    padL l y a = map (padLIn h) (y a)

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.padL_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma padL_of_not_mem {l : List A} {a : A} (h : a ∉ l) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) :
    padL l y a = map (padLOut h) one

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.pad_inr
statement:
lemma pad_inr (i : A) (j : B) (z : S D) (b : B) :
    pad (Sum.inr j : Without A i ⊕ B) z (padEquiv i B ⟨i, padIn rfl b⟩)
      = map (padInr i j D b) (pad j z b)

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.pad_map
statement:
lemma pad_map (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (y : S B) (a : A) :
    pad (σ i) (map τ y) (σ a) = map (padCongr σ τ i a) (pad i y a)

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.pad_of_eq
statement: lemma pad_of_eq {i a : A} (h : a = i) (y : S B) : pad i y a = map (padIn h) y

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.pad_of_ne
statement: lemma pad_of_ne {i a : A} (h : a ≠ i) (y : S B) : pad i y a = map (padOut h) one

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.pad_one
statement: lemma pad_one (i a : A) : pad i (one : S Unit) a = map (padUnit i a) one

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.total_assoc'
statement:
lemma total_assoc' {C : (Σ a, W a) → Type} [∀ p, Fintype (C p)] [∀ p, DecidableEq (C p)]
    (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (W a)) (z : (p : Σ a, W a) → S (C p)) :
    total (total x y) z
      = map (Equiv.sigmaAssoc fun a b => C ⟨a, b⟩).symm
          (total x fun a => total (y a) fun b => z ⟨a, b⟩)

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.total_congr
statement:
lemma total_congr (x : S A) (w : (a : A) → S (W a)) (τ : ∀ a, W a ≃ W' a) :
    total x (fun a => map (τ a) (w a)) = map (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ) (total x w)

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.total_map_left
statement:
lemma total_map_left (σ : A ≃ A') (x : S A) (w : (a : A') → S (V a)) :
    total (map σ x) w
      = map (Equiv.sigmaCongr σ fun a => Equiv.refl (V (σ a))) (total x fun a => w (σ a))

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.total_one_left'
statement:
lemma total_one_left' {E : Unit → Type} [∀ u, Fintype (E u)] [∀ u, DecidableEq (E u)]
    (y : (u : Unit) → S (E u)) : total one y = map (unitSigma E).symm (y ())

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.total_one_right'
statement: lemma total_one_right' (x : S A) : total x (fun _ => one) = map (Equiv.sigmaPUnit A).symm x

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.total_padL_step
statement:
lemma total_padL_step (a : A) (l : List A) (ha : a ∉ l) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) (b : A) :
    total (padL l y b)
        (fun u => pad (Sum.inl ⟨a, ha⟩ : Stage B l) (y a) (padLEquiv B l ⟨b, u⟩))
      = map (padLStep a l ha b) (padL (a :: l) y b)

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.total_pad_par
statement:
lemma total_pad_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (y : S B) (z : S D) (a : A) :
    total (pad i y a)
        (fun b =>
          pad (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩ : Without A i ⊕ B) z (padEquiv i B ⟨a, b⟩))
      = map (parPad hik B D a) (total (pad k z a)
          fun d => pad (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩ : Without A k ⊕ D) y (padEquiv k D ⟨a, d⟩))

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.total_pad_seq
statement:
lemma total_pad_seq (i : A) (j : B) (y : S B) (z : S D) (a : A) :
    total (pad i y a) (fun b => pad (Sum.inr j : Without A i ⊕ B) z (padEquiv i B ⟨a, b⟩))
      = map (seqPad i j D a) (pad i (comp j y z) a)

name: Operad.MaySetOperad.total_toSetOperad
statement:
theorem total_toSetOperad (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) :
    @SetOperad.total S toSetOperad A _ _ B _ _ x y = total x y

name: Operad.SetOperad.ext_of
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.SetOperad.ext_of {I J : SetOperad S}
    (hmap : ∀ {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
      (x : S A), @SetOperad.map S I A B _ _ _ _ e x = @SetOperad.map S J A B _ _ _ _ e x)
    (hone : @SetOperad.one S I = @SetOperad.one S J)
    (hcomp : ∀ {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
      (x : S A) (y : S B),
      @SetOperad.comp S I A B _ _ _ _ i x y = @SetOperad.comp S J A B _ _ _ _ i x y) :
    I = J

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirrorEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirrorEquiv_apply {f : E → E} (hf : Function.Involutive f) {n : ℕ}
    (t : OfArity E n) : mirrorEquiv hf n t = mirror f t

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_bl
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_bl (f : E → E) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : E) :
    mirror f (bl e₁ e₂ e₃) = bl (f e₁) (f e₃) (f e₂)

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_cor
statement: @[simp] lemma mirror_cor (f : E → E) (e : E) : mirror f (cor e) = cor (f e)

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_lc
statement: @[simp] lemma mirror_lc (f : E → E) (e e' : E) : mirror f (lc e e') = rc (f e) (f e')

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_ll
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_ll (f : E → E) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : E) :
    mirror f (ll e₁ e₂ e₃) = rr (f e₁) (f e₂) (f e₃)

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_lr
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_lr (f : E → E) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : E) :
    mirror f (lr e₁ e₂ e₃) = rl (f e₁) (f e₂) (f e₃)

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_mirror
statement:
lemma mirror_mirror {f : E → E} (hf : Function.Involutive f) {n : ℕ} (t : OfArity E n) :
    mirror f (mirror f t) = t

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_rc
statement: @[simp] lemma mirror_rc (f : E → E) (e e' : E) : mirror f (rc e e') = lc (f e) (f e')

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_rl
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_rl (f : E → E) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : E) :
    mirror f (rl e₁ e₂ e₃) = lr (f e₁) (f e₂) (f e₃)

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_rr
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_rr (f : E → E) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : E) :
    mirror f (rr e₁ e₂ e₃) = ll (f e₁) (f e₂) (f e₃)

name: Operad.BTree.arity_mirror
statement:
lemma arity_mirror (f : E → E) : ∀ t : BTree E, (mirror f t).arity = t.arity
  | leaf => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    rw [mirror_node, arity_node, arity_node, arity_mirror f l, arity_mirror f r, Nat.add_comm]

name: Operad.BTree.mirror_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma mirror_leaf (f : E → E) : mirror f (leaf : BTree E) = leaf

name: Operad.BTree.mirror_mirror
statement:
lemma mirror_mirror {f : E → E} (hf : Function.Involutive f) :
    ∀ t : BTree E, mirror f (mirror f t) = t
  | leaf => rfl
  | node e l r => by rw [mirror_node, mirror_node, mirror_mirror hf l, mirror_mirror hf r, hf e]

name: Operad.BTree.mirror_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_node (f : E → E) (e : E) (l r : BTree E) :
    mirror f (node e l r) = node (f e) (mirror f r) (mirror f l)

name: Operad.ML.eq_of_sub_mem
statement:
theorem eq_of_sub_mem (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M) W)

name: Operad.ML.finsuppLift'_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma finsuppLift'_single (g : (∀ i, X i) → W) (t : ∀ i, X i) :

name: Operad.ML.finsuppLift'_update
statement:
lemma finsuppLift'_update (g : (∀ i, X i) → W) (t : ∀ i, X i) (i : ι) (z : X i →₀ R) :
    finsuppLift' (R := R) g (update (fun j => Finsupp.single (t j) 1) i z)
      = Finsupp.lift W R (X i) (fun y => g (update t i y)) z

name: Operad.ML.finsuppLift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finsuppLift_eq_zero [Nonempty X] (g : (ι → X) → W) (N : Submodule R (X →₀ R))
    (hg : ∀ (t : ι → X) (i : ι),
      N ≤ LinearMap.ker (Finsupp.lift W R X fun y => g (update t i y)))
    (x : ι → X →₀ R) (i : ι) (hx : x i ∈ N) : finsuppLift (R := R) g x = 0

name: Operad.ML.finsuppLift_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma finsuppLift_single (g : (ι → X) → W) (t : ι → X) :

name: Operad.ML.finsupp_ext

name: Operad.ML.liftQ'_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftQ'_mk (f : MultilinearMap R M W)

lemma liftQ'_mkQ (f : MultilinearMap R M W)

statement:
@[simp] lemma liftQ_mk (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M) W)
    (hf : ∀ (x : ι → M) (i : ι), x i ∈ N → f x = 0) (x : ι → M) :

name: Operad.ML.liftQ_mkQ
statement:
lemma liftQ_mkQ (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M) W)

Operad.ML.rep_add_sub_mem

name: Operad.Perm.compL_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compL_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) (β : Perm R n) :
    compL a b α β = permComp a b α β

name: Operad.Perm.comp_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_eq (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) (β : Perm R n) :
    NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b α β = permComp a b α β

name: Operad.Perm.one_eq
statement: @[simp] lemma one_eq : (NSOperad.one (R := R) (P := Perm R)) = permOne

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_add_left
statement:
lemma permComp_add_left (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α α' : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) (β : Perm R n) :
    permComp a b (α + α') β = permComp a b α β + permComp a b α' β

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_add_right
statement:
lemma permComp_add_right (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) (β β' : Perm R n) :
    permComp a b α (β + β') = permComp a b α β + permComp a b α β'

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_apply_ge
statement:
lemma permComp_apply_ge (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) (β : Perm R n)
    (j : Fin (a + n + b)) (h : a + n ≤ (j : ℕ)) (hlt : (j : ℕ) - n + 1 < a + 1 + b) :
    permComp a b α β j = (∑ t, β t) * α ⟨(j : ℕ) - n + 1, hlt⟩

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_apply_lt
statement:
lemma permComp_apply_lt (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) (β : Perm R n)
    (j : Fin (a + n + b)) (h : (j : ℕ) < a) (hlt : (j : ℕ) < a + 1 + b) :
    permComp a b α β j = (∑ t, β t) * α ⟨(j : ℕ), hlt⟩

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_apply_mid
statement:
lemma permComp_apply_mid (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) (β : Perm R n)
    (j : Fin (a + n + b)) (h1 : a ≤ (j : ℕ)) (h2 : (j : ℕ) < a + n)
    (ha : a < a + 1 + b) (hb : (j : ℕ) - a < n) :
    permComp a b α β j = α ⟨a, ha⟩ * β ⟨(j : ℕ) - a, hb⟩

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_assoc_par
statement:
theorem permComp_assoc_par (a b c : ℕ) {n p : ℕ} (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b + 1 + c))
    (β : Perm R n) (γ : Perm R p) :
    reindex R (Perm R) (show a + n + b + p + c = a + n + (b + p + c) by omega)
        (permComp (a + n + b) c
          (reindex R (Perm R) (show a + n + (b + 1 + c) = a + n + b + 1 + c by omega)
            (permComp a (b + 1 + c)
              (reindex R (Perm R) (show a + 1 + b + 1 + c = a + 1 + (b + 1 + c) by omega) α)
              β)) γ)
      = permComp a (b + p + c)
          (reindex R (Perm R) (show a + 1 + b + p + c = a + 1 + (b + p + c) by omega)
            (permComp (a + 1 + b) c α γ)) β

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_assoc_seq
statement:
theorem permComp_assoc_seq (a b c d : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b))
    (β : Perm R (c + 1 + d)) (γ : Perm R p) :
    reindex R (Perm R) (show a + c + p + (d + b) = a + (c + p + d) + b by omega)
        (permComp (a + c) (d + b)
          (reindex R (Perm R) (show a + (c + 1 + d) + b = a + c + 1 + (d + b) by omega)
            (permComp a b α β)) γ)
      = permComp a b α (permComp c d β γ)

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_one_left
statement:
theorem permComp_one_left {n : ℕ} (α : Perm R n) :
    reindex R (Perm R) (show 0 + n + 0 = n by omega) (permComp 0 0 permOne α) = α

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_one_right
statement:
theorem permComp_one_right (a b : ℕ) (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) :
    permComp a b α permOne = α

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_smul_left
statement:
lemma permComp_smul_left (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (r : R) (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) (β : Perm R n) :
    permComp a b (r • α) β = r • permComp a b α β

name: Operad.Perm.permComp_smul_right
statement:
lemma permComp_smul_right (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (r : R) (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) (β : Perm R n) :
    permComp a b α (r • β) = r • permComp a b α β

name: Operad.Perm.reindex_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma reindex_apply {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : Perm R m) (j : Fin n) :
    reindex R (Perm R) h x j = x ⟨(j : ℕ), by have := j.isLt; omega⟩

name: Operad.Perm.sum_permComp
statement:
theorem sum_permComp (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : Perm R (a + 1 + b)) (β : Perm R n) :
    (∑ j, permComp a b α β j) = (∑ i, α i) * ∑ t, β t

name: Operad.Perm.sum_permOne
statement: lemma sum_permOne : (∑ t, (permOne : Perm R 1) t) = 1

name: Operad.Perm.sum_split3
statement:
lemma sum_split3 {M : Type u} [AddCommMonoid M] {a n b : ℕ} (f : Fin (a + n + b) → M) :
    ∑ j, f j
      = ((∑ i : Fin a, f (Fin.castAdd b (Fin.castAdd n i)))
          + ∑ i : Fin n, f (Fin.castAdd b (Fin.natAdd a i)))
        + ∑ i : Fin b, f (Fin.natAdd (a + n) i)

name: Operad.Perm.val_mk'
statement: lemma val_mk' {n : ℕ} (x : ℕ) (h : x < n) : ((⟨x, h⟩ : Fin n) : ℕ) = x

name: Operad.Sym.insertEquiv_inl_val
statement:
lemma insertEquiv_inl_val (a b n : ℕ) (k : Without (Fin (a + 1 + b)) ⟨a, by omega⟩) :
    ((insertEquiv a b n (Sum.inl k) : Fin (a + n + b)) : ℕ)
      = if (k.1 : ℕ) < a then (k.1 : ℕ) else (k.1 : ℕ) + n - 1

name: Operad.Sym.insertEquiv_inr_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma insertEquiv_inr_val (a b n : ℕ) (j : Fin n) :
    ((insertEquiv a b n (Sum.inr j) : Fin (a + n + b)) : ℕ) = a + j

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_map_left
statement:
lemma comp_map_left (σ : A ≃ A') (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) (σ i) (map (R := R) σ x) y
      = map (R := R) (compEquiv σ (Equiv.refl B) i) (comp (R := R) i x y)

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_map_right
statement:
lemma comp_map_right (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) i x (map (R := R) τ y)
      = map (R := R) (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Without A i)) τ) (comp (R := R) i x y)

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_slot
statement:
lemma comp_slot {i i' : A} (h : i = i') (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) i' x y = map (R := R) (slotEquiv h) (comp (R := R) i x y)

name: Operad.SymOperad.nsComp_apply
statement:
lemma nsComp_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : P (Fin (a + 1 + b))) (y : P (Fin n)) :
    nsComp (R := R) a b x y
      = map (R := R) (insertEquiv a b n) (comp (R := R) (⟨a, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + 1 + b)) x y)

name: Operad.LinNS.compL_single

    compL R a b (Finsupp.single s r) (Finsupp.single t r')

name: Operad.LinNS.reindex_single

    reindex R (LinNS R S) h (Finsupp.single s r) = Finsupp.single (reindexS S h s) r

name: Operad.SetOperad.single_nsOneSet

name: Operad.reindexS_injective

name: Operad.reindexS_reindexS
statement:
@[simp] lemma reindexS_reindexS {l m n : ℕ} (h₁ : l = m) (h₂ : m = n) (x : S l) :

name: Operad.reindexS_self

name: Operad.NSPres.compFn_mk

name: Operad.NSPres.comp_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_mk (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : NSSyn T (a + 1 + b)) (y : NSSyn T n) :
    NSSetOperad.comp a b (mk (ρ := ρ) x) (mk y) = mk (.comp a b x y)

name: Operad.NSPres.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : NSSetOperadHom (NSPres T ρ) S}
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : T n), φ.app _ (gen g) = ψ.app _ (gen g)) : φ = ψ

name: Operad.NSPres.lift_gen
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_gen (f : ∀ n, T n → S n) (hf : Respects ρ f) {n : ℕ} (g : T n) :
    (lift f hf).app n (gen g) = f n g

name: Operad.NSPres.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk (f : ∀ n, T n → S n) (hf : Respects ρ f) {n : ℕ} (x : NSSyn T n) :
    (lift f hf).app n (mk x) = NSSyn.eval f x

name: Operad.NSPres.mk_eq_mk_of_rel
statement: lemma mk_eq_mk_of_rel {n : ℕ} {x y : NSSyn T n} (h : ρ n x y) : mk (ρ := ρ) x = mk y

name: Operad.NSPres.mk_surjective
statement: lemma mk_surjective {n : ℕ} : Function.Surjective (mk (ρ := ρ) (n := n))

name: Operad.NSPres.reindexS_mk
statement:

name: Operad.NSPres.respects_app
statement:
lemma respects_app (φ : NSSetOperadHom (NSPres T ρ) S) :

name: Operad.NSSyn.Rel.reindexS

name: Operad.NSSyn.eval_comp

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.bin_bin_of_left_right
statement:
theorem bin_bin_of_left_right {p q p' q' : S 2} (h : leftComb p q = rightComb p' q')
    (X Y Z : Arr S) : bin p (bin q X Y) Z = bin p' X (bin q' Y Z)

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.bin_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma bin_fst (g : S 2) (X Y : Arr S) : (bin g X Y).1 = X.1 + Y.1

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.bin_left_of
statement:
theorem bin_left_of {p q p' q' : S 2} (h : leftComb p q = leftComb p' q') (X Y Z : Arr S) :
    bin p (bin q X Y) Z = bin p' (bin q' X Y) Z

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.bin_one_one
statement: theorem bin_one_one (g : S 2) : bin g one one = ⟨2, g⟩

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.bin_right_of
statement:
theorem bin_right_of {p q p' q' : S 2} (h : rightComb p q = rightComb p' q') (X Y Z : Arr S) :

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_bin_left
statement:
theorem comp_bin_left (g : S 2) (X Y W : Arr S) {a : ℕ} (ha : a < X.1) :
    comp (bin g X Y) a W = bin g (comp X a W) Y

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_bin_right
statement:
theorem comp_bin_right (g : S 2) (X Y W : Arr S) {a c : ℕ} (h : a = X.1 + c) (hc : c < Y.1) :
    comp (bin g X Y) a W = bin g X (comp Y c W)

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_comp_disjoint
statement:
theorem comp_comp_disjoint {X : Arr S} (Y Z : Arr S) {a e : ℕ} (hae : a < e) (he : e < X.1) :
    comp (comp X a Y) (e + Y.1 - 1) Z = comp (comp X e Z) a Y

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_comp_nested
statement:
theorem comp_comp_nested {X Y : Arr S} (Z : Arr S) {a c : ℕ} (ha : a < X.1) (hc : c < Y.1) :
    comp (comp X a Y) (a + c) Z = comp X a (comp Y c Z)

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_fst
statement:
lemma comp_fst {X : Arr S} {a : ℕ} (h : a < X.1) (Y : Arr S) :

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_one
statement: theorem comp_one {X : Arr S} {a : ℕ} (h : a < X.1) : comp X a one = X

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.exists_mk

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.map_comp

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.map_one

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.map_rcomb

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.mk_comp

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.one_fst

statement: lemma rcomb_cons (g : S 2) (l : List (S 2)) : rcomb (g :: l) = bin g one (rcomb l)

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.rcomb_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma rcomb_fst (l : List (S 2)) : (rcomb l).1 = l.length + 1

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.rcomb_nil

statement: lemma rcomb_singleton (g : S 2) : rcomb [g] = ⟨2, g⟩

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.rightComb_eq

statement:
lemma subst_leftComb (p q : S 2) (X Y Z : Arr S) :
    comp (comp (comp (leftComb p q) 2 Z) 1 Y) 0 X = bin p (bin q X Y) Z

lemma subst_rightComb (p q : S 2) (X Y Z : Arr S) :

name: Operad.PBW.ctxL_apply
statement:
lemma ctxL_apply (u v : List I) (x : List I →₀ R) :
    ctxL R u v x = mapDomain (fun w => u ++ w ++ v) x

name: Operad.PBW.ctxL_nil
statement: lemma ctxL_nil : ctxL R ([] : List I) [] = LinearMap.id

name: Operad.PBW.ctxL_single
statement:
lemma ctxL_single (u v w : List I) (c : R) :
    ctxL R u v (single w c) = single (u ++ w ++ v) c

name: Operad.PBW.exists_descent
statement:
lemma exists_descent : ∀ {w : List I}, ¬ w.IsChain (· ≤ ·) →
    ∃ u x y v, w = u ++ [x, y] ++ v ∧ ¬ x ≤ y
  | [], h => absurd List.IsChain.nil h
  | [a], h => absurd (List.IsChain.singleton a) h
  | a :: c :: w, h => by
    rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at h
    by_cases hac : a ≤ c
    · obtain ⟨u, x, y, v, hw, hxy⟩

name: Operad.PBW.lead_eq
statement: lemma lead_eq (r : Pair I) : (rules R b).lead r = [r.1.2, r.1.1]

name: Operad.PBW.lin_apply
statement: lemma lin_apply (x : g) : lin R b x = mapDomain (fun a => [a]) (b.repr x)

name: Operad.PBW.lin_basis
statement: lemma lin_basis (a : I) : lin R b (b a) = single [a] 1

name: Operad.PBW.lin_swap
statement:
lemma lin_swap {s : Set (List I)} (hs : ∀ w : List I, w.length = 2 → w ∈ s) (c : I) (x : g) :
    ctxL R [c] [] (lin R b x) - ctxL R [] [c] (lin R b x) - lin R b ⁅b c, x⁆ ∈
      (sys R b).idealOn s

name: Operad.PBW.lmul_mk
statement:
lemma lmul_mk (a : I) (x : List I →₀ R) :
    lmul R b a (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (ctxL R [a] [] x)

name: Operad.PBW.normal_iff_isChain
statement:
lemma normal_iff_isChain (w : List I) :
    (rules R b).Normal (b := ()) w ↔ w.IsChain (· ≤ ·)

name: Operad.PBW.overlap_res
statement:
theorem overlap_res {i j k : I} (hij : i < j) (hjk : j < k) :
    ctxL R [] [i] ((rules R b).tail ⟨(j, k), hjk⟩) -
      ctxL R [k] [] ((rules R b).tail ⟨(i, j), hij⟩) ∈
        (sys R b).idealOn ((sys R b).below [k, j, i])

name: Operad.PBW.prodι_append
statement: lemma prodι_append (u v : List I) : prodι R b (u ++ v) = prodι R b u * prodι R b v

name: Operad.PBW.prodι_cons
statement: lemma prodι_cons (a : I) (w : List I) : prodι R b (a :: w) = ι R (b a) * prodι R b w

name: Operad.PBW.red_ctx
statement:
lemma red_ctx (r : Pair I) (u v : List I) :
    ctxL R u v ((rules R b).tail r) ∈ (sys R b).red (u ++ [r.1.2, r.1.1] ++ v)

name: Operad.PBW.rel_mem
statement:
lemma rel_mem {s : Set (List I)} {i j : I} (h : i < j) (u v : List I)
    (hs : u ++ [j, i] ++ v ∈ s) :
    single (u ++ [j, i] ++ v) 1 - (single (u ++ [i, j] ++ v) 1 +
      ctxL R u v (lin R b ⁅b j, b i⁆)) ∈ (sys R b).idealOn s

name: Operad.PBW.res_critical
statement:
theorem res_critical {r₁ r₂ : Pair I} (B : (rules R b).Amb () r₁ r₂)
    (hB : Critical (rules R b) B) : B.Res

name: Operad.PBW.resolvable
statement: theorem resolvable : (sys R b).Resolvable

name: Operad.PBW.small_lists
statement:
lemma small_lists : ∀ {u v : List I}, u.length + v.length < 2 →
    (u = [] ∧ v = []) ∨ (u = [] ∧ ∃ d, v = [d]) ∨ (∃ c, u = [c] ∧ v = [])
  | [], [], _ => Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | [], [d], _ => Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, d, rfl⟩)
  | [], _ :: _ :: _, h => by simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at h; omega
  | [c], [], _ => Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨c, rfl, rfl⟩)
  | [_], _ :: _, h => by simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at h; omega
  | _ :: _ :: _, _, h => by simp only [List.length_cons] at h; omega

name: Operad.PBW.swap_mem
statement:
lemma swap_mem {s : Set (List I)} (hs : ∀ w : List I, w.length = 2 → w ∈ s) (c a : I) :
    single [c, a] 1 - single [a, c] 1 - lin R b ⁅b c, b a⁆ ∈ (sys R b).idealOn s

name: Operad.PBW.tail_eq
statement:
lemma tail_eq (r : Pair I) :
    (rules R b).tail r = single [r.1.1, r.1.2] 1 + lin R b ⁅b r.1.2, b r.1.1⁆

name: Operad.PBW.toU_ctxL
statement:
lemma toU_ctxL (u v : List I) (x : List I →₀ R) :
    toU R b (ctxL R u v x) = prodι R b u * toU R b x * prodι R b v

name: Operad.PBW.toU_single
statement: lemma toU_single (w : List I) (c : R) : toU R b (single w c) = c • prodι R b w

name: Operad.PBW.ρ₀_basis
statement: lemma ρ₀_basis (a : I) : ρ₀ R b (b a) = lmul R b a

name: Operad.PBW.ρ₀_lie
statement: lemma ρ₀_lie (x y : g) : ρ₀ R b ⁅x, y⁆ = ρ₀ R b x * ρ₀ R b y - ρ₀ R b y * ρ₀ R b x

name: Operad.PBW.ρ₀_mk
statement:
lemma ρ₀_mk (y : g) (w : List I) :
    ρ₀ R b y (Submodule.Quotient.mk (single w 1)) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (ctxL R [] w (lin R b y))

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_2_2_one
statement:
lemma compFin_2_2_one : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (1 : Fin 2) x y
    = ![x 0 * (y 0 + y 1), x 1 * y 0, x 1 * y 1]

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_2_2_zero
statement:
lemma compFin_2_2_zero : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (0 : Fin 2) x y
    = ![x 0 * y 0, x 0 * y 1, x 1 * (y 0 + y 1)]

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_2_3_one
statement:

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_2_3_zero
statement:
lemma compFin_2_3_zero : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (0 : Fin 2) x z
    = ![x 0 * z 0, x 0 * z 1, x 0 * z 2, x 1 * (z 0 + z 1 + z 2)]

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_3_2_one
statement:
lemma compFin_3_2_one : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (1 : Fin 3) z x
    = ![z 0 * (x 0 + x 1), z 1 * x 0, z 1 * x 1, z 2 * (x 0 + x 1)]

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_3_2_two
statement:
lemma compFin_3_2_two : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (2 : Fin 3) z x
    = ![z 0 * (x 0 + x 1), z 1 * (x 0 + x 1), z 2 * x 0, z 2 * x 1]

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_3_2_zero
statement:
lemma compFin_3_2_zero : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (0 : Fin 3) z x
    = ![z 0 * x 0, z 0 * x 1, z 1 * (x 0 + x 1), z 2 * (x 0 + x 1)]

name: Operad.Perm.mem_sumZero

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_map
statement:
lemma bin_map (g : S (Fin 2)) (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (x : S A) (y : S B) :

statement:

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_map_right
statement:
lemma bin_map_right (g : S (Fin 2)) (τ : B ≃ B') (x : S A) (y : S B) :

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_one_one
statement: lemma bin_one_one (g : S (Fin 2)) : bin g one one = map finTwoSum g

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_swap

lemma bin_swap (g : S (Fin 2)) (x : S A) (y : S B) :

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_inl_bin
statement:
lemma comp_inl_bin (g : S (Fin 2)) (a : A) (u : S A) (v : S B) (y : S C) :
    comp (Sum.inl a) (bin g u v) y = map (binLeftEquiv a) (bin g (comp a u y) v)

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_inr_bin
statement:
lemma comp_inr_bin (g : S (Fin 2)) (b : B) (u : S A) (v : S B) (y : S C) :

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_map_left
statement:
lemma comp_map_left (σ : A ≃ A') (i : A) (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    comp (σ i) (map σ x) y = map (compEquiv σ (Equiv.refl B) i) (comp i x y)

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_map_left_of
statement:
lemma comp_map_left_of (σ : A ≃ A') {i : A} {i' : A'} (h : σ i = i') (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    comp i' (map σ x) y
      = map ((compEquiv σ (Equiv.refl B) i).trans (slotEquiv h)) (comp i x y)

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_map_right
statement:
lemma comp_map_right (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    comp i x (map τ y) = map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Without A i)) τ) (comp i x y)

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_one'
statement: lemma comp_one' (i : A) (x : S A) : comp i x one = map (rightUnitEquiv i).symm x

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_slot

name: Operad.SetOperad.eq_map_symm_of_map_eq

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_congr

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_eq_self

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_map

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.comp_assoc

lemma comp_assoc {T : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*}

name: Operad.SetOperadWeight.defect_assoc_par
statement:
lemma defect_assoc_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (s : S A) (t : S B) (u : S D) :
    W.defect i s t + W.defect (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (SetOperad.comp i s t) u
      = W.defect k s u + W.defect (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (SetOperad.comp k s u) t

name: Operad.SetOperadWeight.defect_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma defect_assoc_seq (i : A) (j : B) (s : S A) (t : S B) (u : S D) :
    W.defect i s t + W.defect (Sum.inr j) (SetOperad.comp i s t) u
      = W.defect j t u + W.defect i s (SetOperad.comp j t u)

name: Operad.SetOperadWeight.defect_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma defect_eq_zero_iff (i : A) (s : S A) (t : S B) :
    W.defect i s t = 0 ↔ W.w _ (SetOperad.comp i s t) = W.w A s + W.w B t

name: Operad.SetOperadWeight.defect_map
statement:
lemma defect_map (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (s : S A) (t : S B) :
    W.defect (σ i) (SetOperad.map σ s) (SetOperad.map τ t) = W.defect i s t

name: Operad.SetOperadWeight.defect_one_left
statement: lemma defect_one_left (t : S B) : W.defect () SetOperad.one t = 0

name: Operad.SetOperadWeight.defect_one_right
statement: lemma defect_one_right (i : A) (s : S A) : W.defect i s SetOperad.one = 0

statement:
lemma w_comp_add_defect (i : A) (s : S A) (t : S B) :
    W.w _ (SetOperad.comp i s t) + W.defect i s t = W.w A s + W.w B t

statement:
lemma IsNormal.left {L : Set (LTree E)} {e : E} {l r : LTree E} (h : IsNormal L (node e l r)) :

statement:
lemma IsNormal.right {L : Set (LTree E)} {e : E} {l r : LTree E} (h : IsNormal L (node e l r)) :

name: Operad.LTree.arity_pos
statement:
lemma arity_pos : ∀ t : LTree E, 0 < t.arity
  | leaf _ => Nat.one_pos
  | node _ l _ => Nat.add_pos_left (arity_pos l) _

name: Operad.LTree.decorations_rightComb
statement:
lemma decorations_rightComb : ∀ (w : List E) (k : ℕ), (rightComb w k).decorations = w
  | [], _ => rfl
  | e :: w, k => by simp [rightComb, decorations, decorations_rightComb w (k + 1)]

name: Operad.LTree.doubleFactorial_two_mul_add_one
statement: lemma doubleFactorial_two_mul_add_one (n : ℕ) : (2 * n + 1)‼ = (2 * n + 1) * (2 * n - 1)‼

name: Operad.LTree.eq_rightComb_of_rightCombShape
statement:
theorem eq_rightComb_of_rightCombShape : ∀ (t : LTree E) (k : ℕ), t.IsRightCombShape →
    t.labels = List.range' k t.arity → t = rightComb t.decorations k
  | leaf a, k, _, hl => by
    simp only [labels_leaf, arity, List.range'_one] at hl
    obtain rfl

name: Operad.LTree.exists_graft
statement:
theorem exists_graft {a : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E), t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup → a ∈ t.labels →
    (∀ b ∈ t.labels, b ≤ a) → 2 ≤ t.arity →
    ∃ (s : LTree E) (p : ℕ) (e : E), p < s.size ∧ s.IsShuffle ∧ (∀ b ∈ s.labels, b < a) ∧
      graft e a s p = t
  | leaf _, _, _, _, _, h2 => absurd h2 (by simp [arity])
  | node f l r, hs, hnd, ha, hle, _ => by
    obtain ⟨h1, hsl, hsr⟩

name: Operad.LTree.graft_eq_node
statement:
lemma graft_eq_node (e : E) (a : ℕ) : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), p < t.size →
    ∃ g x y, graft e a t p = node g x y
  | t, 0, _ => ⟨e, t, leaf a, graft_zero e a t⟩
  | leaf _, _ + 1, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, _ => by
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩

name: Operad.LTree.graft_inj
statement:
theorem graft_inj {e e' : E} {a : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p p' : ℕ), a ∉ t.labels → p < t.size →
    p' < t.size → graft e a t p = graft e' a t p' → p = p' ∧ e = e'
  | t, 0, 0, _, _, _, h => by
    simp only [graft_zero, node.injEq] at h
    exact ⟨rfl, h.1⟩
  | _, 0, _ + 1, ha, _, hp', h => absurd h (graft_zero_ne e e' ha hp')
  | _, _ + 1, 0, ha, hp, _, h => absurd h.symm (graft_zero_ne e' e ha hp)
  | leaf _, _ + 1, _ + 1, _, hp, _, _ => by simp at hp
  | node f l r, p + 1, p' + 1, ha, hp, hp', h => by
    simp only [size_node] at hp hp'
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, not_or] at ha
    rw [graft_node_succ, graft_node_succ] at h
    split_ifs at h with h1 h2 h2
    · simp only [node.injEq, true_and, and_true] at h
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Operad.LTree.graft_node_succ
Operad.LTree.graft_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma graft_zero (e : E) (a : ℕ) (t : LTree E) : graft e a t 0 = node e t (leaf a)

name: Operad.LTree.graft_zero_ne
statement:
lemma graft_zero_ne (e e' : E) {a : ℕ} : ∀ {t : LTree E} {p : ℕ}, a ∉ t.labels →
    p + 1 < t.size → graft e a t 0 ≠ graft e' a t (p + 1)
  | leaf _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p, ha, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, not_or] at ha
    rw [graft_zero, graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · intro he
      simp only [node.injEq] at he
      obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩

name: Operad.LTree.isNormal_iff
statement:
theorem isNormal_iff {L : Set (LTree E)}
    (hL : ∀ e f : E, node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2) ∈ L ∧
      node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1) ∈ L)
    {n : ℕ} {t : LTree E} (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hl : t.labels.Perm (List.range n)) :
    IsNormal L t ↔ ∃ w : List E, t = rightComb w 0 ∧
      ∀ p ∈ w.zip w.tail, node p.1 (leaf 0) (node p.2 (leaf 1) (leaf 2)) ∉ L

name: Operad.LTree.isRightCombShape_of_normal
statement:
theorem isRightCombShape_of_normal {L : Set (LTree E)}
    (hL : ∀ e f : E, node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2) ∈ L ∧
      node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1) ∈ L) :
    ∀ t : LTree E, t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup → IsNormal L t → t.IsRightCombShape
  | leaf _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | node e (leaf a) r, hs, hnd, hn =>
    isRightCombShape_of_normal hL r hs.2.2 (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 hn.right
  | node e (node f a b) r, hs, hnd, hn => by
    have hw : window e f false a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel ∈ L

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_graft
statement:
lemma isShuffle_graft (e : E) {a : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), t.IsShuffle →
    (∀ b ∈ t.labels, b < a) → p < t.size → (graft e a t p).IsShuffle
  | t, 0, hs, ha, _ => by
    simp only [graft_zero, isShuffle_node, minLabel_leaf, isShuffle_leaf, and_true]
    exact ⟨ha _ (minLabel_mem t), hs⟩
  | leaf _, _ + 1, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, hs, ha, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append] at ha
    have hal : ∀ b ∈ l.labels, b < a := fun b hb => ha b (Or.inl hb)
    have har : ∀ b ∈ r.labels, b < a := fun b hb => ha b (Or.inr hb)
    obtain ⟨h1, hl, hr⟩

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma isShuffle_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : LTree E).IsShuffle

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma isShuffle_node (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    (node e l r).IsShuffle ↔ l.minLabel < r.minLabel ∧ l.IsShuffle ∧ r.IsShuffle

name: Operad.LTree.labels_graft
statement:
lemma labels_graft (e : E) (a : ℕ) : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), p < t.size →
    (graft e a t p).labels.Perm (t.labels ++ [a])
  | t, 0, _ => by simp
  | leaf _, _ + 1, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · simp only [labels_node, List.append_assoc]
      refine ((labels_graft e a l p hp).append_right _).trans ?_
      rw [List.append_assoc]
      exact List.Perm.append_left _ List.perm_append_comm
    · simp only [labels_node, List.append_assoc]
      exact (labels_graft e a r _ (by omega)).append_left _

name: Operad.LTree.labels_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma labels_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : LTree E).labels = [a]

name: Operad.LTree.labels_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma labels_node (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    (node e l r).labels = l.labels ++ r.labels

name: Operad.LTree.labels_rightComb
statement:
lemma labels_rightComb : ∀ (w : List E) (k : ℕ),
    (rightComb w k).labels = List.range' k (w.length + 1)
  | [], k => rfl
  | e :: w, k => by
    simp only [rightComb, labels_node, labels_leaf, labels_rightComb w (k + 1),
      List.length_cons, List.singleton_append]
    exact List.range'_succ.symm

name: Operad.LTree.labels_sorted_of_rightCombShape
statement:
theorem labels_sorted_of_rightCombShape :
    ∀ t : LTree E, t.IsShuffle → t.IsRightCombShape → t.labels.Pairwise (· < ·)
  | leaf _, _, _ => List.pairwise_singleton _ _
  | node e (leaf a) r, hs, hr => by
    have ih

name: Operad.LTree.length_labels
statement:
@[simp] lemma length_labels : ∀ t : LTree E, t.labels.length = t.arity
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [labels, arity, length_labels l, length_labels r]

name: Operad.LTree.mem_monomials
statement:
theorem mem_monomials : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : LTree E),
    t ∈ monomials n ↔ t.IsShuffle ∧ t.labels.Perm (List.range n)
  | 0, t => by
    simp only [monomials, Finset.notMem_empty, false_iff, not_and, List.range_zero,
      List.perm_nil]
    intro _ h
    have h1 := length_labels t
    have h2 := arity_pos t
    rw [h, List.length_nil] at h1
    omega
  | 1, t => by
    simp only [monomials, Finset.mem_singleton, List.range_one, List.perm_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨trivial, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
      cases t with
      | leaf b => simpa using h
      | node f l r =>
        have h1 := length_labels (node f l r)
        have := arity_pos l
        have := arity_pos r
        rw [h] at h1
        simp only [List.length_singleton, arity] at h1
        omega
  | n + 2, t => by
    simp only [monomials, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_product,
      Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Prod.exists, mem_monomials (n + 1)]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, ⟨hs, hsl⟩, p, e, hp, rfl⟩
      have hsize := size_of_perm hsl
      have hlt : ∀ b ∈ s.labels, b < n + 1 := fun b hb => List.mem_range.1 (hsl.subset hb)
      refine ⟨isShuffle_graft e s p hs hlt (by omega), ?_⟩
      refine (labels_graft e (n + 1) s p (by omega)).trans ?_
      rw [List.range_succ]
      exact hsl.append_right _
    · rintro ⟨hs, hl⟩
      have hlen := hl.length_eq
      rw [length_labels, List.length_range] at hlen
      obtain ⟨s, p, e, hp, hss, hsa, rfl⟩

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_graft
statement:
lemma minLabel_graft (e : E) {a : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), (∀ b ∈ t.labels, b < a) →
    p < t.size → (graft e a t p).minLabel = t.minLabel
  | t, 0, ha, _ => by
    simp only [graft_zero, minLabel_node, minLabel_leaf]
    exact min_eq_left (ha _ (minLabel_mem t)).le
  | leaf _, _ + 1, _, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, ha, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append] at ha
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · simp only [minLabel_node, minLabel_graft e l p (fun b hb => ha b (Or.inl hb)) hp]
    · simp only [minLabel_node,
        minLabel_graft e r (p - l.size) (fun b hb => ha b (Or.inr hb)) (by omega)]

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_le_of_mem
statement:
lemma minLabel_le_of_mem : ∀ (t : LTree E) {b : ℕ}, b ∈ t.labels → t.minLabel ≤ b
  | leaf a, b, hb => by simp at hb; simp [hb]
  | node e l r, b, hb => by
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append] at hb
    rcases hb with hb | hb
    · exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (minLabel_le_of_mem l hb)
    · exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (minLabel_le_of_mem r hb)

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma minLabel_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : LTree E).minLabel = a

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_mem
statement:
lemma minLabel_mem : ∀ t : LTree E, t.minLabel ∈ t.labels
  | leaf a => by simp
  | node _ l r => by
    simp only [minLabel_node, labels_node, List.mem_append]
    rcases min_choice l.minLabel r.minLabel with h | h <;> rw [h]
    · exact Or.inl (minLabel_mem l)
    · exact Or.inr (minLabel_mem r)

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma minLabel_node (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    (node e l r).minLabel = min l.minLabel r.minLabel

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_node_of_shuffle
statement:
lemma minLabel_node_of_shuffle {e : E} {l r : LTree E} (h : (node e l r).IsShuffle) :
    (node e l r).minLabel = l.minLabel

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_rightComb
statement:
lemma minLabel_rightComb : ∀ (w : List E) (k : ℕ), (rightComb w k).minLabel = k
  | [], _ => rfl
  | g :: u, j => by
    simp only [rightComb, minLabel_node, minLabel_leaf, minLabel_rightComb u (j + 1)]
    omega

name: Operad.LTree.prune_graft
statement:
lemma prune_graft (e : E) {a : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), a ∉ t.labels → p < t.size →
    prune a (graft e a t p) = t
  | t, 0, _, _ => by simp [prune]
  | leaf _, _ + 1, _, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, ha, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, not_or] at ha
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · have ih := prune_graft e l p ha.1 hp
      have hmem : a ∈ (graft e a l p).labels := (labels_graft e a l p hp).mem_iff.2 (by simp)
      cases r with
      | leaf b =>
        have hb : b ≠ a := fun hb => ha.2 (by simp [hb])
        simp [prune, hb, ih]
      | node g x y => simp [prune, hmem, ih]
    · have hq : p - l.size < r.size := by omega
      have ih := prune_graft e r _ ha.2 hq
      obtain ⟨g, x, y, hg⟩

name: Operad.LTree.size_add_one
statement:
lemma size_add_one : ∀ t : LTree E, t.size + 1 = 2 * t.arity
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by
    have

name: Operad.LTree.size_graft
statement:
lemma size_graft (e : E) (a : ℕ) : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), p < t.size →
    (graft e a t p).size = t.size + 2
  | t, 0, _ => by simp
  | leaf _, _ + 1, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · simp only [size_node, size_graft e a l p hp]
      omega
    · simp only [size_node, size_graft e a r (p - l.size) (by omega)]
      omega

name: Operad.LTree.size_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma size_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : LTree E).size = 1

name: Operad.LTree.size_node
statement: @[simp] lemma size_node (e : E) (l r : LTree E) : (node e l r).size = l.size + r.size + 1

name: Operad.LTree.size_of_perm
statement:
lemma size_of_perm {t : LTree E} {n : ℕ} (h : t.labels.Perm (List.range (n + 1))) :
    t.size = 2 * n + 1

name: Operad.LTree.window_left_shape
statement:
theorem window_left_shape {e f : E} {a b r : LTree E} (h : (node e (node f a b) r).IsShuffle)
    (hnd : (node e (node f a b) r).labels.Nodup) :
    window e f false a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel = node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2)
      ∨ window e f false a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel
        = node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1)

name: Operad.LTree.window_right_eq
statement:
theorem window_right_eq {e f : E} {l a b : LTree E} (h : (node e l (node f a b)).IsShuffle) :
    window e f true a.minLabel b.minLabel l.minLabel
      = node e (leaf 0) (node f (leaf 1) (leaf 2))

name: Operad.LTree.windows_rightComb
statement:
theorem windows_rightComb : ∀ (w : List E) (k : ℕ),
    (rightComb w k).windows
      = (w.zip w.tail).map fun p => node p.1 (leaf 0) (node p.2 (leaf 1) (leaf 2))
  | [], _ => rfl
  | [e], _ => rfl
  | e :: f :: w, k => by
    have hs :
        (node e (leaf k) (node f (leaf (k + 1)) (rightComb w (k + 1 + 1))) :
          LTree E).IsShuffle := by
      refine ⟨?_, trivial, ?_, trivial, isShuffle_rightComb w _⟩
      · simp only [minLabel_leaf, minLabel_node, minLabel_rightComb]
        omega
      · simp only [minLabel_leaf, minLabel_rightComb]
        omega
    show [window e f true (leaf (k + 1) : LTree E).minLabel (rightComb w (k + 1 + 1)).minLabel
        (leaf k : LTree E).minLabel] ++ (rightComb (f :: w) (k + 1)).windows = _
    rw [window_right_eq hs, windows_rightComb (f :: w) (k + 1)]
    rfl

name: Operad.LTree.IsEdge.exists_node
statement:
lemma IsEdge.exists_node {t : LTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : t.IsEdge p s) :
    ∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r

name: Operad.LTree.WinSpec.mono
statement:
lemma WinSpec.mono {u : LTree E} (h : u.WinSpec s) :

statement: lemma append_lt_append_left_iff (c x y : List α) : c ++ x < c ++ y ↔ x < y

name: Operad.LTree.append_lt_append_of_lengthCoded
statement:
lemma append_lt_append_of_lengthCoded {x y : List ℕ} (hx : LengthCoded x) (hy : LengthCoded y)

statement:
lemma append_lt_append_of_length_eq {x y : List α} (hxy : x.length = y.length) (h : x < y)

name: Operad.LTree.cons_lt_cons_self_iff
statement: lemma cons_lt_cons_self_iff (c : α) (x y : List α) : c :: x < c :: y ↔ x < y

name: Operad.LTree.flatten_lt_flatten_iff
statement:
lemma flatten_lt_flatten_iff {a b : List (List ℕ)} (hab : a.length = b.length)

name: Operad.LTree.ins3_eq_of_ne
statement: lemma ins3_eq_of_ne {x y z : LTree E} {k : ℕ} (h0 : k ≠ 0) (h1 : k ≠ 1) : ins3 x y z k = z

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_plug
statement:
lemma isShuffle_plug {ins : ℕ → LTree E}
    (hmono : ∀ j k, j < k → k < 3 → (ins j).minLabel < (ins k).minLabel)
    (hs : ∀ k < 3, (ins k).IsShuffle) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, m.IsShuffle → (∀ a ∈ m.labels, a < 3) → (m.plug ins).IsShuffle
  | leaf a, _, h3 => hs a (h3 a (by simp))
  | node e l r, ⟨hlr, hl, hr⟩, h3 => by
    have h3l : ∀ a ∈ l.labels, a < 3

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_replaceAt
statement:
lemma isShuffle_replaceAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E),
    (∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r) → t.IsShuffle → u.IsShuffle →
    u.labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels → (t.replaceAt p u).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, [], _, _, _, hu, _ => hu
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩, _, _, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _, _, hu, _ => hu
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, hv, ⟨hlr, hl, hr⟩, hu, hp => by
    refine ⟨?_, isShuffle_replaceAt l p u hv hl hu hp, hr⟩
    rw [minLabel_eq_of_perm (labels_replaceAt_perm l p u hv hp)]
    exact hlr
  | node e l r, true :: p, u, hv, ⟨hlr, hl, hr⟩, hu, hp => by
    refine ⟨?_, hl, isShuffle_replaceAt r p u hv hr hu hp⟩
    rw [minLabel_eq_of_perm (labels_replaceAt_perm r p u hv hp)]
    exact hlr

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_substAt
statement:
theorem isShuffle_substAt (he : t.IsEdge p s) (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup)
    (hms : m.IsShuffle) (hm : m.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) : (t.substAt p s m).IsShuffle

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_subtreeAt
statement:
lemma isShuffle_subtreeAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), t.IsShuffle →
    (t.subtreeAt p).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, [], h => h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h => h
  | node _ _ _, [], h => h
  | node _ l _, false :: p, h => isShuffle_subtreeAt l p h.2.1
  | node _ _ r, true :: p, h => isShuffle_subtreeAt r p h.2.2

name: Operad.LTree.labels_plug
statement:
lemma labels_plug (ins : ℕ → LTree E) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, (m.plug ins).labels = m.labels.flatMap fun k => (ins k).labels
  | leaf a => by simp [plug]
  | node e l r => by
    simp only [plug, labels_node, List.flatMap_append, labels_plug ins l, labels_plug ins r]

name: Operad.LTree.labels_replaceAt_perm
statement:
lemma labels_replaceAt_perm : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E),
    (∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r) → u.labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels →
    (t.replaceAt p u).labels.Perm t.labels
  | leaf _, [], _, _, h => by simpa using h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _, h => by simpa using h
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, hv, h => by
    simp only [replaceAt, labels_node]
    exact (labels_replaceAt_perm l p u hv h).append_right _
  | node e l r, true :: p, u, hv, h => by
    simp only [replaceAt, labels_node]
    exact (labels_replaceAt_perm r p u hv h).append_left _

name: Operad.LTree.labels_subtreeAt_subset
statement:
lemma labels_subtreeAt_subset : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool),
    (t.subtreeAt p).labels ⊆ t.labels
  | leaf _, [] => fun _ h => h
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => fun _ h => h
  | node _ _ _, [] => fun _ h => h
  | node _ l _, false :: p => fun _ h => by
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append]
    exact Or.inl (labels_subtreeAt_subset l p h)
  | node _ _ r, true :: p => fun _ h => by
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append]
    exact Or.inr (labels_subtreeAt_subset r p h)

name: Operad.LTree.lengthCoded_seg
statement: lemma lengthCoded_seg (rk : E → ℕ) (t : LTree E) (i : ℕ) : LengthCoded (seg rk t i)

name: Operad.LTree.lt_three_of_perm
statement:
lemma lt_three_of_perm {m : LTree E} (hm : m.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) :
    ∀ a ∈ m.labels, a < 3

name: Operad.LTree.map_range_lt_iff
statement:
lemma map_range_lt_iff (f g : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ) :
    (List.range n).map f < (List.range n).map g ↔
      ∃ i < n, (∀ j < i, f j = g j) ∧ f i < g i

name: Operad.LTree.mem_windows_iff
statement:
theorem mem_windows_iff {w : LTree E} :
    ∀ t : LTree E, w ∈ t.windows ↔ ∃ p s, t.IsEdge p s ∧ t.windowAt p s = w
  | leaf a => by
    simp only [windows, List.not_mem_nil, false_iff, not_exists, not_and]
    intro p s h
    cases p <;> cases s <;> simp [IsEdge, IsEdgeRoot, subtreeAt] at h
  | node e l r => by
    constructor
    · intro hw
      simp only [windows, List.mem_append] at hw
      rcases hw with ((hw | hw) | hw) | hw
      · match l, hw with
        | node f a b, hw =>
          refine ⟨[], false, trivial, ?_⟩
          simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hw
          simp [windowAt, windowRoot, hw]
      · match r, hw with
        | node f a b, hw =>
          refine ⟨[], true, ?_, ?_⟩
          · show IsEdgeRoot (node e l (node f a b)) true
            cases l <;> trivial
          · show windowRoot (node e l (node f a b)) true = w
            simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hw
            cases l <;> simp [windowRoot, hw]
      · obtain ⟨p, s, hp, rfl⟩

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_eq_of_perm
statement:
lemma minLabel_eq_of_perm {t u : LTree E} (h : t.labels.Perm u.labels) :
    t.minLabel = u.minLabel

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_plug
statement:
lemma minLabel_plug {ins : ℕ → LTree E}
    (hmono : ∀ j k, j < k → k < 3 → (ins j).minLabel < (ins k).minLabel) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, (∀ a ∈ m.labels, a < 3) → (m.plug ins).minLabel = (ins m.minLabel).minLabel
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, h3 => by
    have hl

name: Operad.LTree.ne_of_nodup_append
statement:
lemma ne_of_nodup_append {l₁ l₂ : List ℕ} (h : (l₁ ++ l₂).Nodup) {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ l₁)
    (hb : b ∈ l₂) : a ≠ b

name: Operad.LTree.nodup_subtreeAt
statement:
lemma nodup_subtreeAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), t.labels.Nodup →
    (t.subtreeAt p).labels.Nodup
  | leaf _, [], h => h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h => h
  | node _ _ _, [], h => h
  | node _ l _, false :: p, h => nodup_subtreeAt l p (List.nodup_append.1 h).1
  | node _ _ r, true :: p, h => nodup_subtreeAt r p (List.nodup_append.1 h).2.1

name: Operad.LTree.not_isNormal_iff
statement:
theorem not_isNormal_iff {L : Set (LTree E)} :

name: Operad.LTree.pathKey_eq_flatten
statement:
lemma pathKey_eq_flatten (rk : E → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (t : LTree E) :
    pathKey rk n t = ((List.range n).map (seg rk t)).flatten

name: Operad.LTree.pathKey_lt_iff
statement:
lemma pathKey_lt_iff (rk : E → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (t t' : LTree E) :

      (List.range n).map (seg rk t) < (List.range n).map (seg rk t')

name: Operad.LTree.pathKey_substAt_lt
Operad.LTree.pathKey_substAt_lt'
statement:
theorem pathKey_substAt_lt' (rk : E → ℕ) (ht : t ∈ monomials n) (he : t.IsEdge p s)
    {m m' : LTree E} (hm : m ∈ monomials 3) (hm' : m' ∈ monomials 3)
    (h : pathKey rk 3 m < pathKey rk 3 m') :
    pathKey rk n (t.substAt p s m) < pathKey rk n (t.substAt p s m')

name: Operad.LTree.path_of_mem_subtreeAt
statement:
lemma path_of_mem_subtreeAt {i : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), t.labels.Nodup →
    i ∈ (t.subtreeAt p).labels → t.path i = t.decAt p ++ (t.subtreeAt p).path i
  | leaf _, [], _, _ => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, false :: p, hnd, hi => by
    have hl : i ∈ l.labels

name: Operad.LTree.path_plug
statement:
lemma path_plug (ins : ℕ → LTree E) {N : ℕ}
    (hdisj : ∀ k < N, ∀ k' < N, k ≠ k' → ∀ i ∈ (ins k).labels, i ∉ (ins k').labels) {i k : ℕ}
    (hk : k < N) (hi : i ∈ (ins k).labels) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, (∀ a ∈ m.labels, a < N) → m.labels.Nodup → k ∈ m.labels →
      (m.plug ins).path i = m.path k ++ (ins k).path i
  | leaf a, _, _, hkm => by
    simp only [labels_leaf, List.mem_singleton] at hkm
    subst hkm
    rfl
  | node e l r, hN, hnd, hkm => by
    have hNl : ∀ a ∈ l.labels, a < N

name: Operad.LTree.path_replaceAt_of_mem
statement:
lemma path_replaceAt_of_mem {i : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E),
    t.labels.Nodup → (∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r) →
    u.labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels → i ∈ u.labels →
    (t.replaceAt p u).path i = t.decAt p ++ u.path i
  | leaf _, [], _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩, _, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, hnd, hv, hu, hi => by
    have hl : i ∈ (l.replaceAt p u).labels

name: Operad.LTree.path_replaceAt_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma path_replaceAt_of_not_mem {i : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E),
    t.labels.Nodup → (∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r) →
    u.labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels → i ∈ t.labels → i ∉ (t.subtreeAt p).labels →
    (t.replaceAt p u).path i = t.path i
  | leaf _, [], _, _, _, _, hi, hi' => absurd hi hi'
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩, _, _, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _, _, _, hi, hi' => absurd hi hi'
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, hnd, hv, hu, hi, hi' => by
    have hp

name: Operad.LTree.path_substAt_of_mem
statement:
theorem path_substAt_of_mem (he : t.IsEdge p s) (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup)
    (hm : m.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) {i k : ℕ} (hk : k < 3)
    (hi : i ∈ ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s k).labels) :
    (t.substAt p s m).path i
      = t.decAt p ++ m.path k ++ ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s k).path i

name: Operad.LTree.replaceAt_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma replaceAt_nil (t u : LTree E) : t.replaceAt [] u = u

name: Operad.LTree.replaceAt_subtreeAt
statement:
lemma replaceAt_subtreeAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), t.replaceAt p (t.subtreeAt p) = t
  | leaf _, [] => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _, [] => rfl
  | node e l r, false :: p => by
    simp only [replaceAt, subtreeAt, replaceAt_subtreeAt l p]

  | node _ l r => by simp [arity, arity_mapDec f l, arity_mapDec f r]

statement:
lemma card_edgeKeys {e : X} {l r : LTree X} (hnd : (node e l r).labels.Nodup) :

statement:
lemma edgeKeys_node (e : X) (l r : LTree X) :
    (node e l r).edgeKeys = l.nodeKeys ∪ r.nodeKeys

name: Operad.LTree.edgeWins_keys
statement:
lemma edgeWins_keys (e : X) (l r : LTree X) : (node e l r).edgeWins.map Prod.fst =
    l.rootKey ++ r.rootKey ++ l.edgeWins.map Prod.fst ++ r.edgeWins.map Prod.fst

name: Operad.LTree.exists_of_mem_edgeWins
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_edgeWins {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} {w : LTree X} : ∀ t : LTree X, (k, w) ∈ t.edgeWins →
    ∃ p s, t.IsEdge p s ∧ key (t.subtreeAt (p ++ [s])) = k ∧ t.windowAt p s = w
  | leaf _, h => by simp [edgeWins] at h
  | node e l r, h => by
    simp only [edgeWins, List.mem_append] at h
    rcases h with ((h | h) | h) | h
    · match l, h with
      | node f a b, h =>
        simp only [List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        exact ⟨[], false, trivial, by simp [subtreeAt, h.1],
          by simp [windowAt, windowRoot, h.2]⟩
    · match r, h with
      | node f a b, h =>
        simp only [List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        refine ⟨[], true, ?_, by simp [subtreeAt, h.1], ?_⟩
        · show IsEdgeRoot (node e l (node f a b)) true
          cases l <;> trivial
        · show windowRoot (node e l (node f a b)) true = w
          cases l <;> simp [windowRoot, h.2]
    · obtain ⟨p, s, hp, hk, hw⟩

name: Operad.LTree.isEdgeRoot_mapDec
statement:
lemma isEdgeRoot_mapDec (f : E → F) :
    ∀ (u : LTree E) (s : Bool), (u.mapDec f).IsEdgeRoot s ↔ u.IsEdgeRoot s
  | leaf _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | node _ (leaf _) (leaf _), _ => by cases ‹Bool› <;> exact Iff.rfl
  | node _ (node _ _ _) (leaf _), _ => by cases ‹Bool› <;> exact Iff.rfl
  | node _ (leaf _) (node _ _ _), _ => by cases ‹Bool› <;> exact Iff.rfl

statement: lemma mem_edgeKeys {t : LTree X} {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} : k ∈ t.edgeKeys ↔ ∃ w, (k, w) ∈ t.edgeWins

name: Operad.LTree.mem_edgeWins_key
statement:
lemma mem_edgeWins_key {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} {w : LTree X} : ∀ t : LTree X, (k, w) ∈ t.edgeWins →
    k ∈ t.nodeKeys ∧ (ofLex k).2 < t.arity
  | leaf _, h => by simp [edgeWins] at h
  | node e l r, h => by
    have hl := arity_pos l
    have hr := arity_pos r
    simp only [edgeWins, List.mem_append] at h
    rcases h with ((h | h) | h) | h
    · match l, h with
      | node f a b, h =>
        simp only [List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩

name: Operad.LTree.mem_keyList_iff
statement:
lemma mem_keyList_iff : ∀ (t : LTree X) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ), k ∈ t.keyList ↔ k ∈ t.nodeKeys
  | leaf _, k => by simp [keyList, nodeKeys]
  | node d l r, k => by
    simp [keyList, nodeKeys, mem_keyList_iff l, mem_keyList_iff r]

name: Operad.LTree.mem_nodeKeys_labels
statement:
lemma mem_nodeKeys_labels : ∀ (t : LTree X) {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, k ∈ t.nodeKeys →
    (ofLex k).1 ∈ t.labels ∧ (ofLex k).2 ≤ t.arity
  | leaf _, k, hk => by simp [nodeKeys] at hk
  | node d l r, k, hk => by
    simp only [nodeKeys, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union] at hk
    rcases hk with rfl | hk | hk
    · exact ⟨by simpa [key] using minLabel_mem (node d l r), le_rfl⟩
    · have

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_mapDec
statement:
@[simp] lemma minLabel_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).minLabel = t.minLabel
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [minLabel_mapDec f l, minLabel_mapDec f r]

name: Operad.LTree.nodeKeys_mapDec
statement:
lemma nodeKeys_mapDec {Y : Type*} (f : X → Y) : ∀ t : LTree X, (t.mapDec f).nodeKeys = t.nodeKeys
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, nodeKeys, nodeKeys_mapDec f l, nodeKeys_mapDec f r]
    rw [show key (node (f d) (l.mapDec f) (r.mapDec f)) = key (node d l r) from
      key_mapDec f (node d l r)]

name: Operad.LTree.nodup_keyList
statement:
lemma nodup_keyList : ∀ t : LTree X, t.labels.Nodup → t.keyList.Nodup
  | leaf _, _ => by simp [keyList]
  | node d l r, hnd => by
    rw [keyList, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_append, mem_keyList_iff, mem_keyList_iff]
    refine ⟨fun h => h.elim (key_not_mem_left d l r) (key_not_mem_right d l r),
      List.nodup_append.2 ⟨nodup_keyList l (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1,
        nodup_keyList r (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1, fun a ha b hb hab => ?_⟩⟩
    subst hab
    rw [mem_keyList_iff] at ha hb
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_nodeKeys hnd) ha hb

name: Operad.LTree.path_mapDec
statement:
lemma path_mapDec (f : E → F) (i : ℕ) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).path i = (t.path i).map f
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, path, labels_mapDec, List.map_cons]
    split_ifs
    · rw [path_mapDec f i l]
    · rw [path_mapDec f i r]

name: Operad.LTree.perm_keyList
statement:
lemma perm_keyList : ∀ t : LTree X, t.keyList.Perm (t.rootKey ++ t.edgeWins.map Prod.fst)
  | leaf _ => by simp [keyList, rootKey, edgeWins]
  | node e l r => by
    rw [edgeWins_keys]
    simp only [keyList, rootKey, List.singleton_append]
    refine List.Perm.cons _ (((perm_keyList l).append (perm_keyList r)).trans ?_)
    simp only [List.append_assoc]
    refine List.Perm.append_left _ ?_
    rw [← List.append_assoc, ← List.append_assoc]
    exact List.perm_append_comm.append_right _

name: Operad.LTree.plug_mapDec
statement:
lemma plug_mapDec (f : E → F) (ins : ℕ → LTree E) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, (m.mapDec f).plug (fun k => (ins k).mapDec f) = (m.plug ins).mapDec f
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by simp only [mapDec_node, plug, plug_mapDec f ins l, plug_mapDec f ins r]

name: Operad.LTree.replaceAt_mapDec
statement:
lemma replaceAt_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E),

  | leaf _, [], _ => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _, [], _ => rfl
  | node e l r, false :: p, u => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, replaceAt, replaceAt_mapDec f l p u]
  | node e l r, true :: p, u => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, replaceAt, replaceAt_mapDec f r p u]

name: Operad.LTree.size_mapDec
statement:
@[simp] lemma size_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).size = t.size

name: Operad.LTree.subtreeAt_append
statement:
lemma subtreeAt_append : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p q : List Bool),
    t.subtreeAt (p ++ q) = (t.subtreeAt p).subtreeAt q
  | leaf _, [], _ => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, [] => by simp [subtreeAt]
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _ :: _ => by simp [subtreeAt]
  | node _ _ _, [], _ => by simp
  | node _ l _, false :: p, q => subtreeAt_append l p q
  | node _ _ r, true :: p, q => subtreeAt_append r p q

name: Operad.LTree.subtreeAt_mapDec
statement:
lemma subtreeAt_mapDec (f : E → F) :
    ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), (t.mapDec f).subtreeAt p = (t.subtreeAt p).mapDec f
  | leaf _, [] => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _, [] => rfl
  | node _ l _, false :: p => subtreeAt_mapDec f l p
  | node _ _ r, true :: p => subtreeAt_mapDec f r p

name: Operad.LTree.winInputs_mapDec
statement:
lemma winInputs_mapDec (f : E → F) :
    ∀ (u : LTree E) (s : Bool), u.IsEdgeRoot s →
      (u.mapDec f).winInputs s = ((u.winInputs s).1.mapDec f, (u.winInputs s).2.1.mapDec f,
        (u.winInputs s).2.2.mapDec f)
  | node e (node g a b) c, false, _ => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, winInputs, minLabel_mapDec]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  | node e c (node g a b), true, _ => by
    cases c <;> rfl

lemma windowRoot_mapDec (f : E → F) :

  | node e (node g a b) c, false, _ => by
    simp [windowRoot, window]
  | node e c (node g a b), true, _ => by
    cases c <;> simp [windowRoot, window]

@[simp] lemma arity_mergeK (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : ∀ x : BarTree E, (mergeK x k).arity = x.arity
